fields.title: El Anillo Único
fields.subtitle: Respuesta a Todos Los Acertijos
fields.lore: “...que se creía desaparecido para el mundo.”

fields.title: L'Anneau Unique
fields.subtitle: La Réponse à Toutes les Énigmes
fields.lore: « “... que l'on croyait disparu du monde.” »

fields.title: L'Unico Anello
fields.subtitle: La Risposta a Tutti gli Enigmi
fields.lore: “‘...che tutti pensavano scomparso dal mondo.'”

fields.title: Rabia
fields.lore: La furia llenó los corazones de los atacantes Dunlendinos.

fields.title: Colère
fields.lore: La rage emplissait le coeur des attaquants de Dun.

fields.title: Collera
fields.lore: La rabbia riempì i cuori degli assalitori Dunlandiani.

cards.gameText: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may make it fierce until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: “‘The Wild Men of Dunland have no love for Théoden of Rohan since he took their land.'”

fields.title: Horde wilder Menschen
fields.lore: “Diese Wilden aus Dunland hassen Théoden dafür, dass er ihnen ihr Land genommen hat.“

fields.title: Banda De Hombres Salvajes
fields.lore: “Los hombres salvajes de las Tierras Pardas no le tienen aprecio a Théoden de Rohan desde que tomó sus tierras.”

fields.title: Bande d'Hommes Sauvages
fields.lore: « “Les Hommes sauvages du Pays de Dun n'ont aucune dévotion pour Théoden de Rohan depuis qu'il leur a pris leurs terres.” »

fields.title: Banda di Uomini Selvaggi
fields.lore: “‘Gli Uomini selvaggi del Dunland odiano Théoden di Rohan da quando egli ha preso le loro terre.'”

cards.title: Burn Every Village

cards.lore: “‘Take your rabble through the Westemnet; take back the lands they stole from you.'”

fields.title: Brennt jedes Dorf nieder
fields.lore: “Führt eure Stämme durch Westemnet, erobert das Land, dass sie euch gestohlen haben, zurück.”

fields.title: Quemad Cada Pueblo
fields.lore: “Lleva a tu multitud a Oestemnet; recupera las tierras que te robaron.”

fields.title: Brûlez ChaqueVillage
fields.lore: « “Emmenez votre meute à travers l'Ouestemnet; reprenez les terres qu'ils vous ont volées. ” »

fields.title: Bruciate Ogni Villaggio
fields.lore: “‘Guida la tua marmaglia attraverso l'Ovestemnet; riprendetevi le terre che vi hanno rubato.'”

cards.lore: The men of Dunland have hated the Rohirrim for many years.

fields.title: Anhaltende Bedrohung
fields.lore: Die Menschen aus Dunland hassten die Rohirrim schon seit vielen Jahren.

fields.title: Amenazando Constantemente
fields.lore: Los hombres de las Tierras Pardas han odiado a los Rohirrim por largos años.

fields.title: Une Menace Constante
fields.lore: La haine de Ceux du Pays de Dun pour les Rohirrim perdure depuis longtemps.

fields.title: Minaccia Costante
fields.lore: Gli uomini del Dunland hanno in odio i Rohirrim da molti anni.

fields.lore: “Dunland and Dunlendings are the names that the Rohirrim gave to them, because they were swarthy and dark-haired....”

fields.title: Dunkle Wut
fields.lore: Dunland und Dunländer sind die Namen, die die Rohirrim ihnen gaben, weil sie schwärzlich und dunkelhaarig waren.

fields.title: Furia Oscura
fields.lore: “Dunlendinos de las Tierras Pardas fue el nombre que los Rohirrim les dieron, porque eran de cabellos negros y rostros cetrinos...”

fields.title: Fureur Noire
fields.lore: « Les Rohirrim, eux, les appelaient gens du Pays de Dun, ou Ceux du Pays de Dun parce qu'ils avaient le teint basané et le cheveu noir... »

fields.title: Furia Oscura
fields.lore: “Dunland e Dunlandiani erano i nomi dati loro dai Rohirrim, perché erano scuri di pelle e di capelli...”

cards.title: Death to the Strawheads
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make a [DUNLAND] Man strength +1 for each companion you spot.
cards.lore: The dark Dunlendings called their fair-haired enemies from Rohan “Strawheads.”

fields.title: Death to the Strawheads
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make a [DUNLAND] Man strength +1 for each companion you spot.
fields.lore: The dark Dunlendings called their fair-haired enemies from Rohan “Strawheads.”

fields.title: Tod den Strohköpfen!
fields.lore: Die dunkelhaarigen Dunländer nannten ihre blonden Feinde aus Rohan ‚Strohköpfe'.

fields.title: Muerte Para Los Cabeza-De-Paja
fields.lore: Los oscuros Dunlendinos llamaban a sus enemigos de cabello claro de Rohan “Cabeza-de-Paja”.

fields.title: Mort aux Têtes de Paille
fields.lore: Les sombres habitants du Pays de Dun appelaient leurs ennemis de Rohan, aux cheveux pâles, “Têtes de paille”.

fields.title: Morte ai Testapaglia
fields.lore: Gli scuri Dunlandiani chiamavano i loro biondi nemici di Rohan “Testapaglia”.

cards.title: Dunlending Arsonist
cards.gameText: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may play a [DUNLAND] Man from hand; his twilight cost is -2. That Man is fierce and damage +1 until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: “‘They bring fire... and they are burning as they come, rick, cot, and tree.'”

fields.title: Dunland Brandstifter
fields.lore: "Sie bringen Feuer mit und verbrennen im Vorbeiziehen Stall, Schober und Baum.“

fields.title: Incendiario Dunlendino
fields.lore: “Traen fuego... e incendian todo cuanto encuentran a su paso, niaras, cabañas y árboles.”

fields.title: Pyromane Dun
fields.lore: « “Ils apportent du feu, et ils brûlent tout sur leur passage, meules, chaumières et arbres.” »

fields.title: Incendiario Dunlandiano
fields.lore: “‘Portano fuoco... e stanno bruciando sul loro passaggio alberi, capanne e pagliai.'”

cards.title: Dunlending Brigand
cards.lore: “‘This was a rich vale and had many homesteads. Alas for my folk!'”

fields.title: Dunlending Brigand
fields.lore: “‘This was a rich vale and had many homesteads. Alas for my folk!'”

fields.title: Dunland Brigant
fields.lore: "Das hier war ein reiches Tal und hatte viele Gehöfte. Wehe für mein Volk!“

fields.title: Bandolero Dunlendino
fields.lore: “Este era un valle rico y en él prosperaban muchas heredades. ¡Ay, pobre pueblo mío!”

fields.title: Brigand Dun
fields.lore: « “C'était une riche vallée, qui possédait de nombreux coursiers de chez nous. Hélas pour les miens!” »

fields.title: Brigante Dunlandiano
fields.lore: “‘Questa era una ricca vallata piena di fattorie. Ahimè, povero mio popolo!'”

cards.title: Dunlending Looter

cards.lore: “...the Dunlendings raided often over the Isen.”

fields.lore: “...the Dunlendings raided often over the Isen.”

fields.title: Diebischer Dunländer
fields.lore: ... machten die Dunländer oft Raubzüge über den Isen.

fields.title: Saqueador Dunlendino
fields.lore: “...los Dunlendinos saqueaban frecuentemente cruzando el Isen.”

fields.title: Dépouilleur Dun
fields.lore: « ... Ceux du Pays de Dun allaient souvent piller de par l'Isen. »

fields.title: Saccheggiatore Dunlandiano
fields.lore: ‘...i Dunlandiani fecero molte scorribande oltre l'Isen.'”

cards.title: Dunlending Madman

cards.lore: “‘They hate us, and they are glad; for our doom seems certain to them.'”

fields.title: Dunlending Madman
fields.gameText: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may make him strength +2 and fierce until the regroup phase.
fields.lore: “‘They hate us, and they are glad; for our doom seems certain to them.'”

fields.title: Wahnsinniger Dunländer
fields.lore: "Sie hassen uns und freuen sich; denn unser Untergang scheint ihnen gewiss zu sein.“

fields.title: Dunlendino Loco
fields.lore: “Nos odian y están contentos; pues nuestra perdición les parece segura.”

fields.title: Fou Dun
fields.lore: « “Ils nous haïssent, et ils sont contents, car notre perte leur semble certaine.” »

fields.title: Pazzo Dunlandiano
fields.lore: “‘Ci odiano e sono contenti, perché sono certi che ormai il nostro destino sta per compiersi.'”

cards.title: Dunlending Pillager

cards.lore: “‘Not in half a thousand years have they forgotten their grievance that the lords of Gondor gave the Mark to Eorl the Young and made alliance with him.'”

fields.title: Plündernder Dunländer
fields.lore: "In einem halben Jahrtausend haben sie ihren Groll darüber nicht vergessen, dass die Herren von Gondor Eorl dem Jungen die Mark verliehen und ein Bündnis mit ihm geschlossen haben.“

fields.title: Dunlendino Saqueador
fields.lore: “No han olvidado en medio milenio la ofensa que les infligieran los señores de Gondor al otorgar la Marca a Eorl el Joven y aliarse con él.”

fields.title: Pilleur Dun
fields.lore: « “Depuis un demi-millénaire, ils n'ont pas oublié leur grief de ce que les seigneurs du Gondor ont donné la Marche à Eorl le Grand et fait une alliance avec lui.” »

fields.title: Razziatore Dunlandiano
fields.lore: “‘Non sono bastati cinquecento anni per cancellare in loro il rancore contro i signori di Gondor che diedero il Mark ad Eorl il Giovane e si allearono con lui.'”

cards.title: Dunlending Ransacker

cards.lore: “‘Yet there are many that cry in the Dunland tongue.'”

fields.lore: “‘Yet there are many that cry in the Dunland tongue.'”

fields.title: Dunland Wegelagerer
fields.lore: "Dennoch sind viele da, die in der Sprache von Dunland schreien.“

fields.title: Desvalijador Dunlendino
fields.lore: “Sin embargo hay muchos que gritan en la lengua de las Tierras Pardas.”

fields.title: Cambrioleur Dun
fields.lore: « “Il y en a pourtant plusieurs qui pleurent dans la langue du Pays de Dun.” »

fields.title: Predone Dunlandiano
fields.lore: “‘Ci sono molti ancora che gridano in lingua Dunlandiana.'”

cards.lore: “‘They will not give way now for dusk or dawn, until Théoden is taken, or they themselves are slain.'”

fields.lore: “‘They will not give way now for dusk or dawn, until Théoden is taken, or they themselves are slain.'”

fields.title: Dunland Vandale
fields.lore: "Sie werden nicht zurückweichen, ob nun die Abend – oder Morgendämmerung kommt, bis Théoden gefangengenommen ist oder sie selbst erschlagen sind.“

fields.title: Devastador Dunlendino
fields.lore: “No los detendrán las luces del alba ni las sombras del crepúsculo, hasta que hayan tomado prisionero a Théoden, o ellos mismos hayan sucumbido.”

fields.title: Ravageur Dun
fields.lore: « “Ils ne fléchiront pas maintenant, que ce soit le crépuscule ou l'aube, tant que Théoden ne sera pris ou eux-mêmes tués.” »

fields.title: Distruttore Dunlandiano
fields.lore: “‘Alba e crepuscolo non li faranno indietreggiare se prima non avranno fatto prigioniero Théoden, o non si saranno fatti tutti uccidere.'”

cards.title: Dunlending Robber

cards.lore: “‘We will fight....'”

fields.lore: “‘We will fight....'”

fields.title: Dunland Räuber
fields.lore: "Wir werden kämpfen....“

fields.title: Ladrón Dunlendino
fields.lore: “Lucharemos...”

fields.title: Voleur Dun
fields.lore: « “Nous nous battrons...” »

fields.title: Ladro Dunlandiano
fields.lore: “‘Noi combatteremo...'”

cards.title: Dunlending Savage
cards.lore: The Dunlendings' fury could only end in the death of the king of Rohan.

fields.title: Dunlending Savage

fields.title: Dunland Krieger
fields.lore: Sie stammten von dem Volk ab, das vor Urzeiten in den Tälern des Weißen Gebirges gelebt hatte.

fields.title: Guerrero Dunlendino
fields.lore: “Son las reminiscencias de la gente que se estableció antaño en los valles de las Montañas Blancas.”

fields.title: Guerrier Dun
fields.lore: « Il s'agissait des restes des populations qui au temps jadis avaient vécu dans les vallons des Montagnes Blanches. »

fields.title: Guerriero Dunlandiano
fields.lore: “Essi erano... gli ultimi superstiti degli abitanti dei Monti Bianchi.”

fields.lore: Einzig dicke Tierhäute schützten die Dunländer.

fields.title: Pieles
fields.lore: Sólo las gruesas pieles de los animales protegían a los Dunlendinos.

fields.title: Peaux
fields.lore: Ceux du Pays de Dun n'avaient que des peaux d'animaux sauvages en guise d'armure.

fields.title: Pelli
fields.lore: I Dunlandiani si corazzavano solamente con pesanti pelli di animali.

cards.lore: “‘...Saruman has armed the wild hillmen and herdfolk of Dunland beyond the rivers, and these also he loosed upon us.'”

fields.lore: “‘...Saruman has armed the wild hillmen and herdfolk of Dunland beyond the rivers, and these also he loosed upon us.'”

fields.title: Berghäuptling
fields.lore: "... Saruman hat die wilden Bergbewohner und das Hirtenvolk von Dunland jenseits der Flüsse bewaffnet und auch auf uns losgelassen.“

fields.title: Jefe De La Colina
fields.lore: “...Saruman ha armado a los montañeses salvajes y a las masas de las Tierras Pardas al otro lado del río, y estos también nos los ha tirado encima.”

fields.title: Chef des Collines
fields.lore: « “Saroumane a armé les sauvages montagnards et gardiens de troupeaux du Pays de Dun au-delà des rivières, et ceux-là aussi il les a lancés contre nous.” »

fields.title: Capo delle Colline
fields.lore: ‘“‘...Saruman ha armato i selvaggi uomini delle colline e il popolo pastore di Dunland oltre i fiumi, e anche questi li ha sciolti contro di noi.'”

fields.title: Bergbewohnerschar
fields.lore: Wie in den Jahren zuvor, marschierten die Dunländer in großer Zahl nach Westen.

fields.title: Banda De Montañeses
fields.lore: Como antiguamente, los Dunlendinos lucharon contra el oeste.

fields.title: Bande des Collines
fields.lore: « Comme par les années passées, Ceux du Pays de Dun marchèrent en force vers l'ouest. »

fields.title: Banda delle Colline
fields.lore: Come nel passato, i Dunlandiani marciarono in forza verso l'ovest.

fields.title: Bergbewohnerhorde
fields.lore: "Sie sind ein kampfwütiges Volk, wenn sie einmal aufgerüttelt sind.“

fields.title: Horda De Montañeses
fields.lore: “Son un pueblo fiero cuando los provocan.”

fields.title: Horde des Collines
fields.lore: « “Lorsqu'ils sont agités, ils deviennent un peuple acharné.” »

fields.title: Orda delle Colline
fields.lore: “‘E' gente feroce, quando si desta.'”

fields.title: Bergbewohnerpöbel
fields.lore: "Diesen alten Hass hat Saruman geschürt.“

fields.title: Turba De Montañeses
fields.lore: “Este antiguo odio ha inflamado a Saruman.”

fields.title: Meute des Collines
fields.lore: « “Saroumane a enflammé cette ancienne haine. ” »

fields.title: Torma delle Colline
fields.lore: “‘Saruman ha infiammato e alimentato quell'antico odio.'”

fields.title: Bergbewohnergesindel
fields.lore: Die unerbittliche Wut der Dunländer verschlang ein Dorf nach dem anderen.

fields.title: Populacho Montañes
fields.lore: La implacable furia de los Dunlendinos consumió un poblado tras otro.

fields.title: Foule des Collines
fields.lore: La furie sans bornes de Ceux du Pays de Dun détruisit un village après l'autre.

fields.title: Folla delle Colline
fields.lore: La furia inarrestabile dei Dunlandiani consumò un villaggio dopo l'altro.

fields.title: Bergbewohnerstamm
fields.lore: "... die werden nicht schwach in der Sonne... die wilden Menschen aus den Bergen.“

fields.title: Tribu De Montañeses
fields.lore: “No retrocederán a la luz del sol... los montañeses salvajes.”

fields.title: Tribu des Collines
fields.lore: « “Ils ne vont pas fléchir sous le soleil... les hommes sauvages des collines.” »

fields.title: Tribù delle Colline
fields.lore: ‘Non si scoraggeranno certo di fronte al sole... gli Uomini selvaggi delle colline.'”

fields.title: Eiserne Axt
fields.lore: Saruman rüstete die Dunländer mit Waffen aus, die von seinen Orks in Isengart geschmiedet worden waren.

fields.title: Hacha De Hierro
fields.lore: Saruman armó a los Dunlendinos con armas forjadas por sus Orcos en Isengard.

fields.title: Hache de Fer
fields.lore: Saroumane arma Ceux du Pays de Dun de haches forgées par ses Orques en l'Isengard.

fields.title: Ascia di Ferro
fields.lore: Saruman armò i Dunlandiani con armi forgiate a Isengard dai suoi Orchi.

cards.title: Living Off Rock
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time a [DUNLAND] Man wins a skirmish involving a [ROHAN] Man, you may make that minion strength +2 and fierce until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: “‘The Horsemen took your land; they drove your people into the hills to scratch living off rock.'”

fields.title: Living Off Rock

fields.lore: “‘The Horsemen took your land; they drove your people into the hills to scratch living off rock.'”

fields.title: Von nacktem Fels leben
fields.lore: “Die Pferdeherren nahmen euch euer Land, sie trieben euer Volk in die Berge, wo ihr auf nacktem Fels einen neuen Anfang machen musstet.”

fields.title: Viviendo De Las Piedras
fields.lore: “Los Jinetes tomaron vuestras tierras; llevaron a tus gentes a las colinas para que vivieran de las piedras.”

fields.title: Vivre de Pierres
fields.lore: « “Les Cavaliers ont pris vos terres; ils ont chassé votre peuple dans les collines, où ils durent vivre de pierres.” »

fields.title: Vivere tra le Rocce
fields.lore: “‘I Cavalieri si sono presi la vostra terra; hanno costretto la vostra gente ad andarsene sulle colline a guadagnarsi da vivere tra le rocce!'”

cards.title: No Refuge
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. While a [DUNLAND] Man is stacked on a site, the Shadow number of each site is +5.
cards.lore: As their homes were ravaged by the wild men, refugees fled to the safety of Helm's Deep.

fields.title: No Refuge
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. While a [DUNLAND] Man is stacked on a site, the Shadow number of each site is +5.
fields.lore: As their homes were ravaged by the wild men, refugees fled to the safety of Helm's Deep.

fields.title: Kein Unterschlupf
fields.lore: Während ihre Häuser von den wilden Menschen niedergebrannt wurden, flüchteten die Überlebenden in die Sicherheit von Helms Klamm.

fields.title: Sin Refugio
fields.lore: Mientras sus hogares eran devastados por los hombres salvajes, los refugiados huyeron a la seguridad del Abismo de Helm.

fields.title: Aucun Refuge
fields.lore: Puisque leurs maisons étaient ravagées par les hommes sauvages, les réfugiés s'enfuirent vers la sécurité du Gouffre de Helm.

fields.title: Nessun Rifugio
fields.lore: Quando le loro case furono saccheggiate dagli uomini selvaggi, i profughi scapparono verso la sicurezza del Fosso di Helm.

cards.title: No Retreat
cards.gameText: Plays on a site you control. Regroup: Spot 2 [DUNLAND] Men and discard this condition to make the Free Peoples player choose to move again this turn (if the move limit allows).
cards.lore: Hordes from Dunland laid waste to villages as their numbers grew.

fields.title: No Retreat

fields.lore: Hordes from Dunland laid waste to villages as their numbers grew.

fields.title: Kein Zurück
fields.lore: Eine immer größer werdende Horde Dunländer verwüstete die Dörfer Rohans.

fields.title: No Hay Huida
fields.lore: Las hordas de las Tierras Pardas devastaron pueblos a medida que su número crecía.

fields.title: Aucune Retraite
fields.lore: Plus les hordes du Pays de Dun grandissaient, plus les villages qu'ils visitaient en souffraient.

fields.title: Nessuna Ritirata
fields.lore: Le orde del Dunland portarono distruzione presso i villaggi non appena il loro numero crebbe.

cards.title: Over the Isen
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Assignment: Spot a site you control and remove (2) to assign a [DUNLAND] Man to an unbound companion.
cards.lore: Like their ancestors years before, the Dunlendings came down from Isengard.

fields.title: Over the Isen
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Assignment: Spot a site you control and remove (2) to assign a [DUNLAND] Man to an unbound companion.
fields.lore: Like their ancestors years before, the Dunlendings came down from Isengard.

fields.title: Über den Isen
fields.lore: Wie schon ihre Vorfahren Jahre zuvor, kamen die Dunländer aus Isengard hervor.

fields.title: Sobre El Isen
fields.lore: Al igual que sus ancestros años antes, los Dunlendinos bajaron hacia Isengard.

fields.title: Au-Delà de l'Isen
fields.lore: Comme leurs ancêtres avant eux, Ceux du Pays de Dun descendirent de l'Isengard.

fields.title: Sull'Isen
fields.lore: Come i loro antenati anni prima, i Dunlandiani scesero giù da Isengard.

cards.title: Ravage the Defeated
cards.gameText: Response: If your [DUNLAND] Man wins a skirmish, discard all Free Peoples cards borne by the companion or ally he was skirmishing.
cards.lore: What the Dunlendings cannot steal, they destroy.

fields.title: Ravage the Defeated
fields.gameText: Response: If your [DUNLAND] Man wins a skirmish, discard all Free Peoples cards borne by the companion or ally he was skirmishing.
fields.lore: What the Dunlendings cannot steal, they destroy.

fields.title: Macht die Verlierer nieder
fields.lore: Was die Dunländer nicht stehlen konnten, zerstörten sie.

fields.title: Aniquilar A Los Derrotados
fields.lore: Lo que los Dunlendinos no pueden robar, lo destruyen.

fields.title: Ravagez les Vaincus
fields.lore: Ce que Ceux du Pays de Dun ne pouvaient prendre, ils détruisaient.

fields.title: Saccheggia gli Sconfitti
fields.lore: Ciò che i Dunlandiani non possono rubare, essi lo distruggono.

cards.title: Wake of Destruction
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Spot 2 sites you control to make each of your [DUNLAND] Men fierce until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: The anger of the wild men increased with every home they pillaged.

fields.title: Wake of Destruction
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Spot 2 sites you control to make each of your [DUNLAND] Men fierce until the regroup phase.
fields.lore: The anger of the wild men increased with every home they pillaged.

fields.title: Im Sog der Zerstörung
fields.lore: Der Zorn der wilden Menschen wuchs mit jedem Haus, das sie zerstörten.

fields.title: El Despertar De La Destrucción
fields.lore: La ira de los hombres salvajes creció con cada hogar saqueado.

fields.title: Vague de Destruction
fields.lore: La colère des hommes sauvages croissait d'une maison pillée à l'autre.

fields.title: Scia di Distruzione
fields.lore: L'astio degli uomini selvaggi aumentò dopo ogni casa saccheggiata.

cards.title: War Club
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a [DUNLAND] Man. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may discard 2 Free Peoples possessions.
cards.lore: The wooden weapons of the wild men slew scores of unarmed villagers.

fields.title: War Club
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a [DUNLAND] Man. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may discard 2 Free Peoples possessions.
fields.lore: The wooden weapons of the wild men slew scores of unarmed villagers.

fields.title: Kriegskeule
fields.lore: Die hölzernen Waffen der wilden Menschen erschlugen unzählige unbewaffnete Dorfbewohner.

fields.title: Garrote De Guerra
fields.lore: Las armas de madera de los hombres salvajes exterminaron a cientos de aldeanos desarmados.

fields.title: Massue de Guerre
fields.lore: Des vingtaines de villageois sans défense périrent sous les coups des armes de bois des hommes sauvages.

fields.title: Mazza da Guerra
fields.lore: Le armi di legno degli Uomini selvaggi uccisero centinaia di villici disarmati.

cards.title: War Cry of Dunland
cards.gameText: Response: If a [DUNLAND] Man wins a skirmish, make him fierce and strength +4 until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: “‘Death to the Forgoil!'”

fields.title: War Cry of Dunland
fields.gameText: Response: If a [DUNLAND] Man wins a skirmish, make him fierce and strength +4 until the regroup phase.
fields.lore: “‘Death to the Forgoil!'”

fields.title: Kriegsschrei der Dunländer
fields.lore: "Tod den Forgoil!“

fields.title: Grito De Guerra De Las Tierras Pardas
fields.lore: “¡Muerte para los Forgoil!”

fields.title: Cri de Guerre du Pays de Dun
fields.lore: « “Mort au Forgoil!” »

fields.title: Grido di Battaglia del Dunland
fields.lore: “Morte ai Forgoil!'”

cards.title: Wild Man of Dunland
cards.gameText: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may play a [DUNLAND] Man from hand; his twilight cost is -2. That Man is fierce and damage +1 until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: “‘By our blood... we swear to fight for you....'”

fields.title: Wild Man of Dunland
fields.gameText: Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may play a [DUNLAND] Man from hand; his twilight cost is -2. That Man is fierce and damage +1 until the regroup phase.
fields.lore: “‘By our blood... we swear to fight for you....'”

fields.title: Barbarischer Dunländer
fields.lore: "Bei unserem Blute... schwören wir für Euch zu kämpfen....“

fields.title: Hombre Salvaje Dunlendino
fields.lore: “Por nuestra sangre...juramos luchar por ti...”

fields.title: Homme Sauvage de Dun
fields.lore: « “Par notre sang... nous jurons de nous battre pour toi...” »

fields.title: Uomo Selvaggio
fields.lore: “‘Sul nostro sangue... giuriamo di combattere al tuo servizio...'”

cards.title: Wild Man Raid
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Spot 3 [DUNLAND] Men to discard a Free Peoples possession or condition.
cards.lore: Not even the smallest of trinkets was safe from the destruction of the Dunlendings.

fields.title: Wild Man Raid
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Spot 3 [DUNLAND] Men to discard a Free Peoples possession or condition.
fields.lore: Not even the smallest of trinkets was safe from the destruction of the Dunlendings.

fields.title: Überfall der wilden Menschen
fields.lore: Nicht einmal das kleinste Ding war vor der Zerstörungswut der Dunländer sicher.

fields.title: Incursión De Hombres Salvajes
fields.lore: Ni los más pequeños cachivaches estaban a salvo de la destrucción de los Dunlendinos.

fields.title: Raid d'Hommes Sauvages
fields.lore: Même la plus petite des pacotilles n'est pas à l'abri de la destruction de Ceux du Pays de Dun.

fields.title: Razzia degli Uomini Selvaggi
fields.lore: Nemmeno il più piccolo oggetto era al sicuro dalla distruzione portata dai Dunlandiani.

cards.title: Wulf
cards.subtitle: Dunlending Chieftain
cards.gameText: Fierce. Response: If another [DUNLAND] Man wins a skirmish, exert Wulf to take control of a site.
cards.lore: “‘Do you not hear their voices?'”

fields.title: Wulf
fields.subtitle: Dunlending Chieftain
fields.gameText: Fierce. Response: If another [DUNLAND] Man wins a skirmish, exert Wulf to take control of a site.
fields.lore: “‘Do you not hear their voices?'”

fields.subtitle: Häuptling der Dunländer
fields.lore: "Hört Ihr nicht ihre Stimmen?“

fields.subtitle: Caudillo Dunlendino
fields.lore: “¿No oyes sus voces?”

fields.subtitle: Chef de Clan Dun
fields.lore: « “N'entendez-vous pas leurs voix?” »

fields.subtitle: Capotribù Dunlandiano
fields.lore: “‘Senti le loro voci?'”

cards.title: Axe of Erebor
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Gimli. He is damage +1. Skirmish: Discard a [DWARVEN] condition or a card stacked on a [DWARVEN] condition to make Gimli strength +1.
cards.lore: “‘...wherever thou goest my thought goes with thee. But have a care to lay thine axe to the right tree!'”

fields.title: Axe of Erebor
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Gimli. He is damage +1. Skirmish: Discard a [DWARVEN] condition or a card stacked on a [DWARVEN] condition to make Gimli strength +1.
fields.lore: “‘...wherever thou goest my thought goes with thee. But have a care to lay thine axe to the right tree!'”

fields.title: Axt vom Erebor
fields.lore: "... wo immer Ihr geht, begleiten Euch meine Gedanken. Doch nehmt Euch in acht, dass Ihr Eure Axt an den richtigen Baum legt!“

fields.title: Hacha De Erebor
fields.lore: “...a donde quiera que vaya mi pensamiento va contigo. ¡Pero cuida de que tu hacha se aplique al árbol adecuado!”

fields.title: Hache d'Erebor
fields.lore: « “... où que tu ailles, ma pensée t'accompagne. Mais prends bien soin d'appliquer ta hache au bon arbre!” »

fields.title: Ascia di Erebor
fields.lore: “‘...ovunque andrai il mio pensiero ti accompagnerà. Ma abbi cura che la tua ascia colpisca l'albero giusto!'”

cards.title: Best Company
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or +4 if at a battleground).
cards.lore: “An axe swung and swept back. Two Orcs fell headless. The rest fled.”

fields.title: Best Company
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or +4 if at a battleground).
fields.lore: “An axe swung and swept back. Two Orcs fell headless. The rest fled.”

fields.title: Beste Gesellschaft
fields.lore: Eine Axt wurde geschwungen und sauste noch einmal nieder. Zwei Orks waren die Köpfe abgeschlagen. Die übrigen flohen.

fields.title: La Mejor Compañía
fields.lore: “Un hacha osciló como un péndulo. Dos Orcos cayeron, decapitados. El resto escapó.”

fields.title: La Meilleure Compagnie
fields.lore: « Une hache se balança et revint brutalement. Deux Orques tombèrent, décapités. Les autres s'enfuirent. »

fields.title: La Miglior Compagnia
fields.lore: “Un'ascia oscillò e cadde. Due Orchi piombarono a terra decapitati. Gli altri fuggirono.”

cards.title: Come Here Lad
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Stack the top 2 cards from your draw deck on a [DWARVEN] condition that has a card already stacked on it.
cards.lore: “‘You are the canniest, luckiest, most reckless fool I've ever met! Bless you.'”

fields.title: Come Here Lad
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Stack the top 2 cards from your draw deck on a [DWARVEN] condition that has a card already stacked on it.
fields.lore: “‘You are the canniest, luckiest, most reckless fool I've ever met! Bless you.'”

fields.title: Komm her, Bursche!
fields.lore: "Du bist der schlauste, sorgloseste und närrischste Glückspilz, der mir je untergekommen ist. Sei gesegnet.“

fields.title: Ven Aquí Muchacho
fields.lore: “¡Eres el loco más temerario, astuto y con suerte que jamás he encontrado! Bendito seas.”

fields.title: Venez Ici Jeune Homme
fields.lore: « “Vous êtes le plus rusé, le plus chanceux, le plus insouciant fou que j'aie jamais rencontré. Soyez béni.” »

fields.title: Vieni Qui Amico
fields.lore: “‘Sei il più scaltro, fortunato, imprudente pazzo che io abbia mai incontrato! Che tu sia benedetto.'”

cards.title: Courtesy of My Hall
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, stack a card from your discard pile here. Fellowship: Discard a Free Peoples card stacked here to heal a Dwarf.
cards.lore: “‘Now my guests, come!... Come and take such refreshment as haste allows.'”

fields.title: Courtesy of My Hall
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. When you play this condition, stack a card from your discard pile here. Fellowship: Discard a Free Peoples card stacked here to heal a Dwarf.
fields.lore: “‘Now my guests, come!... Come and take such refreshment as haste allows.'”

fields.title: Gastfreundschaft meines Hauses
fields.lore: "Nun, meine Gäste, kommt!... Kommt und nehmt das an Erfrischungen zu euch, was die Eile erlaubt.“

fields.title: La Hospitalidad De Mi Castillo
fields.lore: “¡Y ahora, mis invitados, venid!... Venid y reparad fuerzas mientras la prisa nos lo permita.”

fields.title: La Courtoisie de mon Château
fields.lore: « “Et maintenant, mes hôtes, venez!... Venez vous rafraîchir autant que la hâte le permet.” »

fields.title: La Cortesia Nel Mio Palazzo
fields.lore: “‘Ed ora, ospiti miei, venite!... Venite a prendere quel poco di ristoro concessoci dalla fretta.'”

cards.title: Dwarven Foresight
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf to take a Free Peoples card stacked on a [DWARVEN] condition into hand.
cards.lore: “‘I would guess that the burned bones of the hobbits are now mingled with the Orcs'.'”

fields.title: Dwarven Foresight
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf to take a Free Peoples card stacked on a [DWARVEN] condition into hand.
fields.lore: “‘I would guess that the burned bones of the hobbits are now mingled with the Orcs'.'”

fields.title: Voraussicht eines Zwergs
fields.lore: "Ich vermute, die verbrannten Knochen der Hobbits sind jetzt vermengt mit denen der Orks.“

fields.title: Visión Enana
fields.lore: “Apostaría a que los huesos quemados de los hobbits están mezclados con los de los orcos.”

fields.title: Prévoyance Naine
fields.lore: « “J'ai l'impression que les os calcinés des Hobbits sont à présent mêlés à ceux des Orques.” »

fields.title: Lungimiranza dei Nani
fields.lore: “‘Suppongo che le ceneri degli Hobbit siano ormai confuse con quelle degli Orchi.'”

fields.title: Immer geht mir das Herz auf
El Corazón Siempre Se Me Anima
Il Mio Cuore si Rinfranca Sempre

cards.title: From the Armory
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Exert a Dwarf and stack a Free Peoples card from hand here to prevent all wounds to that Dwarf.
cards.lore: “‘It's a bit tight around the chest.'”

fields.lore: “‘It's a bit tight around the chest.'”

fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Exert a Dwarf and stack a Free Peoples card from hand here to make that Dwarf unable to take wounds.

fields.title: Aus der Waffenkammer
fields.lore: "Es spannt ein wenig um die Brust.“

fields.title: De La Armería
fields.lore: “Está un poco ajustado alrededor del pecho.”

fields.title: De l'Armurerie
fields.lore: « “C'est un peu serré autour de la poitrine.” »

fields.title: Dall'Armeria
fields.lore: “‘E' un po' stretta sul torace.'”

cards.title: Gimli
cards.subtitle: Lockbearer
cards.gameText: Damage +1. Gimli is strength +1 for each unbound Hobbit companion you can spot.
cards.lore: “‘You speak evil of that which is fair beyond the reach of your thought, and only little wit can excuse you.'”

fields.title: Gimli
fields.subtitle: Lockbearer
fields.gameText: Damage +1. Gimli is strength +1 for each unbound Hobbit companion you can spot.
fields.lore: “‘You speak evil of that which is fair beyond the reach of your thought, and only little wit can excuse you.'”

fields.subtitle: Lockenträger
fields.lore: "Ihr sprecht schlecht von dem, was schöner ist, als Ihr Euch vorzustellen vermögt, und nur geringer Verstand kann Euch entschuldigen.“

fields.subtitle: Portador del Rizo
fields.lore: “Habla mal de lo que es hermoso más allá de tus posibilidades de comprensión y sólo el poco entendimiento podría excusarte.”

fields.subtitle: Porteur de Boucle
fields.lore: « “Vous parlez en mal de ce qui est d'une beauté qui dépasse vos capacités de pensée, et seul peut vous excuser votre peu d'entendement.” »

fields.subtitle: Portatore della Ciocca
fields.lore: “‘Parli con malvagità di ciò ch'è bello più di quanto tu non possa immaginare, e la tua unica scusa è la poca intelligenza.'”

cards.title: Gimli
cards.subtitle: Unbidden Guest
cards.gameText: Damage +1. Skirmish: Exert Gimli to make an unbound companion strength +1 (or +2 if that companion is Legolas).
cards.lore: “But a small dark figure that none had observed sprang out of the shadows and gave a hoarse shout: Baruk Khazâd!”

fields.title: Gimli
fields.subtitle: Unbidden Guest
fields.gameText: Damage +1. Skirmish: Exert Gimli to make an unbound companion strength +1 (or +2 if that companion is Legolas).
fields.lore: “But a small dark figure that none had observed sprang out of the shadows and gave a hoarse shout: Baruk Khazâd!”

fields.subtitle: Ungebetener Gast
fields.lore: Doch eine kleine, dunkle Gestalt, die niemand bemerkt hatte, sprang aus dem Schatten hervor und stieß einen heiseren Schrei aus: Baruk Khazâd!

fields.subtitle: Invitado Espontáneo
fields.lore: “Pero una pequeña figura negra en la que nadie había reparado emergió de las sombras lanzando un grito ronco: ¡Baruk Khazâd!”

fields.subtitle: Hôte Non Invité
fields.lore: « Mais une petite forme noire que personne n'avait remarquée s'élança hors de l'ombre, poussant un cri rauque: Barouk Khazâd! »

fields.subtitle: Ospite Non Invitato
fields.lore: “Ma una piccola figura scura che nessuno aveva notato sbucò dalle ombre con un roco grido: Baruk Khazâd!”

cards.title: Here Is Good Rock
cards.gameText: Tale. Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Stack a Free Peoples card from hand here to make a Dwarf damage +1.
cards.lore: “‘Give me a year and a hundred of my kin and I would make this a place that armies would break upon like water.'”

fields.title: Here Is Good Rock
fields.gameText: Tale. Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Stack a Free Peoples card from hand here to make a Dwarf damage +1.
fields.lore: “‘Give me a year and a hundred of my kin and I would make this a place that armies would break upon like water.'”

fields.title: Das ist guter Felsen hier
fields.lore: "Gib mir ein Jahr Zeit und hundert Mann von meiner Sippe, und ich würde daraus eine Festung machen, an der sich Heere wie Wellen brechen würden.“

fields.title: Aquí Hay Buena Roca
fields.lore: “Dadme un año y un centenar de los de mi raza y haré de este lugar un baluarte donde los ejércitos se estrellarán como un oleaje.”

fields.title: Ceci est du Bon Roc
fields.lore: « “Qu'on me donne un an et une centaine des miens, et je ferais de ceci un endroit sur lequel les armées se briseraient comme de l'eau.” »

fields.title: Ecco della Buona Roccia
fields.lore: “‘In cento e un anno della mia razza farei di questo posto una rocca contro la quale gli eserciti si infrangerebbero come flutti.'”

cards.title: Khazâd Ai-mênu
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or strength +3 and damage +1 if you spot Legolas).
cards.lore: “‘The Orcs are behind the wall. Ai-oi! Come, Legolas! There are enough for both of us.'”

"Die Orks sind hinter dem Wall. Ai-oi! Komm, Legolas! Es sind genug für uns beide.”
“¡Los orcos están detrás del muro! ¡Ai-oi! Ven aquí, Legolas. ¡Hay bastante para los dos!”

fields.title: Khazâd Ai-Mênou
fields.lore: « “Les Orques sont derrière le mur. Ai-oi! Par ici, Legolas! Il y a assez à faire pour deux.” »
“‘Gli Orchi sono all'interno delle mura. Ai-oi! Vieni, Legolas! C'è n'è a sufficienza per ambedue.'”

cards.title: Quick As May Be
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Spot a Dwarf companion and an Elf companion to wound a minion.
cards.lore: “‘I think, nonetheless, that we no longer need any trail to tell us which way to go.'”

fields.title: Quick As May Be
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Spot a Dwarf companion and an Elf companion to wound a minion.
fields.lore: “‘I think, nonetheless, that we no longer need any trail to tell us which way to go.'”

fields.title: So rasch als möglich
fields.lore: "Dennoch glaube ich, dass wir nicht länger eine Spur brauchen, die uns sagt, welchen Weg wir gehen sollen.“

fields.title: Tan Rápido Como Sea Posible
fields.lore: “Pienso, sin embargo, que ya no necesitamos de ninguna huella que nos diga qué camino hemos de tomar.”

fields.title: Aussi Vite Que Possible
fields.lore: « “Je pense en tout cas que nous n'avons plus besoin d'une piste pour nous dire de quel côté aller...” »

fields.title: Il Più Veloce Possibile
fields.lore: “‘Credo comunque che non abbiamo più bisogno di orme che ci indichino la via.'”

cards.title: Rest by Blind Night
cards.gameText: Regroup: Shuffle any number of [DWARVEN] conditions (and all cards stacked on them) into your draw deck.
cards.lore: “‘And yet even I, Dwarf of many journeys... cannot run all the way to Isengard without any pause....'”

fields.title: Rest by Blind Night
fields.gameText: Regroup: Shuffle any number of [DWARVEN] conditions (and all cards stacked on them) into your draw deck.
fields.lore: “‘And yet even I, Dwarf of many journeys... cannot run all the way to Isengard without any pause....'”

fields.title: Rast in schwarzer Nacht
fields.lore: "Doch selbst ich, Zwerg vieler Wanderungen... kann nicht den ganzen Weg nach Isengart ohne Rast zurücklegen.“

fields.title: Descanso En La Noche Oscura
fields.lore: “Y sin embargo yo mismo, enano de muchos viajes... no podría ir corriendo hasta Isengard sin hacer una pausa...”

fields.title: Repos Durant la Nuit Aveugle
fields.lore: « “Et pourtant même moi, Nain rompu aux voyages... je ne puis faire tout le trajet jusqu'à l'Isengard sans aucune pause...” »

fields.title: Riposo nel Buio della Notte
fields.lore: “‘Ma persino io, Nano che ha viaggiato... non potrò mai percorrere senza riposare tutta la strada sino a Isengard...'”

cards.title: Restless Axe
cards.gameText: Regroup: Exert a Dwarf to shuffle a [DWARVEN] condition (and all cards stacked on it) into your draw deck. Exert a minion for each card shuffled into your draw deck.
cards.lore: “‘Give me a row of orc-necks and room to swing and all weariness will fall from me!'”

fields.title: Restless Axe

fields.lore: “‘Give me a row of orc-necks and room to swing and all weariness will fall from me!'”

fields.title: Ruhelose Axt
fields.lore: "Gib mir eine Reihe Orknacken und Platz zum Ausholen, und alle Müdigkeit wird von mir abfallen!“

fields.title: Hacha Incansable
fields.lore: “¡Dadme una hilera de cabezas de Orcos y espacio suficiente para blandir el hacha y todo mi cansancio desaparecerá!”

fields.title: Hache Fébrile
fields.lore: « “Qu'on me donne une rangée de têtes d'Orques et la place de me balancer, et toute fatigue m'abandonnera!” »

fields.title: Ascia Instancabile
fields.lore: “‘Datemi una fila di Orchi e un po' di spazio per prendere lo slancio, ed ogni stanchezza scomparirà dalle mie membra!'”

cards.title: Search Far and Wide
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf and discard the top card of your draw deck to draw 2 cards.
cards.lore: “‘We have been set many riddles since we came to Tol Brandir, but this is the hardest to unravel.'”

fields.title: Search Far and Wide

fields.lore: “‘We have been set many riddles since we came to Tol Brandir, but this is the hardest to unravel.'”

fields.title: Weit und breit absuchen
fields.lore: "Uns sind viele Rätsel aufgegeben worden, seit wir zum Tol Brandir kamen, aber dies hier ist am schwersten zu lösen.“

fields.title: Buscar A Lo Largo Y A Lo Ancho
fields.lore: “Hemos tropezado con muchos enigmas desde que llegamos a Tol Brandir, pero este es el más difícil de descifrar.”

fields.title: Inspection de Tous Côtés
fields.lore: « “Nous nous sommes trouvés devant bien des énigmes depuis notre arrivée à Tol Brandir, mais celle-ci est la plus difficile à déchiffrer.” »

fields.title: Cercare in Lungo e in Largo
fields.lore: “‘Ci siamo trovati innanzi a molti enigmi da quando arrivammo a Tol Brandir, ma questo è il più arduo da risolvere.'”

cards.title: Stout and Strong
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time a Dwarf wins a skirmish, you may place a [DWARVEN] token on this card. Skirmish: Make an unbound companion strength +1 for each [DWARVEN] token here (limit +3). Discard this condition.
cards.lore: “‘Never did I see an axe so wielded.'”

fields.title: Stout and Strong

fields.lore: “‘Never did I see an axe so wielded.'”

fields.title: Beherzt und stark
fields.lore: "Nie habe ich eine Axt gesehen, die so geschwungen wurde.“

fields.title: Recio Y Fuerte
fields.lore: “Nunca vi un hacha en manos tan hábiles.”

fields.title: Vaillant et Fort
fields.lore: « “Jamais je n'ai vu de hache si bien maniée.” »

fields.title: Forte e Robusto
fields.lore: “‘Non ho mai visto adoperare tanto un'ascia!'”

cards.title: Alliance Reforged
cards.gameText: Tale. Fellowship: Draw a card for each Elf companion you spot.
cards.lore: “‘If we do not trust the strength of Men, then we trust to the victory of Sauron.'”

fields.title: Alliance Reforged

fields.lore: “‘If we do not trust the strength of Men, then we trust to the victory of Sauron.'”

fields.title: Das Bündnis neu geschmiedet
fields.lore: "Wenn wir uns nicht auf die Kraft der Menschen verlassen, dann hat Sauron bereits gewonnen.“

fields.title: Alianza Reforjada
fields.lore: “Si no confiamos en la fuerza de los Hombres, entonces confiamos en la victoria de Sauron.”

fields.title: Alliance Reforgée
fields.lore: « “Si nous n'avons pas confiance en la force des Hommes, nous avons confiance en la victoire de Sauron.” »

fields.title: Alleanza Riformata
fields.lore: “‘Se non possiamo confidare nella forza degli Uomini, allora Sauron vincerà.'”

cards.title: Arrow and Blade

cards.lore: The Elven bow and the sword of Man fought together as one weapon.

fields.title: Bogen und Schwert
fields.lore: Die Bögen der Elben und die Schwerter der Menschen kämpften zusammen wie eine einzige Waffe.

fields.title: Hoja Y Flecha
fields.lore: El arco Élfico y la espada del Hombre lucharon juntos como una sola arma.

fields.title: Lame et Flèche
fields.lore: L'arc elfique et l'épée de l'Homme combattirent comme une seule arme.

fields.title: Freccia e Lama
fields.lore: L'arco degli Elfi e la spada dell'Uomo combatterono insieme come una sola arma.

fields.title: Hojas Desenvainadas
fields.lore: La habilidad con la espada de los arqueros Élficos era inesperada.

fields.title: Épées Tirées
fields.lore: Personne ne s'attend à une telle adresse à l'épée chez les archers Elfes.

fields.title: Lame Sguainate
fields.lore: L'abilità con la spada degli arcieri elfici era sorprendente.

fields.title: Compañía De Arqueros

fields.title: Compagnie d'Archers

fields.title: Compagnia di Arcieri

fields.title: Elbenbrosche

fields.title: Broche Élfico
fields.lore: “Las hojas de Lórien no caen inútilmente.”

fields.title: Broche Elfique
fields.lore: « “ Ce n'est pas inutilement que tombent les feuilles de Lórien.” »

fields.title: Spilla Elfica
fields.lore: “‘Non cadono inutilmente le foglie di Lórien.'”

fields.title: Espada Élfica
fields.lore: Estupendas hojas forjadas por los herreros Élficos son herencias centenarias.

fields.title: Épée Elfique
fields.lore: Les lames de qualité, forgées par des artisans Elfes, sont des héritages centenaires.

fields.title: Spada Elfica
fields.lore: Le ottime lame forgiate dai fabbri elfici sono cimeli antichi di secoli.

fields.subtitle: Leutnant aus Naith
fields.lore: Selbst auf kürzeste Distanz ist Erethóns Treffsicherheit unheimlich.

fields.subtitle: Lugarteniente de Naith
fields.lore: Incluso a corta distancia, la puntería de Erethon es increíble.

fields.subtitle: Lieutenant Naith
fields.lore: Même à courte portée, la précision d'Erethón est étonnante.

fields.subtitle: Luogotenente del Naith
fields.lore: Anche a distanza ravvicinata, la mira di Erethón è incredibile.

cards.title: Feathered

fields.lore: Elven swords found the same targets as their arrows.

fields.title: Gefiedert
fields.lore: Die Schwerter der Elben fanden die gleichen Ziele wie ihre Pfeile.

fields.title: Emplumado
fields.lore: Las espadas Élficas encontraron los mismos blancos que sus flechas.

fields.title: Empenné
fields.lore: Les lames des Elfes trouvèrent les mêmes cibles que leurs flèches.

fields.title: Frecce Piumate
fields.lore: Le spade elfiche trovarono gli stessi bersagli delle loro frecce.

fields.subtitle: Sohn des Thandronen
fields.lore: Thandronens Söhne patrouillieren gemeinsam an den Grenzen Lóriens.

fields.subtitle: Hijo de Thandronen
fields.lore: Los hijos de Thandronen patrullan juntos las fronteras de Lórien.

fields.subtitle: Fils de Thandronen
fields.lore: Les fils de Thandronen patrouillent les frontières de la Lorien ensemble.

fields.subtitle: Figlio di Thandronen
fields.lore: I figli di Thandronen pattugliano insieme i confini di Lórien.

cards.title: Ferevellon

cards.lore: The Uruks at Helm's Deep fell to his blade as easily as Goblins from the mountains.

fields.subtitle: Sohn des Thandronen
fields.lore: In Helms Klamm fielen die Uruks unter den Hieben seines Schwertes genauso leicht wie Goblins aus den Bergen.

fields.subtitle: Hijo de Thandronen
fields.lore: Los Uruks en el Abismo de Helm cayeron bajo su espada tan fácilmente como los Goblins de las montañas.

fields.subtitle: Fils de Thandronen
fields.lore: Les Ourouks au Gouffre de Helm tombèrent sous sa lame aussi facilement que les Goblins des montagnes.

fields.subtitle: Figlio di Thandronen
fields.lore: Gli Uruk al Fosso di Helm cadevano sotto la sua lama facilmente, come i Goblin delle montagne.

cards.lore: “‘Good!... But my count is now two dozen. It has been knife-work up here.'”

fields.title: Flashing Steel

fields.lore: “‘Good!... But my count is now two dozen. It has been knife-work up here.'”

fields.title: Blitzender Stahl
fields.lore: "Gut! Aber meine Rechnung beträgt jetzt zwei Dutzend. Es war Messerarbeit hier oben.“

fields.title: Acero Reluciente
fields.lore: “¡Magnífico!... Pero ahora mi cuenta asciende a dos docenas. Aquí arriba han trabajado los puñales.”

fields.title: Acier Virevoltant
fields.lore: « “Bon! Mais moi j'en suis maintenant à deux douzaines. Ç'a été une lutte au couteau, ici.” »

fields.title: Acciaio Scintillante
fields.lore: “‘Bene!... Ma io ora sono a due dozzine. Il pugnale ha avuto da fare quassù.'”

cards.lore: “‘In days of old, my people stood beside the King of Gondor – we come to honor that allegiance.'”

fields.subtitle: Gesandter der Galadhrim
fields.lore: "Bereits in den alten Zeiten kämpfte mein Volk an der Seite des Königs von Gondor – wir sind hier, dieses Bündnis zu ehren.“

fields.subtitle: Emisario de los Galadrim
fields.lore: “Antaño, mi pueblo estaba junto al Rey de Gondor – hemos venido para honrar esa lealtad.”

fields.subtitle: Émissaire des Galadhrim
fields.lore: « “Par les jours anciens, mon peuple soutenait le Roi du Gondor – nous venons pour faire honneur à cette fidélité.” »

fields.subtitle: Emissario dei Galadhrim
fields.lore: “‘Nei giorni antichi, la mia gente stava al fianco del Re di Gondor; abbiamo onorato tale alleanza.'”

cards.lore: The courage of the defenders blunted the Uruk assaults.

fields.title: Blutgetränkter Boden
fields.lore: Durch den Mut der Verteidiger gerieten die Angriffe der Uruks mehr und mehr ins Wanken.

fields.title: Campo De Matanza
fields.lore: El coraje de los defensores acabó con los asaltos de los Uruks.

fields.title: Champ Meutrier
fields.lore: Le courage des défenseurs émoussa les assauts Ourouks.

fields.title: Luogo di Morte
fields.lore: Il coraggio dei difensori smorzò gli assalti degli Uruk.

fields.subtitle: Unermüdlicher Jäger
fields.lore: "Sie sind weit, weit fort.... Ich weiß in meinem Herzen, dass sie in dieser Nacht nicht gerastet haben.“

fields.subtitle: Cazador Intrépìdo
fields.lore: “Están de veras muy lejos... El corazón me dice que no han descansado esta noche.”

fields.subtitle: Chasseur Intrépide
fields.lore: « “Ils sont très, très loin... Je sais dans mon c*ur qu'il n'ont pris aucun repos cette nuit.” »

fields.subtitle: Cacciatore Intrepido
fields.lore: “‘Sono molto molto lontani... il cuore mi dice che non si sono concessi alcun riposo questa notte.'”

cards.title: Legolas

cards.lore: “‘Come, you shall sit behind me, friend Gimli.'”

fields.subtitle: Elbischer Kamerad
fields.lore: "Komm, du sollst hinter mir sitzen, Freund Gimli.“

fields.subtitle: Camarada Élfico
fields.lore: “Vamos, te sentarás detrás de mí, amigo Gimli.”

fields.subtitle: Camarade Elfe
fields.lore: « “Allons, tu t'assiéras derrière moi, ami Gimli...” »

fields.subtitle: Amico Elfico
fields.lore: “‘Suvvia, siederai dietro di me, amico Gimli.'”

fields.title: Lórien Es Bienvenido

fields.title: La Lórien est la Bienvenue

fields.title: Lórien è la Benvenuta

fields.title: Espadachín De Lórien
fields.lore: Largo y curvado acero Élfico segó a los Uruks ya debilitados por las flechas Élficas.

fields.title: Épéiste de la Lórien
fields.lore: L'acier elfique, long et recourbé, terrassait les Ourouks déjà affaiblis par les flèches des Elfes.

fields.title: Spadaccino di Lórien
fields.lore: Il lungo e curvo acciaio elfico abbatté gli Uruk già indeboliti dalle loro frecce.

fields.title: Nacht ohne Ende

fields.title: Noche Sin Fin
fields.lore: “Quisiera que la noche terminase de una vez, así tendría mejor luz para tomar puntería.”

fields.title: Une Nuit Interminable
fields.lore: « “... si cette nuit pouvait se terminer, que j'aie une meilleure lumière pour mon tir!” »

fields.title: Notte senza Fine
fields.lore: “‘Se almeno questa notte finisse, e io potessi finalmente avere una luce migliore per tirare.'”

fields.title: Fuerza De Las Armas
fields.lore: Las armas Élficas fueron más que un reto para los Uruk.

fields.title: La Force Par les Armes
fields.lore: Les armes elfiques étaient bien évidemment à la hauteur des Ourouks.

fields.title: Forza delle Armi
fields.lore: Le armi elfiche furono più di una sfida per gli Uruk.

fields.title: Tir de Soutien

fields.title: Fuoco di Supporto

fields.title: Muro De Espadas

fields.title: Mur d'Épées
fields.lore: Une ferme ligne de lames elfiques peut arrêter un grand nombre d'hordes de l'Ennemi.

fields.title: Muro di Spade

fields.subtitle: Protettore Veterano

Un Elfo evita tomar las armas, pero una vez resuelto en la lucha, su voluntad es inquebrantable.

fields.title: Bravoure
fields.lore: Un Elfe évite de prendre les armes, mais une fois engagé au combat, sa volonté est sans faille.

fields.title: Coraggio
fields.lore: Gli Elfi evitano di impugnare le armi, ma una volta impegnati nella lotta la loro volontà è ferrea.

fields.title: Contemplad Al Jinete Blanco
fields.lore: “Gandalf ha vuelto.”

fields.title: Voilà le Cavalier Blanc
fields.lore: « “Gandalf est revenu!” »

fields.title: Mirate il Bianco Cavaliere
fields.lore: “‘Gandalf è ritornato!'”

fields.subtitle: Graurock

fields.subtitle: Capagrís
fields.lore: “¡Peligroso!... Y yo también lo soy, muy peligroso, más peligroso que cualquier otra cosa que hayáis encontrado hasta ahora...”

fields.subtitle: Maisongrise
fields.lore: « “Dangereux! ... Et moi aussi je le suis, très dangereux même: plus dangereux que tout ce que vous rencontrerez jamais...” »

fields.subtitle: Grigiomanto
fields.lore: “‘Pericoloso! Anch'io lo sono, estremamente pericoloso: più pericoloso di qualunque cosa tu possa mai incontrare...'”

cards.title: Gandalf

fields.subtitle: Der Weiße
fields.lore: "Siehe, ich bin nicht Gandalf der Graue, den du betrogen hast. Ich bin Gandalf der Weiße, der vom Tode zurückgekehrt ist.“

fields.subtitle: El Mago Blanco
fields.lore: “¡Mírame! No soy Gandalf el Gris a quien tú traicionaste. Soy Gandalf el Blanco que ha regresado de la muerte.”

fields.subtitle: Le Magicien Blanc
fields.lore: « “Voyez! je ne suis pas Gandalf le Gris, que vous avez trahi. Je suis Gandalf le Blanc, qui est revenu de la mort.” »

fields.subtitle: Lo Stregone Bianco
fields.lore: “‘Osserva, io non sono Gandalf il Grigio che tu tradisti. Sono Gandalf il Bianco, ritornato dalla morte.'”

cards.title: Gandalf's Staff

fields.title: Gandalfs Stab
fields.subtitle: Eine Gehstütze
fields.lore: "Der Stab in der Hand eines Zauberers mag mehr sein als eine Hilfe für das Alter.“

fields.title: La Vara De Gandalf
fields.subtitle: Bastón de Andar
fields.lore: “Esa vara en manos de un mago puede ser algo más que un simple báculo...”

fields.title: Le Bâton de Gandalf
fields.subtitle: Bâton de Marche
fields.lore: « “Le bâton entre les mains d'un magicien peut-être plus qu'un simple soutien pour la vieillesse...” »

fields.title: Bastone di Gandalf
fields.subtitle: Bastone da Passeggio
fields.lore: “‘Il bastone nelle mani di uno stregone potrebbe essere più di un semplice sostegno...'”

cards.title: Grown Suddenly Tall

fields.title: Plötzlich groß geworden
fields.lore: Seine Kapuze und die grauen Lumpen warf er ab. Sein weißes Gewand schimmerte.

fields.title: Crecido De Repente
fields.lore: “Había dejado caer la capucha y los harapos grises, y ahora la vestidura blanca centelleaba.”

fields.title: Une Stature Soudain Accrue
fields.lore: « “Il avait rejeté son capuchon et ses haillons gris, et ses vêtements blancs étincelaient.” »

fields.title: Si Eresse Improvvisamente
fields.lore: “‘Il cappuccio e gli stracci grigi giacevano in terra, e le bianche vesti brillavano.'”

cards.title: Have Patience
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Spot Gandalf to heal an unbound companion twice.
cards.lore: “‘Go where you must go, and hope!'”

fields.title: Have Patience
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Spot Gandalf to heal an unbound companion twice.
fields.lore: “‘Go where you must go, and hope!'”

fields.title: Habt Geduld
fields.lore: "Geht, wohin ihr gehen müsst, und hofft!“

fields.title: Ten Paciencia
fields.lore: “Id a donde tenéis que ir, ¡y confiad!”

fields.title: Prenez Patience
fields.lore: « “Allez où vous devez aller et espérez!” »

fields.title: Abbi Pazienza
fields.lore: “‘Vai dove devi andare, e spera!'”

cards.title: Hearken to Me

cards.lore: “‘Not all is dark. Take courage, Lord of the Mark; for better help you will not find.'”

fields.lore: “‘Not all is dark. Take courage, Lord of the Mark; for better help you will not find.'”

fields.title: Hört auf mich!
fields.lore: "Nicht alles ist dunkel. Fasst Mut, Herr der Mark; denn bessere Hilfe werdet ihr nicht finden.“

fields.title: Escúchame
fields.lore: “No todo es oscuridad. Tened valor, Señor de la Marca, pues mejor ayuda no encontraréis.”

fields.title: Écoutez-Moi!
fields.lore: « “Tout n'est pas sombre. Prenez courage, Seigneur de la Marche, car vous ne sauriez trouver de meilleure assistance.” »

fields.title: Ascoltami
fields.lore: “‘Non tutto è oscuro. Abbi fede, Signore del Mark, perché non troverai aiuto migliore.'”

cards.title: Into Dark Tunnels
cards.gameText: Spell. Response: If you play a [GANDALF] event, exert Gandalf twice to place that event in your hand instead of your discard pile.
cards.lore: “‘Even Sauron knows them not. They are older than he. Now I have walked there, but I will bring no report to darken the light of day.'”

fields.lore: “‘Even Sauron knows them not. They are older than he. Now I have walked there, but I will bring no report to darken the light of day.'”

fields.title: In dunkle Gänge
fields.lore: "Selbst Sauron kennt sie nicht. Sie sind älter als er. Nun bin ich dort gewandert, doch ich will nicht darüber berichten, um das Licht des Tages nicht zu verdunkeln.“

fields.title: En Túneles Oscuros
fields.lore: “Ni siquiera Sauron las conoce. Son más viejas que él. Recorrí esos caminos, pero nada diré que oscurezca la luz del día.”

fields.title: Dans de Noirs Tunnels
fields.lore: « “Même Sauron ne les connaît pas. Elles sont plus vieilles que lui. J'y ai marché, mais je n'en ferai aucun récit qui enténébrerait la lumière du jour.” »

fields.title: Nei Tunnel Oscuri
fields.lore: “‘Persino Sauron non li conosce. Essi sono più vecchi di lui.'”

cards.title: Keep Your Forked Tongue

cards.lore: “‘A witless worm you have become.'”

fields.lore: “‘A witless worm you have become.'”

fields.title: Hütet Eure gespaltene Zunge
fields.lore: "Eine einfältige Schlange seid Ihr geworden.“

fields.title: Guardate Tu Lengua Bífida
fields.lore: “Te has convertido en un gusano estúpido.”

fields.title: Garde ta Langue Fourchue
fields.lore: « “Tu es devenu un serpent sans intelligence.” »

fields.title: Ferma La Tua Lingua Biforcuta
fields.lore: “‘Sei diventato un verme dissennato.'”
