fields.title: Lange Zeit fiel ich
fields.lore: "Sein Feuer war um mich. Es verbrannte mich.“

fields.title: Mucho Tiempo Caí
fields.lore: “El fuego de él me envolvía, quemándome.”

fields.title: Je Suis Tombé Longtemps
fields.lore: « “Son feu m'environnait. J'étais brûlé.” »

fields.title: A Lungo Caddi
fields.lore: “‘Il suo fuoco mi avvolgeva. Avvampai.'”

cards.title: Mithrandir, Mithrandir!
cards.gameText: Spell. Maneuver: Exert Gandalf to wound each minion who has strength of 6 or less.
cards.lore: “The wild men fell on their faces before him.”

fields.title: Mithrandir, Mithrandir!
fields.gameText: Spell. Maneuver: Exert Gandalf to wound each minion who has strength of 6 or less.
fields.lore: “The wild men fell on their faces before him.”
Die wilden Menschen fielen vor ihm auf den Boden.

fields.title: ¡Mithrandir, Mithrandir!
fields.lore: “Los salvajes montañeses caían de bruces.”
« Les hommes sauvages tombèrent face contre terre. »
“Gli Uomini selvaggi caddero bocconi innanzi a lui.”

cards.title: Roll of Thunder
cards.gameText: Fellowship or Maneuver: Spot Gandalf to discard a Shadow possession or Shadow artifact.
cards.lore: “‘I have not passed through fire and death to bandy crooked words with a serving-man till the lightning falls.'”

fields.title: Roll of Thunder
fields.gameText: Fellowship or Maneuver: Spot Gandalf to discard a Shadow possession or Shadow artifact.
fields.lore: “‘I have not passed through fire and death to bandy crooked words with a serving-man till the lightning falls.'”

fields.title: Roll of Thunder
fields.gameText: Fellowship or Maneuver: Spot Gandalf to discard a Shadow possession or hinder a Shadow artifact.

fields.title: Donnergrollen
fields.lore: "Ich bin nicht durch Feuer und Tod gegangen, um verlogene Worte mit einem Diener zu wechseln, bis der Blitz einschlägt.“

fields.title: Tronido
fields.lore: “No me he salvado de los horrores del fuego y de la muerte para cambiar frases retorcidas con un sirviente hasta que el rayo nos fulmine.”

fields.title: Roulement de Tonnerre
fields.lore: « “Je n'ai pas passé par le feu et la mort pour échanger des paroles malhonnêtes avec un domestique jusqu'à ce que tombe l'éclair.” »

fields.title: Rombo di Tuono
fields.lore: “‘Non ho attraversato fuoco e morte per scambiare parole contorte con un uomo servile sino al cadere del fulmine.'”

cards.title: Shadowfax
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Gandalf. Discard any hand weapon he bears. Gandalf may not bear a hand weapon. At the start of each skirmish involving Gandalf, each minion skirmishing him must exert.
cards.lore: “‘He is the chief of the Mearas, lords of horses....'”

fields.title: Shadowfax
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Gandalf. Discard any hand weapon he bears. Gandalf may not bear a hand weapon. At the start of each skirmish involving Gandalf, each minion skirmishing him must exert.
fields.lore: “‘He is the chief of the Mearas, lords of horses....'”

fields.title: Schattenfell
fields.lore: "Er ist das Haupt der Mearas, der Fürsten unter den Pferden....“

fields.title: Sombragrís
fields.lore: “Es el jefe de los Mearas, señores de los caballos...”

fields.title: Gripoil
fields.lore: « “Il est le chef des Mearas, seigneurs des chevaux...” »

fields.title: Ombromanto
fields.lore: “‘E' il capo dei Mearas, principi dei cavalli...'”

cards.title: Stump and Bramble
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Spot an [ISENGARD] minion and an Ent ally. Until the regroup phase, that ally is damage +2 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.
cards.lore: “‘Many of those trees were my friends... many had voices of their own that are lost for ever now.'”

fields.title: Stump and Bramble
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Spot an [ISENGARD] minion and an Ent ally. Until the regroup phase, that ally is damage +2 and participates in archery fire and skirmishes.
fields.lore: “‘Many of those trees were my friends... many had voices of their own that are lost for ever now.'”

fields.title: Stumpf und Stiel
fields.lore: "Viele dieser Bäume waren meine Freunde... viele hatten eine eigene Stimme, die nun auf immer verstummt ist.“

fields.title: Tocones Y Zarzas
fields.lore: “Muchos de estos árboles eran mis amigos... muchos tenían voces propias que se han perdido para siempre.”

fields.title: Souches et Ronces
fields.lore: « “Bon nombre de ces arbres étaient mes amis... beaucoup avaient des voix à eux, qui sont maintenant perdues à jamais.” »

fields.title: Ceppi e Rovi
fields.lore: “‘Molti di quegli alberi erano amici miei... molti di loro avevano la propria voce, che oramai è muta per sempre.'”

cards.title: Task Was Not Done
cards.gameText: Spell. Regroup: Exert Gandalf to discard up to 2 wounded minions.
cards.lore: “‘Naked I was sent back – for a brief time, until my task is done. And naked I lay upon the mountain-top.'”

fields.title: Task Was Not Done
fields.gameText: Spell. Regroup: Exert Gandalf to discard up to 2 wounded minions.
fields.lore: “‘Naked I was sent back – for a brief time, until my task is done. And naked I lay upon the mountain-top.'”

fields.title: Die Aufgabe ist noch nicht erfüllt
fields.lore: "Nackt wurde ich zurückgeschickt – für eine kurze Zeit, bis meine Aufgabe erfüllt ist. Und nackt lag ich auf dem Berggipfel.“

fields.title: La Tarea No Fue Cumplida
fields.lore: “Desnudo fui enviado de vuelta, durante un tiempo, hasta que llevara a cabo mi trabajo. Y desnudo yací en la cima de la montaña.”

fields.title: La Tâche ne Fut Pas Accomplie
fields.lore: « “Je fus renvoyé nu, pour une brève période, jusqu'à ce que ma tâche soit accomplie. Et nu je restai étendu sur le sommet de la montagne.” »

fields.title: Il Dovere non è Stato Compiuto
fields.lore: “Nudo fui rimandato indietro, ma per un breve tempo, finché il mio compito non fosse concluso. E giacqui nudo in cima alla montagna.”

cards.title: Treebeard
cards.subtitle: Earthborn
cards.gameText: Unhasty. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is about to be discarded, stack him here instead. Fellowship: Exert Treebeard and add(1) to play an unbound Hobbit stacked here.
cards.lore: “‘Do not be hasty, that is my motto.'”

fields.title: Treebeard
fields.subtitle: Earthborn
fields.gameText: Unhasty. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is about to be discarded, stack him here instead. Fellowship: Exert Treebeard and add(1) to play an unbound Hobbit stacked here.
fields.lore: “‘Do not be hasty, that is my motto.'”

fields.title: Baumbart
fields.subtitle: Erdspross
fields.lore: "'Sei nicht hastig' ist mein Wahlspruch.“

fields.title: Bárbol
fields.subtitle: Nacido de la Tierra
fields.lore: “No te apresures, esa es mi divisa.”

fields.title: Sylvebarbe
fields.subtitle: Né de la Terre
fields.lore: « “Pas de jugement hâtif, c'est ma devise.” »

fields.title: Barbalbero
fields.subtitle: Nato dalla Terra
fields.lore: “‘Niente fretta, questo è il mio motto.'”

cards.title: Treebeard
cards.subtitle: Oldest Living Thing
cards.gameText: Unhasty. Fellowship: Exert Treebeard and discard an unbound companion from hand to heal an unbound companion.
cards.lore: “‘No, I am not tired. I do not easily get tired. And I do not sit down. I am not very, hm, bendable.'”

fields.title: Treebeard
fields.subtitle: Oldest Living Thing
fields.gameText: Unhasty. Fellowship: Exert Treebeard and discard an unbound companion from hand to heal an unbound companion.
fields.lore: “‘No, I am not tired. I do not easily get tired. And I do not sit down. I am not very, hm, bendable.'”

fields.title: Baumbart
fields.subtitle: Das älteste lebende Wesen
fields.lore: "Nein, ich bin nicht müde. Ich werde nicht leicht müde. Und ich setze mich nicht hin. Ich bin nicht sehr, hm, biegsam.“

fields.title: Bárbol
fields.subtitle: El Ser Viviente más viejo
fields.lore: “No, no estoy cansado. No me canso fácilmente. Y no tengo costumbre de sentarme. No soy, hm, plegadizo.”

fields.title: Sylvebarbe
fields.subtitle: La Plus Vieille Chose Vivante
fields.lore: « “Non, je ne suis pas fatigué. Je ne me fatigue pas facilement. Et je ne me m'assieds pas. Je ne suis pas très, hem, ployable.” »

fields.title: Barbalbero
fields.subtitle: L'Essere Vivente Più Antico
fields.lore: “‘No, non sono stanco. Non mi stanco facilmente. E non mi siedo mai. Non sono molto, hm, flessibile.'”

cards.title: Under the Living Earth
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make Gandalf strength +1 for each twilight token you spot (limit +5).
cards.lore: “‘Thither I came at last, to the uttermost foundations of stone. He was with me still.'”

fields.title: Under the Living Earth
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make Gandalf strength +1 for each twilight token you spot (limit +5).
fields.lore: “‘Thither I came at last, to the uttermost foundations of stone. He was with me still.'”

fields.title: Unter der lebendigen Erde
fields.lore: "Dorthin kam ich zuletzt, zum äußersten Grund des Gesteins. Er war noch bei mir.“

fields.title: Bajo La Tierra Viviente
fields.lore: “Al fin llegué allí, a las más extremas fundaciones de piedra. Él estaba todavía conmigo.”

fields.title: En Dessous de la Terre Vivante
fields.lore: « “Je finis par y toucher, aux fondements les plus reculés de la pierre. Il était toujours avec moi.” »

fields.title: Nelle Viscere della Terra
fields.lore: ‘Ivi giunsi infine, nelle estreme fondamenta della pietra. E lui era ancora con me.'”

cards.title: Well Met Indeed
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Spot an Elf, a [GONDOR] Man, and a Dwarf to play Gandalf from your dead pile.
cards.lore: “‘And what may you be doing in these parts? An Elf, a Man, and a Dwarf, all clad in elvish fashion.'”

fields.title: Well Met Indeed
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Spot an Elf, a [GONDOR] Man, and a Dwarf to play Gandalf from your dead pile.
fields.lore: “‘And what may you be doing in these parts? An Elf, a Man, and a Dwarf, all clad in elvish fashion.'”

fields.title: Wahrlich gut getroffen
fields.lore: "Und was mögt ihr wohl in dieser Gegend tun? Ein Elb, ein Mensch und ein Zwerg, und alle auf elbische Weise gekleidet.“

fields.title: Bienhallados
fields.lore: “¿Y qué podéis estar haciendo en estas regiones? Un Elfo, un Hombre, y un Enano, todos vestidos a la manera élfica.”

fields.title: Heureuse Rencontre, en Effet
fields.lore: « “Et que faites-vous donc dans cette région? Un Elfe, un Homme et un Nain, tous vêtus à la manière elfique.” »

fields.title: Un Felice Incontro Davvero!
fields.lore: “‘E che cosa potete fare da queste parti? Un Elfo, un Uomo e un Nano vestiti alla maniera elfica.'”

cards.title: Windows in a Stone Wall
cards.gameText: To play, exert an Ent. Plays on that Ent. Response: If an [ISENGARD] minion is killed, discard this condition to reveal the top 10 cards of an opponent's draw deck. Discard 1 Shadow card and 1 Free Peoples card revealed. Your opponent reshuffles that deck.

fields.title: Windows in a Stone Wall
fields.gameText: To play, exert an Ent. Plays on that Ent. Response: If an [ISENGARD] minion is killed, discard this condition to reveal the top 10 cards of an opponent's draw deck. Discard 1 Shadow card and 1 Free Peoples card revealed. Your opponent reshuffles that deck.

fields.title: Ventanas En Un Muro De Piedra
Des Fenêtres Dans un Mur de Pierre
Finestre in un Muro di Pietra

cards.title: Wizardry Indeed
cards.gameText: Maneuver: If you can spot more minions than companions, exert Gandalf to make an opponent discard a minion.
cards.lore: “The hosts of Isengard roared, swaying this way and that, turning from fear to fear.”

fields.title: Wizardry Indeed
fields.gameText: Maneuver: If you can spot more minions than companions, exert Gandalf to make an opponent discard a minion.
fields.lore: “The hosts of Isengard roared, swaying this way and that, turning from fear to fear.”

fields.title: Wahrlich Zauberei
fields.lore: Die Heere Isengarts schrieen, lenkten ihre Schritte hierhin und dorthin und fielen von einem Schrecken in den anderen.

fields.title: Verdaderamente Hechicería
fields.lore: “Las huestes de Isengard aullaron, yendo de un lado a otro, pasando de un miedo a otro.”

fields.title: C'Est Assurément de la Magie
fields.lore: « “Les armées de l'Isengard rugirent, oscillant d'un côté et d'un autre, passant d'une peur à une autre. “ »

fields.title: Stregoneria, Davvero!
fields.lore: “‘L'esercito di Isengard ruggì, vacillante e ondeggiante, perché ovunque si volgesse lo fronteggiava il terrore.'”

cards.title: Aragorn
cards.subtitle: Heir of Elendil
cards.gameText: Defender +1.
cards.lore: “‘Sauron fears you, Aragorn, he fears what you may become.'”

fields.title: Aragorn
fields.subtitle: Heir of Elendil
fields.gameText: Defender +1.
fields.lore: “‘Sauron fears you, Aragorn, he fears what you may become.'”

fields.subtitle: Elendils Erbe
fields.lore: "Sauron fürchtet dich, Aragorn, er fürchtet, was aus dir werden könnte.“

fields.subtitle: Heredero de Elendil
fields.lore: “Sauron te teme, Aragorn, teme en lo que te puedes llegar a convertir.”

fields.subtitle: Héritier d'Elendil
fields.lore: « “Sauron te craint, Aragorn, Il craint ce que tu pourrais devenir.” »

fields.subtitle: Erede di Elendil
fields.lore: “‘Sauron ti teme, Aragorn, teme ciò che puoi diventare.'”

cards.title: Arrows Thick in the Air
cards.gameText: Archery or Skirmish: Exert 2 Ring-bound Men to wound each roaming minion.
cards.lore: “He came to rest in the fern a few feet away, face downward, green arrow-feathers sticking from his neck below a golden collar.”

fields.title: Arrows Thick in the Air
fields.gameText: Archery or Skirmish: Exert 2 Ring-bound Men to wound each roaming minion.
fields.lore: “He came to rest in the fern a few feet away, face downward, green arrow-feathers sticking from his neck below a golden collar.”

fields.title: Viele Pfeile in der Luft
fields.lore: Er blieb in dem Farn ein paar Fuß entfernt liegen, das Gesicht nach unten, und grüngefiederte Pfeile staken unter einem goldenen Kragen in seinem Hals.

fields.title: Las Flechas Llenan El Aire
fields.lore: “Cayó de bruces en el helechal, a pocos pies de distancia; unos penachos verdes le sobresalían del cuello por debajo de la gola de oro.”

fields.title: Volée de Flèches Drue
fields.lore: « “... il resta face contre terre, des plumes de flèches vertes saillant de son cou sous un col doré.” »

fields.title: Fitta Pioggia di Frecce
fields.lore: “‘Giacque immobile nelle felci a pochi passi di distanza, bocconi, con frecce dalle verdi piume che gli trafiggevano il collo appena più in basso del collare d'oro.'”

cards.title: Boromir, My Brother
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Faramir. Skirmish: Discard a [GONDOR] card from hand to make a Ringbound Man strength +1.
cards.lore: “‘Where is thy horn? Whither goest thou? O Boromir! But he was gone.'”

fields.title: Boromir, My Brother
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Faramir. Skirmish: Discard a [GONDOR] card from hand to make a Ringbound Man strength +1.
fields.lore: “‘Where is thy horn? Whither goest thou? O Boromir! But he was gone.'”

fields.title: Boromir, Mein Bruder
fields.lore: "Wo ist dein Horn? Wohin gehst du? O Boromir! Doch er war fort.“

fields.title: Boromir, Hermano Mío
fields.lore: “¿Dónde está tu cuerno? ¿A dónde vas? ¡Oh Boromir! Pero ya no estaba.”

fields.title: Boromir, Mon Frère
fields.lore: « “Où est ton cor? Où vas-tu? Ô Boromir! Mais il était parti.” »

fields.title: Boromir, Mio Fratello
fields.lore: “‘Dov'è il tuo corno? Dove stai andando? Oh Boromir! Ma egli scomparve.'”

cards.title: Boromir's Gauntlets
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. Skirmish: Exert bearer to cancel a skirmish involving bearer. Any Shadow player may remove (1) to prevent this.
cards.lore: “‘...now Boromir has taken his road, and we must make haste to choose our own.'”

fields.title: Boromir's Gauntlets
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. Skirmish: Exert bearer to cancel a skirmish involving bearer. Any Shadow player may remove (1) to prevent this.
fields.lore: “‘...now Boromir has taken his road, and we must make haste to choose our own.'”

fields.title: Boromirs Handschuhe
fields.lore: "Doch jetzt hat Boromir seinen Weg angetreten, und wir müssen uns eilen, den unseren zu wählen.“

fields.title: Los Guanteletes De Boromir
fields.lore: “...ahora Boromir ha tomado su camino y hemos de apresurarnos a elegir el nuestro.”

fields.title: Les Gantelets de Boromir
fields.lore: « “... Boromir a pris sa route, et nous devons nous hâter de choisir la nôtre.” »

fields.title: Guanti di Boromir
fields.lore: “‘...ora che Boromir è partito per la sua via, dobbiamo affrettarci a scegliere la nostra.'”

cards.title: Curse Them
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Exert a Ring-bound Man to cancel a skirmish involving a roaming minion.
cards.lore: “‘It is close on ten leagues hence to the east-shore of Anduin... and we seldom come so far afield.'”

fields.title: Curse Them
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Exert a Ring-bound Man to cancel a skirmish involving a roaming minion.
fields.lore: “‘It is close on ten leagues hence to the east-shore of Anduin... and we seldom come so far afield.'”

fields.title: Verflucht sollen sie sein!
fields.lore: "Es sind annähernd zehn Wegstunden von hier bis zum Ostufer des Anduin... und wir kommen selten so weit ins Land.“

fields.title: Malditos Sean
fields.lore: “Hay casi diez leguas desde aquí a la costa oriental de Anduin... y rara vez llegamos tan lejos en nuestras expediciones.”

fields.title: Maudits Soient-Ils
fields.lore: « “Il y a près de dix lieues d'ici à la rive orientale de l'Anduin... et nous venons rarement aussi loin en expédition.” »

fields.title: Maledetti!
fields.lore: “‘Dista quasi dieci leghe da qui, la riva est dell'Anduin... e di rado ci spingiamo tanto lontano.'”

cards.title: Damrod
cards.subtitle: Ranger of Ithilien
cards.gameText: Ring-bound. Ranger. To play, spot a Ring-bound Man. Skirmish: Exert Damrod to exhaust a Man he is skirmishing.
cards.lore: “‘I doubt not that the days of Gondor are numbered, and the walls of Minas Tirith are doomed, so great is His strength and malice.'”

fields.title: Damrod
fields.subtitle: Ranger of Ithilien
fields.gameText: Ring-bound. Ranger. To play, spot a Ring-bound Man. Skirmish: Exert Damrod to exhaust a Man he is skirmishing.
fields.lore: “‘I doubt not that the days of Gondor are numbered, and the walls of Minas Tirith are doomed, so great is His strength and malice.'”

fields.subtitle: Waldläufer aus Ithilien
fields.lore: "Ich zweifle nicht, dass Gondors Tage gezählt und die Mauern von Minas Tirith dem Untergang geweiht sind, so groß ist Seine Stärke und Bosheit.“

fields.subtitle: Montaraz de Ithilien
fields.lore: “No hay duda de que los días de Gondor están contados, y que los muros de Minas Tirith están condenados, tal es la fuerza y la malicia que hay en Él.”

fields.subtitle: Rôdeur de L'Ithilien
fields.lore: « “Je ne doute pas que les jours du Gondor ne soient comptés et que les murs de Minas Tirith ne soient condamnés, tant Sa force et Sa malice sont grandes.” »

fields.subtitle: Ramingo di Ithilien
fields.lore: “‘I giorni di Gondor sono indubbiamente contati, e le mura di Minas Tirith votate alla distruzione, così grandi sono la Sua forza e la Sua malvagità.'”

cards.title: Defend It and Hope
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a [GONDOR] Man to wound a minion once (or twice if that minion is an Uruk-hai).
cards.lore: “‘Is it not said that no foe has ever taken the Hornburg, if men defended it?'”

fields.title: Defend It and Hope
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a [GONDOR] Man to wound a minion once (or twice if that minion is an Uruk-hai).
fields.lore: “‘Is it not said that no foe has ever taken the Hornburg, if men defended it?'”

fields.title: Haltet aus und hofft
fields.lore: "Heißt es nicht, dass die Hornburg noch nie eingenommen wurde, wenn Menschen sie verteidigten?“

fields.title: Defendámosla y Confiemos
fields.lore: “¿No se dice acaso que ningún enemigo tomó jamás Cuernavilla, cuando la defendieron los hombres?”

fields.title: Défendons-le, et Espérons
fields.lore: « “Ne dit-on pas qu'aucun ennemi n'a jamais pris le Fort le Cor si des hommes le défendaient?” »

fields.title: Difendiamolo e Speriamo
fields.lore: “‘Non si dice forse che mai nemico prese il Trombatorrione, difeso dagli Uomini?'”

cards.title: Faramir
cards.subtitle: Captain of Gondor
cards.gameText: Ring-bound. Ranger. The twilight cost of each other [GONDOR] Man in your starting fellowship is -1. While skirmishing a roaming minion, Faramir is strength +2.
cards.lore: “‘He leads us now in all perilous ventures.'”

fields.title: Faramir
fields.subtitle: Captain of Gondor
fields.gameText: Ring-bound. Ranger. The twilight cost of each other [GONDOR] Man in your starting fellowship is -1. While skirmishing a roaming minion, Faramir is strength +2.
fields.lore: “‘He leads us now in all perilous ventures.'”

fields.subtitle: Heermeister von Gondor
fields.lore: "Er ist jetzt der Führer bei allen gefährlichen Unterfangen.“

fields.subtitle: Capitán de Gondor
fields.lore: “Nos conduce en todas las empresas peligrosas.”

fields.subtitle: Capitaine du Gondor
fields.lore: « “Il mène maintenant toutes les entreprises périlleuses.” »

fields.subtitle: Capitano di Gondor
fields.lore: “‘E' lui ora a condurci in tutte le pericolose avventure.'”

cards.title: Faramir
cards.subtitle: Son of Denethor
cards.gameText: Ring-bound. Ranger. An opponent may not play skirmish events or use skirmish special abilities during skirmishes involving Faramir.
cards.lore: “He could see Faramir's face, which was now unmasked; it was stern and commanding, and a keen wit lay behind his searching glance.”

fields.title: Faramir
fields.subtitle: Son of Denethor
fields.gameText: Ring-bound. Ranger. An opponent may not play skirmish events or use skirmish special abilities during skirmishes involving Faramir.
fields.lore: “He could see Faramir's face, which was now unmasked; it was stern and commanding, and a keen wit lay behind his searching glance.”

fields.subtitle: Sohn des Denethor
fields.lore: Er sah Faramirs Gesicht, der jetzt keine Maske trug: es war streng und herrisch, und ein scharfer Verstand sprach aus seinem forschenden Blick.

fields.subtitle: Hijo de Denethor
fields.lore: “Veía el rostro de Faramir, ahora desenmascarado: era severo e imperioso; y detrás de aquella mirada escrutadora brillaba una viva inteligencia.”

fields.subtitle: Fils de Denethor
fields.lore: « Il voyait le visage de Faramir, à présent démasqué: il était sévère et imposant; une intelligence aiguë paraissait dans son regard scrutateur. »

fields.subtitle: Figlio di Denethor
fields.lore: “Vedeva il viso di Faramir, ora senza maschera: era severo ed imperioso, e dietro al suo sguardo investigatore si nascondeva un'intelligenza acuta.”

cards.title: Faramir's Bow
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Faramir. He is an archer. Skirmish: If Faramir is skirmishing a Man or a roaming minion, exert Faramir to wound that minion.
cards.lore: “‘Were I as hasty as you, I might have slain you long ago.'”

fields.title: Faramir's Bow
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Faramir. He is an archer. Skirmish: If Faramir is skirmishing a Man or a roaming minion, exert Faramir to wound that minion.
fields.lore: “‘Were I as hasty as you, I might have slain you long ago.'”

fields.title: Faramirs Bogen
fields.lore: "Wäre ich so hastig wie du, hätte ich dich vielleicht schon längst erschlagen.“

fields.title: El Arco De Faramir
fields.lore: “Si fuera tan irreflexivo como tú, ya os hubiera matado.”

fields.title: L'Arc de Faramir
fields.lore: « “Si j'étais aussi irréfléchi que vous, j'aurais pu vous tuer depuis longtemps.” »

fields.title: Arco di Faramir
fields.lore: “‘Fossi stato frettoloso come te, vi avrei già uccisi da parecchio tempo.'”

cards.title: Faramir's Cloak
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Faramir. Each roaming minion skirmishing a Ring-bound Man is strength -1.
cards.lore: Captain Faramir and his rangers were clad in green and brown of varied hues, better to walk unseen in the glades of Ithilien.

fields.title: Faramir's Cloak
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Faramir. Each roaming minion skirmishing a Ring-bound Man is strength -1.
fields.lore: Captain Faramir and his rangers were clad in green and brown of varied hues, better to walk unseen in the glades of Ithilien.

fields.title: Faramirs Mantel
fields.lore: Heermeister Faramir und seine Waldläufer waren in Grün und Braun von verschiedener Tönung gekleidet, als ob das günstiger sei, um ungesehen in den Lichtungen von Ithilien zu wandern.

fields.title: La Capa De Faramir
fields.lore: El Capitán Faramir y sus montaraces estaban vestidos de verde y marrón de varios tonos, para moverse sin ser vistos por los bosques de Ithilien.

fields.title: La Cape de Faramir
fields.lore: « Le Capitaine Faramir et ses rôdeurs étaient drapés de tons variés de vert et de brun, afin de traverser discrètement les clairières de L'Ithilien. »

fields.title: Mantello di Faramir
fields.lore: Il Capitano Faramir e i suoi raminghi erano vestiti in varie tonalità di verde e di marrone come per meglio celarsi nelle radure dell'Ithilien.

cards.title: Forbidden Pool
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at site 6T, each Ring-bound Man takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase. Fellowship: Add (2) and discard this condition to heal a Ring-bound Man.
cards.lore: “‘...tonight you have come where it is death to come.'”

fields.title: Forbidden Pool

fields.lore: “‘...tonight you have come where it is death to come.'”

fields.title: Der verbotene Weiher
fields.lore: "... bist du dorthin gekommen, wohin zu kommen den Tod bedeutet.“

fields.title: Estanque Vedado
fields.lore: “...pero esta noche has venido a un lugar donde sólo venir significa la muerte.”

fields.title: Lac Interdit
fields.lore: « “...vous êtes venus en un lieu où la venue signifie la mort.” »

fields.title: Lo Stagno Proibito
fields.lore: “‘...stanotte sei venuto qui ove ogni visita si paga con la morte.'”

cards.title: Forests of Ithilien
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at site 5T, the site number of each Man in a skirmish is +2. Regroup: Discard this condition and exert a Ring-bound Man to liberate a site.
cards.lore: “...a fair country of climbing woods and swift-falling streams.”

fields.title: Forests of Ithilien
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at site 5T, the site number of each Man in a skirmish is +2. Regroup: Discard this condition and exert a Ring-bound Man to liberate a site.
fields.lore: “...a fair country of climbing woods and swift-falling streams.”

fields.title: Die Wälder Ithiliens
fields.lore: ... ein liebliches Land mit emporklimmenden Wäldern....

fields.title: Bosques De Ithilien
fields.lore: “...una hermosa región de lomas boscosas y de aguas rápidas.”

fields.title: Les Forêts de L'Ithilien
fields.lore: « ... belle région de forêts et de torrents rapides. »

fields.title: Foreste dell'Ithilien
fields.lore: “‘...un bel paese dai boschi scoscesi e dai rapidi torrenti.'”

cards.title: Gondorian Ranger
cards.gameText: Ring-bound. Ranger. The site number of each minion assigned to skirmish a Ring-bound Man is +2.
cards.lore: “Green gauntlets covered their hands, and their faces were hooded and masked with green, except for their eyes, which were very keen and bright.”

fields.title: Gondorian Ranger
fields.gameText: Ring-bound. Ranger. The site number of each minion assigned to skirmish a Ring-bound Man is +2.
fields.lore: “Green gauntlets covered their hands, and their faces were hooded and masked with green, except for their eyes, which were very keen and bright.”

fields.title: Waldläufer von Gondor
fields.lore: Grüne Stulpenhandschuhe bedeckten ihre Hände, und ihre Gesichter waren verhüllt durch Kapuzen und grüne Masken, mit Ausnahme der Augen, die sehr scharf und strahlend waren.

fields.title: Montaraz Gondoriano
fields.lore: “Guantes verdes les cubrían las manos, y tenían los rostros encapuchados y enmascarados de verde, con excepción de los ojos que eran vivos y brillantes.”

fields.title: Rôdeur du Gondor
fields.lore: « Des gants verts couvraient leurs mains, et leurs visages étaient encapuchonnés et masqués de vert, sauf pour les yeux, qu'ils avaient vifs et brillants. »

fields.title: Ramingo di Gondor
fields.lore: “‘Guanti verdi coprivano le loro mani, e i loro volti erano protetti da un cappuccio e da una maschera verdi che lasciavano liberi soltanto gli occhi, assai penetranti e luminosi.'”

cards.title: Hard Choice
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Spot Aragorn to heal a companion who has the Aragorn signet twice.
cards.lore: “‘Shall we rest by night, or shall we go on while our will and strength hold?'”

fields.title: Hard Choice
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Spot Aragorn to heal a companion who has the Aragorn signet twice.
fields.lore: “‘Shall we rest by night, or shall we go on while our will and strength hold?'”

fields.title: Schwierige Entscheidung
fields.lore: "Sollen wir bei Nacht ruhen oder weitergehen, solange unser Wille und unsere Kraft reichen?“

fields.title: Difícil Elección
fields.lore: “¿Descansaremos de noche o seguiremos adelante mientras tengamos voluntad y fuerzas?”

fields.title: Choix Difficile
fields.lore: « “Nous reposerons-nous la nuit, ou continuerons-nous tant que notre volonté et nos forces tiendront?” »

fields.title: Scelta Difficile
fields.lore: “‘Riposare durante la notte, o proseguire finché forza e volontà reggono ancora?'”

cards.title: Help in Doubt and Need
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Exert an unbound [GONDOR] Man to make a [ROHAN] companion strength +2, or exert a [ROHAN] companion to make an unbound [GONDOR] Man strength +2.
cards.lore: “‘The Heir of Elendil would be a strength indeed to the Sons of Eorl in this evil tide.'”

fields.title: Help in Doubt and Need
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Exert an unbound [GONDOR] Man to make a [ROHAN] companion strength +2, or exert a [ROHAN] companion to make an unbound [GONDOR] Man strength +2.
fields.lore: “‘The Heir of Elendil would be a strength indeed to the Sons of Eorl in this evil tide.'”

fields.title: Hilfe in Zweifel und Not
fields.lore: "Elendils Erbe wäre wahrlich eine Verstärkung für Eorls Söhne in dieser bösen Zeit.“

fields.title: Ayuda En La Necesidad Y En La Duda
fields.lore: “El Heredero de Elendil sería sin duda un fuerte apoyo para los Hijos de Eorl en estos tiempos aciagos.”

fields.title: De l'Aide dans le Doute et le Besoin
fields.lore: « “L'Héritier d'Elendil serait assurément une force pour les Fils d'Eorl en cette mauvaise période.” »

fields.title: Aiuto nel Dubbio e nel Bisogno
fields.lore: “‘L'Erede di Elendil sarebbe una vera forza per i Figli di Eorl in questa tragica situazione.'”

cards.title: Henneth Annûn
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at site 6T, each roaming minion skirmishing a Ring-bound companion is strength -2. Skirmish: Spot a [GONDOR] Man and discard this condition to wound a roaming minion.
cards.lore: “‘This is the Window of the Sunset....'”

fields.lore: “‘This is the Window of the Sunset....'”
"Dies ist das Fenster des Sonnenuntergangs....“
“Esta es la Ventana del Sol Poniente...”
« “C'est ici la Fenêtre du Soleil Couchant...” »

fields.title: Henneth Annún
fields.lore: “‘ Questa è la Finestra del Tramonto...'”

cards.title: Ithilien Trap
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time a [GONDOR] Man wins a skirmish, you may place a [GONDOR] token here. Maneuver: Exert a minion for each [GONDOR] token here (limit 3). Discard this condition.
cards.lore: “He was glad he could not see the dead face.”

fields.title: Ithilien Trap
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time a [GONDOR] Man wins a skirmish, you may place a [GONDOR] token here. Maneuver: Exert a minion for each [GONDOR] token here (limit 3). Discard this condition.
fields.lore: “He was glad he could not see the dead face.”

fields.title: Hinterhalt in Ithilien
fields.lore: Er war froh, dass er das Gesicht des Toten nicht sehen konnte.

fields.title: Trampa De Ithilien
fields.lore: “Se alegró de no verle la cara al muerto.”

fields.title: Piège de L'Ithilien
fields.lore: « Il fut heureux de ne pas voir le visage mort. »

fields.title: Trappola dell'Ithilien
fields.lore: “Era contento di non poter vedere il viso del morto.”

cards.title: Mablung
cards.subtitle: Soldier of Gondor
cards.gameText: Ring-bound. Ranger. To play, spot a Ring-bound Man. Skirmish: Exert Mablung to exhaust a roaming minion he is skirmishing.
cards.lore: “‘...we have a new errand on this journey....'”

fields.gameText: Ring-bound. Ranger. To play, spot a Ring-bound Man. Skirmish: Exert Mablung to exhaust a roaming minion he is skirmishing.
fields.lore: “‘...we have a new errand on this journey....'”

fields.subtitle: Soldat aus Gondor
fields.lore: "Aber wir haben bei dieser Fahrt einen neuen Auftrag....“

fields.subtitle: Soldado de Gondor
fields.lore: “...tenemos una nueva misión en este viaje...”

fields.subtitle: Soldat du Gondor
fields.lore: « “... nous avons une nouvelle mission, cette fois-ci...” »

fields.subtitle: Soldato di Gondor
fields.lore: “‘...questo viaggio ha uno scopo diverso dal solito...'”

cards.title: New Errand
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Spot a Ring-bound Man to make a minion's site number +2. If that minion loses this skirmish, you may wound a minion.
cards.lore: “‘...we come to Ambush the Men of Harad.'”

fields.title: New Errand
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Spot a Ring-bound Man to make a minion's site number +2. If that minion loses this skirmish, you may wound a minion.
fields.lore: “‘...we come to Ambush the Men of Harad.'”

fields.title: Ein neuer Auftrag
fields.lore: "... wir sind gekommen, um den Menschen aus Harad aus dem Hinterhalt aufzulauern.“

fields.title: Nueva Misión
fields.lore: “...venimos a emboscar a los Hombres de Harad.”

fields.title: Une Nouvelle Mission
fields.lore: « “... nous venons tendre une embûche aux Hommes de Harad.” »

fields.title: Un Nuovo Scopo
fields.lore: “‘...siamo venuti a tendere un agguato agli Uomini dell'Harad.'”

cards.title: Ranger of Ithilien
cards.gameText: Ring-bound. Ranger. When this companion is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -1. While skirmishing a roaming minion, this companion is strength +2.
cards.lore: “...they were goodly men, pale-skinned, dark of hair, with grey eyes and faces sad and proud.”

fields.title: Ranger of Ithilien
fields.gameText: Ring-bound. Ranger. When this companion is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -1. While skirmishing a roaming minion, this companion is strength +2.
fields.lore: “...they were goodly men, pale-skinned, dark of hair, with grey eyes and faces sad and proud.”

fields.title: Waldläufer aus Ithilien
fields.lore: ... dass sie stattliche Menschen waren, blasshäutig, dunkelhaarig, mit grauen Augen und traurigen und stolzen Gesichtern.

fields.title: Montaraz De Ithilien
fields.lore: “... eran hombres hermosos, de tez pálida, cabellos oscuros, ojos grises y rostros tristes y orgullosos.”

fields.title: Rôdeur de L'Ithilien
fields.lore: « “... c'étaient de beaux hommes, à la peau pâle et aux cheveux sombres, avec des yeux gris et un visage triste et fier. »

fields.title: Ramingo dell'Ithilien
fields.lore: “...erano begli Uomini, dalla pelle chiara e dai capelli scuri, gli occhi grigi e il viso triste e fiero.”

cards.title: Ranger's Bow
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Ring-bound Man. Skirmish: If bearer is skirmishing a Man or a roaming minion, exert bearer to wound that minion.
cards.lore: “Two had great bows, almost of their own height, and great quivers of long green-feathered arrows.”

fields.title: Ranger's Bow
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Ring-bound Man. Skirmish: If bearer is skirmishing a Man or a roaming minion, exert bearer to wound that minion.
fields.lore: “Two had great bows, almost of their own height, and great quivers of long green-feathered arrows.”

fields.title: Bogen der Waldläufer
fields.lore: Zwei hatten große Bögen, fast mannshoch, und große Köcher mit langen grüngefiederten Pfeilen.

fields.title: Arco De Montaraz
fields.lore: “...dos llevaban arcos grandes, casi de la altura de ellos, y grandes carcaj repletos de flechas largas con penachos verdes.”

fields.title: Arc de Rôdeur
fields.lore: « “Deux avaient de grands arcs, presque hauts qu'eux, et de grands carquois de longues flèches empennées de vert.” »

fields.title: Arco del Ramingo
fields.lore: “Gli altri erano armati d'immensi archi alti quasi quanto loro, e di faretre piene di lunghe frecce dalle piume verdi.”

cards.title: Ranger's Sword
cards.subtitle: Blade of Aragorn
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Aragorn. While skirmishing an Uruk-hai, Aragorn is strength +2.
cards.lore: “‘I am not weaponless.'”

fields.title: Ranger's Sword
fields.subtitle: Blade of Aragorn
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Aragorn. While skirmishing an Uruk-hai, Aragorn is strength +2.
fields.lore: “‘I am not weaponless.'”

fields.title: Das Schwert des Waldläufers
fields.subtitle: Aragorns Klinge
fields.lore: "Ich bin nicht waffenlos.“

fields.title: La Espada del Montaraz
fields.subtitle: Hoja de Aragorn
fields.lore: “No estoy desarmado.”

fields.title: Épée de Rôdeur
fields.subtitle: La Lame d'Aragorn
fields.lore: « “Je ne suis pas sans armes.” »

fields.title: Spada di Ramingo
fields.subtitle: Lama di Aragorn
fields.lore: “‘Io non sono inerme.'”

cards.title: Ruins of Osgiliath
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at site 7T, each Ring-bound Man is defender +1. Skirmish: Spot a Ringbound Man and discard this condition to wound an opponent's Man.
cards.lore: The Citadel of the Stars had fallen into ruin.

fields.title: Ruins of Osgiliath
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. While the fellowship is at site 7T, each Ring-bound Man is defender +1. Skirmish: Spot a Ringbound Man and discard this condition to wound an opponent's Man.
fields.lore: The Citadel of the Stars had fallen into ruin.

fields.title: Die Trümmer von Osgiliath
fields.lore: Die Zitadelle der Sterne war zu Ruinen zerfallen.

fields.title: Ruinas De Osgiliath
fields.lore: La Ciudadela de las Estrellas se ha convertido en ruinas.

fields.title: Les Ruines de l'Osgiliath
fields.lore: La Citadelle des Étoiles était tombée en ruine.

fields.title: Rovine di Osgiliath
fields.lore: La Cittadella delle Stelle era caduta in rovina.

cards.title: Sword of Gondor
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a [GONDOR] Man. While skirmishing a Man or a roaming minion, bearer is damage +1.
cards.lore: “Four tall Men stood there.... All had swords at their sides....”

fields.title: Sword of Gondor

fields.lore: “Four tall Men stood there.... All had swords at their sides....”

fields.title: Gondorklinge
fields.lore: Vier hochgewachsene Menschen standen dort.... Alle hatten Schwerter an der Seite....

fields.title: Espada De Gondor
fields.lore: “Cuatro hombres de elevada estatura estaban allí... Todos ceñían espadas...”

fields.title: Lame du Gondor
fields.lore: « “Quatre hommes de haute taille étaient là... Tous portaient des épées au côté...” »

fields.title: Spada di Gondor
fields.lore: “‘Quattro alti Uomini erano apparsi... tutti cingevano una spada...'”

cards.title: War and Valor
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make a [GONDOR] Man strength +2 (or +3 and damage +1 if skirmishing a roaming minion).
cards.lore: “‘So even was my brother, Boromir: a man of prowess, and for that he was accounted the best man in Gondor.'”

fields.title: War and Valor
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make a [GONDOR] Man strength +2 (or +3 and damage +1 if skirmishing a roaming minion).
fields.lore: “‘So even was my brother, Boromir: a man of prowess, and for that he was accounted the best man in Gondor.'”

fields.title: Krieg und Tapferkeit
fields.lore: "Gerade so war mein Bruder Boromir: ein heldenmütiger Mann, und deshalb galt er als der beste Mann in Gondor.“

fields.title: Guerra y Valor
fields.lore: “Guerrero era también mi hermano, Boromir: un hombre intrépido, considerado por su temple como el mejor de Gondor.”

fields.title: La Guerre et la Valeur
fields.lore: « “Tel était même mon frère, Boromir, homme très vaillant, considéré à ce titre comme le meilleur de Gondor.” »

fields.title: Guerra e Coraggio
fields.lore: “‘E tale era mio fratello Boromir: era un prode, e perciò era considerato il miglior Uomo di Gondor.'”

cards.title: Advance Uruk Patrol
cards.gameText: Damage +1. While at a battleground, this minion is fierce. While you control a battleground, this minion is strength +4.
cards.lore: “‘This is no rabble of mindless Orcs.'”

fields.lore: “‘This is no rabble of mindless Orcs.'”

fields.title: Uruk Erkundungstrupp
fields.lore: "Das ist keine Bande dummer Orks.“

fields.title: Patrulla Avanzada Uruk
fields.lore: “Esta no es una chusma de orcos descerebrados.”

fields.title: Patrouille Avancée Ourouk
fields.lore: « “Ceci n'est pas une meute d'Orques stupides.” »

fields.title: Squadra d'Avanguardia Uruk
fields.lore: “‘Questa non è feccia di Orchi senza cervello.'”

fields.lore: “‘Ten thousand strong at least....'”

fields.title: Angriff auf Helms Klamm
fields.lore: "Es sind mindestens zehntausend....“

fields.title: Ataque En El Abismo De Helm
fields.lore: “Diez mil y fuertes, por lo menos...”

fields.title: Attaque au Gouffre de Helm
fields.lore: « “Au moins dix mille hommes...” »

fields.title: Attacco al Fosso di Helm
fields.lore: “‘Almeno diecimila...'”

cards.title: Band of Uruk Bowmen
cards.gameText: Archer. Damage +1. While you control a site, the minion archery total is +1.
cards.lore: Taking the high ground provides a better field of fire.

fields.title: Band of Uruk Bowmen

fields.lore: Taking the high ground provides a better field of fire.

fields.title: Uruk Schützentrupp
fields.lore: Ein erhöhter Standpunkt ermöglichte ein besseres Schussfeld.

fields.title: Banda De Arqueros Uruk
fields.lore: Tomar una posición elevada proporciona un mejor campo de tiro.

fields.title: Troupe d'Archers Ourouks
fields.lore: En occupant l'amont du champ de bataille, les archers avaient un meilleur angle de tir.

fields.title: Gruppo di Arcieri Uruk
fields.lore: Il possesso del terreno elevato fornisce un migliore campo d'attacco.

cards.title: Banished
cards.gameText: To play, exert Saruman or an [ISENGARD] Man. Plays on a Free Peoples Man. Each time another ally or companion loses a skirmish, bearer must exert.
cards.lore: “‘Oh, but this is not from me – it comes from the King. He signed it this morning.'”

fields.lore: “‘Oh, but this is not from me – it comes from the King. He signed it this morning.'”

fields.title: Verbannt
fields.lore: "Oh, aber dies ist nicht von mir, es kommt vom König. Er hat es heute morgen unterzeichnet.“

fields.title: Desterrado
fields.lore: “Ah, pero no es mia; proviene del Rey. La firmó esta mañana.”

fields.title: Banni
fields.lore: « “Oh, mais ceci n'est pas de moi. Cela vient du Roi. Il l'a signé ce matin.” »

fields.title: Esiliato
fields.lore: “‘Oh, ma non è mio, è del Re. Lo ha firmato questa mattina.'”

cards.title: Beyond All Hope
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert 2 Uruk-hai to add a burden for each card in the dead pile.
cards.lore: “‘How shall any tower withstand such numbers and such reckless hate?'”

fields.title: Beyond All Hope
fields.gameText: Maneuver: Exert 2 Uruk-hai to add a burden for each card in the dead pile.
fields.lore: “‘How shall any tower withstand such numbers and such reckless hate?'”

fields.title: Jenseits aller Hoffnung
fields.lore: "Wie soll irgendein Turm einer solchen Anzahl von Feinden und solchem tollkühnen Hass standhalten?“

fields.title: Más Allá de Toda Esperanza
fields.lore: “¿Cómo podrá una torre resistir a fuerzas tan numerosas y a un odio tan implacable?”

fields.title: Au-Delà de Tout Espoir
fields.lore: « “Comment aucune tour pourrait-elle résister à un tel nombre et à une haine aussi violente?” »

fields.title: Aldilà di Ogni Speranza
fields.lore: “‘Come potrà mai una torre resistere a una tale valanga e a un odio così implacabile?'”

cards.title: Beyond Dark Mountains
cards.gameText: Response: If a companion or ally is killed, exert an [ISENGARD] minion to add a burden (or 2 burdens if Aragorn, Gandalf, or Theoden is killed).
cards.lore: “Where now was the Ring-bearer? How thin indeed was the thread upon which doom still hung!”

fields.title: Beyond Dark Mountains
fields.gameText: Response: If a companion or ally is killed, exert an [ISENGARD] minion to add a burden (or 2 burdens if Aragorn, Gandalf, or Theoden is killed).
fields.lore: “Where now was the Ring-bearer? How thin indeed was the thread upon which doom still hung!”

fields.title: Hinter dunklen Bergen
fields.lore: Wo war jetzt der Ringträger? Wie dünn war der Faden, an dem das Schicksal noch hing!

fields.title: Tras Montañas Oscuras
fields.lore: “¿Dónde estaba ahora el Portador del Anillo? ¡Qué frágil era el hilo del que pendía aún el destino!”

fields.title: Par-Delà les Montagnes Noires
fields.lore: « Où était maintenant le Porteur de l'Anneau? Qu'il était donc ténu le fil auquel était encore suspendu le Destin! »

fields.title: Oltre le Montagne Oscure
fields.lore: “Dov'era il Portatore dell'Anello? Com'era davvero fragile il filo da cui pendeva il loro destino!”

cards.title: Broad-bladed Sword
cards.gameText: Bearer must be an Uruk-hai. Bearer may not take wounds (except during skirmish phases).
cards.lore: “They were armed with short broad-bladed swords, not with the curved scimitars usual with Orcs....”

fields.title: Broad-bladed Sword

fields.lore: “They were armed with short broad-bladed swords, not with the curved scimitars usual with Orcs....”

fields.title: Schwert mit breiter Klinge
fields.lore: Ihre Waffen waren kurze Schwerter mit breiten Klingen, nicht die bei Orks üblichen Krummsäbel....

fields.title: Espada De Hoja Ancha
fields.lore: “Estaban armados con espadas cortas de hoja ancha y no con las cimitarras curvas habituales en los Orcos.”

fields.title: Épée à Large Lame
fields.lore: « “Ils étaient armés de courtes épées à large lame et non des cimeterres courbes habituels aux Orques...” »

fields.title: Spada Corta e Larga
fields.lore: “Invece delle comuni scimitarre ricurve degli Orchi avevano spade corte e larghe...”

cards.title: Brought Back Alive

fields.title: Lebendig zurückgebracht
fields.lore: "Wofür will man sie? Warum lebendig? Bereiten sie viel Spaß?“

fields.title: Devuelto Con Vida
fields.lore: “¿Para qué los quiere? ¿Por qué vivos? ¿Son una buena diversión?”

fields.title: Les Ramener Vivants
fields.lore: « “Pourquoi les veut-on?... Pourquoi vivants? Offrent-il un bon divertissement?” »

fields.title: Riportarli Vivi
fields.lore: “‘A che cosa servono?... Perché li vogliono vivi? Forse sono divertenti?'”

fields.title: Westfold in Flammen
fields.lore: "Wir haben viele von unseren Leuten hier gefunden, die erschlagen worden sind, als sie hierher flohen.“

fields.title: Quema Del Folde Oeste
fields.lore: “Hemos encontrado muertos a muchos de nuestros hombres que trataron de huir...”

fields.title: L'Incendie de l'Ouestfolde
fields.lore: « “Nous avons trouvé plusieurs des nôtres, massacrés alors qu'ils tentaient de s'échapper...” »

fields.title: L'Incendio dell'Ovestfalda
fields.lore: “‘Questa era una ricca vallata piena di fattorie.'”

cards.title: Cloud of Arrows

cards.lore: “Behind them orc-archers crowded, sending a hail of darts against the bowmen on the walls.”

fields.title: Ein Hagel von Pfeilen
fields.lore: Hinter ihnen scharten sich Orkschützen zusammen und schickten einen Hagel von Pfeilen gegen die Bogenschützen auf den Wällen.

fields.title: Nube De Flechas
fields.lore: “Tras ellos se amontonaban los arqueros orcos, lanzando una lluvia de dardos contra los arqueros apostados en los muros.”

fields.title: Une Nuée de Flèches
fields.lore: « Derrière, se pressaient des archers orques, qui lançaient une grêle de traits sur les archers des murs. »

fields.title: Nube di Frecce
fields.lore: “Dietro a loro, uno stuolo di Orchi scoccava una grandine di frecce contro gli arcieri sulle mura.”

fields.title: Komm herunter
fields.lore: "Wir sind die kämpfenden Uruk-hai. ...Bring deinen König heraus, den Drückeberger!“

fields.title: Bajad
fields.lore: “Somos los guerreros Uruk-hai... ¡Tráenos al cobardón de tu rey!”

fields.title: Descendez!
fields.lore: « “Nous sommes les combattants ourouk-haï... Amenez votre roi qui se dérobe!” »

fields.title: Scendete
fields.lore: “‘Siamo gli imbattibili Uruk-hai... Mostrateci il vostro re scontroso!'”

fields.title: Deckungsfeuer
fields.lore: Bogenschützen duckten sich hinter den Wall, nicht in der Lage das Feuer zu erwidern.

fields.title: Fuego De Cobertura
fields.lore: Los arqueros se refugiaron en los muros, incapaces de responder.

fields.title: Tir de Couverture
fields.lore: Incapables de répliquer, les archers ne quittaient pas les murailles.

fields.title: Fuoco di Copertura
fields.lore: Gli arcieri si rannicchiarono contro le mura, incapaci di rispondere al fuoco.

fields.title: Bis zum letzten Mann

fields.title: Hasta El Último Niño
fields.lore: Los Uruks trajeron la muerte a las villas de Rohan.

fields.title: Jusqu'au Dernier Enfant
fields.lore: Les Ourouks amenaient la mort dans les villages Rohan.

fields.title: Fino all'Ultimo Bambino
fields.lore: Gli Uruk portarono la morte nei villaggi di Rohan.

fields.lore: Mit jedem gefallenen Verteidiger stieg der Mut der angreifenden Armee.

fields.title: Rechazado
fields.lore: Con cada defensor caído, la moral del ejercito atacante crecía.

fields.title: Repoussés
fields.lore: Chaque fois qu'un défenseur tombait, le moral des attaquants grimpait.

fields.title: Respinti
fields.lore: Per ciascun difensore caduto, il morale degli attaccanti cresceva.

cards.lore: The best archers were held in reserve, awaiting the final assault.

fields.title: Elite Armbrustschützen
fields.lore: Die besten Schützen wurden für den entscheidenden Angriff in Reserve gehalten.

fields.title: Ballesteros De Élite
fields.lore: Los mejores arqueros fueron reservados, esperando al asalto final.

fields.title: Arbalétriers d'Élite
fields.lore: Les meilleurs archers étaient gardés en réserve, en attendant l'assaut final.

fields.title: Balestrieri d'Elite
fields.lore: Gli arcieri migliori erano tenuti di riserva, in attesa dell'assalto decisivo.

fields.title: Wildheit
fields.lore: Die Uruks waren trotz ihres Kampftrainings immer noch wilde Bestien.

fields.title: Ferocidad
fields.lore: La brutalidad de los Uruks siguió a pesar de su entrenamiento para la batalla.

fields.title: Férocité
fields.lore: La sauvagerie des Ourouks demeure malgré leur entraînement.

fields.title: Ferocia
fields.lore: La selvaggia furia degli Uruk perdurava nonostante il loro addestramento.

cards.lore: “‘We do not answer to Mordor scum!'”

fields.title: Zurück!
fields.lore: "Wir antworten Abschaum aus Mordor nicht!“

fields.title: Dad La Vuelta
fields.lore: “¡Nosotros no respondemos a la escoria de Mordor!”

fields.title: Partez
fields.lore: « “Nous ne répondons pas à la pourriture du Mordor!” »

fields.title: Tornare Indietro
fields.lore: “‘Noi non rispondiamo alla feccia di Mordor!'”

fields.lore: "Habe ich Euch nicht geraten, Herr, seinen Stab zu verbieten?“

fields.subtitle: Hijo de Galmód
fields.lore: “¿No os aconsejé, señor, que no le dejarais entrar con la vara?”

fields.title: Grima
fields.subtitle: Fils de Galmod
fields.lore: « “Ne vous avais-je pas conseillé, Seigneur, d'interdire son bâton?” »

fields.subtitle: Figlio di Galmód
fields.lore: “‘Non ti avevo consigliato, sire, di impedirgli di entrare con il bastone?'”

fields.subtitle: Schlangenzunge
fields.lore: "Ich sorge für Euch und die Euren, so gut ich kann. Doch ermüdet Euch nicht und beansprucht Eure Kraft nicht zu schwer.“

fields.subtitle: Lengua de Serpiente
fields.lore: “Me preocupo por vos y por los vuestros tanto como puedo. Pero no os fatiguéis, ni confiéis demasiado en vuestras fuerzas.”

fields.title: Grima
fields.subtitle: Langue de Serpent
fields.lore: « “Je me soucie de vous et des vôtres le mieux que je le puis. Mais ne vous fatiguez pas, ou ne présumez pas trop de votre force.” »

fields.subtitle: Vermilinguo
fields.lore: “‘Io mi prendo cura di te e dei tuoi averi, come meglio posso. Ma non ti stancare, e non mettere a dura prova le tue forze.'”

cards.title: Haunting Her Steps

cards.lore: “‘What was the promised price? When all the men were dead, you were to pick your share of the treasure and take the woman you desire?'”

fields.title: Jeden ihrer Schritte verfolgend
fields.lore: "Was war der versprochene Preis? Wenn alle Männer tot wären, solltest du dir deinen Teil des Schatzes nehmen und die Frau, die du begehrtest?“

fields.title: Siguiendo Sus Pasos
fields.lore: “¿Cuál fue el precio convenido? Cuando todos los hombres hayan muerto, ¿recogerás tu parte del tesoro y tomarás la mujer que codicias?”

fields.title: Hante Ses Pas
fields.lore: « “Quel a été le prix convenu? Quand tous mes hommes seront morts, tu ramasseras ta part du trésor et tu prendras la femme que tu désires?” »

fields.title: Seguirla Passo a Passo
fields.lore: “‘Qual era la ricompensa promessa? Morti tutti gli uomini, avresti preso la tua parte del tesoro e la donna dei tuoi desideri?'”

cards.title: Kill Them Now
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make an [ISENGARD] tracker strength +2 (or +4 if skirmishing a character bearing a search card).
cards.lore: “‘They're a cursed nuisance, and we're in a hurry.'”

fields.title: Tötet sie jetzt
fields.lore: "Sie sind eine verdammte Last, und wir haben es eilig.“

fields.title: Matadlos Ahora
fields.lore: “Son una maldita molestia y tenemos prisa.”

fields.title: Tuons-Les Tout de Suite
fields.lore: « “Ils nous encombrent fichtrement, et nous sommes pressés.” »

fields.title: Uccideteli Ora
fields.lore: “‘Sono una maledetta seccatura, e noi abbiamo molta fretta.'”

cards.title: Leechcraft
cards.gameText: Spell. To play, exert Saruman or an [ISENGARD] Man. Plays on a Free Peoples Man. Special abilities in bearer's game text may not be used.
cards.lore: “‘Your leechcraft ere long would have had me walking on all fours like a beast.'”

fields.title: Heilkunst
fields.lore: "Eure Heilkunst hätte mich binnen kurzem dazu gebracht, wie ein Tier auf allen vieren zu gehen.“

fields.title: Sanguijuela
fields.lore: “Tus sanguijuelas pronto me hubieran obligado a caminar en cuatro patas como las bestias.”

fields.title: Science Médicale
fields.lore: « “Votre science médicale m'aurait bientôt réduit à marcher à quatre pattes comme les bêtes.” »

fields.title: Stregoneria
fields.lore: “‘Fra non molto le tue stregonerie mi avrebbero costretto a camminare a quattro zampe come una bestia.'”

cards.title: Lieutenant of Orthanc

cards.lore: “‘Do you wish to see the greatness of our army? We are the fighting Uruk-hai.'”

fields.title: Leutnant des Orthanc
fields.lore: "Willst du die Größe unseres Heeres sehen? Wir sind die kämpfenden Uruk-hai.“

fields.title: Lugarteniente De Orthanc
fields.lore: “¿Quieres ver la grandeza de nuestro ejército? Somos los guerreros Uruk-hai.”

fields.title: Lieutenant d'Orthanc
fields.lore: « “Voulez-vous voir la grandeur de notre armée? Nous sommes les combattans ourouk-haï.” »

fields.title: Luogotenente di Orthanc
fields.lore: “‘Desideri vedere quanto è grande il nostro esercito? Noi siamo gli imbattibili Uruk-hai.'”

fields.title: Viele Rätsel
fields.lore: "Es wird eine traurige Kunde für Frodo sein....“

fields.title: Muchos Acertijos
fields.lore: “Malas noticias para Frodo...”

fields.title: Bien des Énigmes
fields.lore: « “Ce sera une dure nouvelle pour Frodon...” »

fields.title: Molti Enigmi
fields.lore: “‘Sarà una notizia assai penosa per Frodo...'”

cards.title: Mauhúr

cards.lore: “‘Mauhúr and his lads are in the forest, and they should turn up any time now.'”

fields.subtitle: Anführer des Spähtrupps
fields.lore: "Mauhúr und seine Jungs sind im Wald, und sie müssten jetzt eigentlich jeden Augenblick auftauchen.“

fields.subtitle: Líder de Patrulla
fields.lore: “Las gentes de Mauhúr están en el bosque y se presentarán en cualquier momento.”

fields.title: Mauhour
fields.subtitle: Chef de Patrouille
fields.lore: « “Mauhour et ses gars sont dans la forêt, et ils devraient se montrer d'un moment à l'autre, à présent.” »

fields.subtitle: Capo Pattuglia
fields.lore: “‘Mauhúr e i suoi sono nella foresta, e dovrebbero spuntare da un minuto all'altro.'”

cards.title: Men Will Fall
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Spot Saruman or an [ISENGARD] Man to make an unbound companion strength -2.
cards.lore: “‘The Ring of Barahir. So, Gandalf Greyhame thinks he has found Isildur's heir, the Lost King of Gondor... Fool! That line was broken years ago.'”

fields.title: Men Will Fall

fields.lore: “‘The Ring of Barahir. So, Gandalf Greyhame thinks he has found Isildur's heir, the Lost King of Gondor... Fool! That line was broken years ago.'”

fields.title: Menschen werden fallen
fields.lore: "Barahirs Ring- Nun, Gandalf Graumähne glaubt, er habe Isildurs Erbe gefunden, den verlorenen König von Gondor... Narr! Diese Linie ist bereits vor vielen Jahren unterbrochen worden.“

fields.title: Los Hombres Caerán
fields.lore: “El Anillo de Barahir. Así pues, Gandalf Capagrís piensa que ha encontrado al Heredero de Isildur, el Rey Perdido de Gondor... ¡Loco! Esa estirpe se cortó hace años.”

fields.title: Les Hommes Tomberont
fields.lore: « “L'Anneau de Barahir. Alors Gandalf Maisongrise croit avoir trouvé l'héritier d'Isildur, le Roi perdu du Gondor... Le fou! Cette lignée s'est brisée il y a des années.” »

fields.title: Gli Uomini Cadranno
fields.lore: “‘L'Anello di Barahir. Così, Gandalf Grigiomanto pensa di aver trovato l'erede di Isildur, il Re Perduto di Gondor... Stolto! Quella linea è stata interrotta anni fa.'”

cards.title: New Power Rising

cards.lore: “‘For those who aid the Great Eye there will be rich reward.'”

fields.title: Eine neue Macht
fields.lore: "Allen, die dem Großen Auge dienen, ist reicher Lohn gewiss.“

fields.title: Un Nuevo Poder Se Alza
fields.lore: “Habrá una gran recompensa para aquellos que ayuden al Gran Ojo.”

fields.title: Un Nouveau Pouvoir Croît
fields.lore: « “Ceux qui viennent en aide au Grand *il seront richement récompensés.” »

fields.title: Un Nuovo Potere Sta Crescendo
fields.lore: “‘Per coloro che aiuteranno il Grande Occhio ci sarà una ricca ricompensa.'”

fields.lore: "Heute nacht wird das Land mit dem Blut Rohans getränkt....“

fields.title: No Hay Alba Para Los Hombres
fields.lore: “Esta noche, la tierra se teñirá de la sangre de Rohan...”

fields.title: L'Aube ne Viendra Pas Pour les Hommes
fields.lore: « “Cette nuit, le sol portera la tache du sang de Rohan...” »

fields.title: Nessuna Alba per gli Uomini
fields.lore: “‘Stanotte, la terra si macchierà del sangue di Rohan...'”

fields.title: Orthanc Kämpe
fields.lore: Ein Kämpfer, speziell für den Zweikampf trainiert, schnitt durch die Reihen der Verteidiger aus Rohan, wie eine Sense durch Gras.

fields.title: Campeón De Orthanc
fields.lore: Un guerrero entrenado en combate singular, abrió una brecha entre los defensores.

fields.title: Champion d'Orthanc
fields.lore: Entraîné pour le combat au corps-à-corps, le guerrier décima les défenseurs.

fields.title: Campione di Orthanc
fields.lore: Guerriero addestrato nel combattimento singolo, falciava le schiere dei difensori.

fields.title: Orthanc Krieger
fields.lore: Die von Saruman gezüchteten Uruk-hai waren stärker und grausamer als die Orks aus Mordor.

fields.title: Guerrero De Orthanc
fields.lore: Los Uruk-hai creados por Saruman son más fuertes y más temidos que los Orcos de Mordor.

fields.title: Guerrier d'Orthanc
fields.lore: Les Ourouk-Haï créés par Saroumane sont plus forts et plus féroces que les Orques du Mordor.

fields.title: Guerriero di Orthanc
fields.lore: Gli Uruk-hai creati da Saruman sono più forti e feroci degli Orchi di Mordor.

cards.title: The Palantír of Orthanc
cards.subtitle: Seventh Seeing-stone
cards.gameText: To play, spot an [ISENGARD] minion. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Spot an [ISENGARD] minion and remove (2) to reveal the top card of any draw deck. You may place that card beneath that draw deck.
cards.lore: “‘The name meant that which looks far away.'”

fields.title: The Palantír of Orthanc
fields.subtitle: Seventh Seeing-stone
fields.gameText: To play, spot an [ISENGARD] minion. Plays to your support area. Shadow: Spot an [ISENGARD] minion and remove (2) to reveal the top card of any draw deck. You may place that card beneath that draw deck.
fields.lore: “‘The name meant that which looks far away.'”

fields.title: Der Palantír von Orthanc
fields.subtitle: Einer der sieben sehenden Steine
fields.lore: "Der Name bedeutet das, was in weite Ferne schaut.“

fields.title: El Palantír De Orthanc
fields.subtitle: La Séptima Piedra Vidente
fields.lore: “El nombre significa lo que mira a lo lejos.”

fields.title: Le Palantír d'Orthanc
fields.subtitle: Septième Pierre de Vision
fields.lore: « “Ce nom signifiait ce qui regarde au loin.” »

fields.title: Il Palantír di Orthanc
fields.subtitle: La Settima Pietra Veggente
fields.lore: “‘Il nome significa ciò che guarda lontano.'”

cards.title: Pillage of Rohan
cards.gameText: Plays on a site you control. While an Uruk-hai is stacked on this site, the Free Peoples player may not play skirmish events or use skirmish special abilities.
cards.lore: Rumor of plunder swelled the ranks of the Isengarders.

fields.title: Pillage of Rohan
fields.gameText: Plays on a site you control. While an Uruk-hai is stacked on this site, the Free Peoples player may not play skirmish events or use skirmish special abilities.
fields.lore: Rumor of plunder swelled the ranks of the Isengarders.

fields.title: Die Plünderung Rohans
fields.lore: Das Versprechen auf Beute ließ die Ränge der Isengarter anschwellen.

fields.title: Saqueo De Rohan
fields.lore: El rumor de los saqueos creció entre las filas de los Isengardos.

fields.title: Le Saccage de Rohan
fields.lore: Les rumeurs de pillage couraient dans les rangs des combattants de l'Isengard.

fields.title: Saccheggio di Rohan
fields.lore: Le voci di saccheggio gonfiarono le schiere degli Isengardiani.

cards.title: Race Across the Mark
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Spot a site you control and remove (2) to cancel a skirmish involving an Uruk-hai.
cards.lore: “‘But in the meantime, the Uruk-hai of Isengard can do the dirty work as usual.'”

fields.title: Race Across the Mark
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Spot a site you control and remove (2) to cancel a skirmish involving an Uruk-hai.
fields.lore: “‘But in the meantime, the Uruk-hai of Isengard can do the dirty work as usual.'”

fields.title: Ein Rennen durch die Mark
fields.lore: "Aber inzwischen können wie gewöhnlich die Uruk-hai von Isengart die Dreckarbeit machen.“

fields.title: Carrera A Través De La Marca
fields.lore: “Pero entretanto los Uruk-hai de Isengard pueden hacer el trabajo sucio, como de costumbre.”

fields.title: Une Course à Travers la Marche
fields.lore: « “Mais en attendant l'Ourouk-haï de l'Isengard peut faire le sale travail, comme toujours.” »

fields.title: Corsa attraverso il Mark
fields.lore: “‘Ma nel frattempo, gli Uruk-hai di Isengard sbrigheranno come al solito le faccende più pesanti.'”

cards.title: Ranged Commander
cards.gameText: Archer. The twilight cost of each [ISENGARD] archer is -1. Archery: Exert Ranged Commander to make the Free Peoples player wound an unbound companion; this minion does not add to the minion archery total.
cards.lore: Hand-picked Uruks led Saruman's crossbowmen.

fields.title: Ranged Commander
fields.gameText: Archer. The twilight cost of each [ISENGARD] archer is -1. Archery: Exert Ranged Commander to make the Free Peoples player wound an unbound companion; this minion does not add to the minion archery total.
fields.lore: Hand-picked Uruks led Saruman's crossbowmen.

fields.title: Anführer der Fernkämpfer
fields.lore: Handverlesene Uruks führten Sarumans Armbrustschützen an.

fields.title: Comandante De Arqueros
fields.lore: Uruks elegidos cuidadosamente lideraron a los ballesteros de Saruman.

fields.title: Commandant à Distance
fields.lore: Des Ourouks choisis personnellement mènent les arbalétriers de Saroumane.

fields.title: Comandante dei Tiratori
fields.lore: Uruk scelti uno a uno comandano i balestrieri di Saruman.

cards.title: Ranks Without Number
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns an ally to a skirmish, you may play an [ISENGARD] minion from your discard pile. That minion's twilight cost is -2.
cards.lore: “‘All Isengard must be emptied....'”

fields.title: Ranks Without Number
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns an ally to a skirmish, you may play an [ISENGARD] minion from your discard pile. That minion's twilight cost is -2.
fields.lore: “‘All Isengard must be emptied....'”

fields.title: Unendliche Heerscharen
fields.lore: "Ganz Isengart muss leer sein....“

fields.title: Filas Sin Número
fields.lore: “Todo Isengard debe ser purgado.”

fields.title: Des Rangs Sans Nombre
fields.lore: « “Tout l'Isengard doit être vidé...” »

fields.title: Schiere Innumerevoli
fields.lore: “‘Isengard dev'essere completamente vuota...'”

cards.title: Rest While You Can
cards.gameText: Search. To play, spot an [ISENGARD] tracker. Plays on a companion. Limit 1 per companion. If bearer is killed, reveal the top 10 cards of opponent's draw deck and discard 1 Shadow card and 1 Free Peoples card. Your opponent reshuffles that deck.

fields.title: Rest While You Can
