fields.title: Ruh dich aus, solange du kannst
Repose-Toi Pendant Que Tu le Peux

cards.title: Rohan Is Mine
cards.gameText: To play, spot Saruman or an [ISENGARD] Man. Plays on a Free Peoples Man. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns bearer to a skirmish, exert each ally.
cards.lore: “‘You have no power here, Gandalf the Grey.'”

fields.title: Rohan Is Mine
fields.gameText: To play, spot Saruman or an [ISENGARD] Man. Plays on a Free Peoples Man. Each time the Free Peoples player assigns bearer to a skirmish, exert each ally.
fields.lore: “‘You have no power here, Gandalf the Grey.'”

fields.title: Rohan ist mein Land
fields.lore: "Ihr habt keinerlei Macht hier, Gandalf der Graue.“

fields.title: Rohan Es Mío
fields.lore: “No tienes poder aquí, Gandalf el Gris.”

fields.title: Rohan M'Appartient
fields.lore: « “Vous n'avez aucun pouvoir ici, Gandalf le Gris.” »

fields.title: Rohan è Mia
fields.lore: “‘Qui non hai alcun potere, Gandalf il Grigio.'”

cards.title: Saruman
cards.subtitle: Black Traitor
cards.gameText: Saruman may not take wounds during the archery phase and may not be assigned to a skirmish. When you play Saruman, you may discard a condition. Shadow: Exert Saruman to play Saruman's Staff from your discard pile.

fields.title: Saruman
fields.subtitle: Black Traitor
fields.gameText: Saruman may not take wounds during the archery phase and may not be assigned to a skirmish. When you play Saruman, you may discard a condition. Shadow: Exert Saruman to play Saruman's Staff from your discard pile.

cards.title: Saruman's Staff
cards.subtitle: Wizard's Device
cards.gameText: Plays on Saruman. He is fierce and damage +1. Maneuver: Make the first sentence of Saruman's game text not apply until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: “His hand clutched his heavy black staff like a claw.”

fields.title: Saruman's Staff
fields.subtitle: Wizard's Device
fields.gameText: Plays on Saruman. He is fierce and damage +1. Maneuver: Make the first sentence of Saruman's game text not apply until the regroup phase.
fields.lore: “His hand clutched his heavy black staff like a claw.”

fields.title: Sarumans Stab
fields.subtitle: Zauberers' Werkzeug
fields.lore: Seine Hand umklammerte den schweren schwarzen Stab wie eine Klaue.

fields.title: La Vara De Saruman
fields.subtitle: Instrumento de Mago
fields.lore: “La mano que aferraba la pesada vara negra parecía una garra.”

fields.title: Le Bâton de Saroumane
fields.subtitle: Dispositif de Magicien
fields.lore: « Sa main tenait son lourd bâton noir comme une serre. »

fields.title: Bastone di Saruman
fields.subtitle: Strumento da Stregone
fields.lore: “‘La mano che stringeva il pesante bastone nero pareva un artiglio.'”

cards.title: Still They Came
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Exert an Uruk-hai who is not assigned to a skirmish to make another Uruk-hai strength +3.
cards.lore: “Before the wall's foot the dead and broken were piled like shingle in a storm; ever higher rose the hideous mounds....”

fields.title: Still They Came
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Exert an Uruk-hai who is not assigned to a skirmish to make another Uruk-hai strength +3.
fields.lore: “Before the wall's foot the dead and broken were piled like shingle in a storm; ever higher rose the hideous mounds....”

fields.title: Immer noch griffen sie an
fields.lore: Vor dem Wall häuften sich Tote und Verwundete wie Schindeln in einem Sturm; immer höher türmten sich die scheußlichen Haufen....

fields.title: Aún Así Vienen
fields.lore: “A los pies del muro, los cadáveres y los despojos se apilaban como pedruscos en una tormenta; el lúgubre montículo crecía y crecía...”

fields.title: Mais Ils ne Faisaient Pas Relâche
fields.lore: « Au pied du mur, les cadavres et les corps rompus s'empilaient comme galets dans la tempête; les effroyables monticules s'élevaient toujours plus haut... »

fields.title: Ancora Arrivano
fields.lore: “Ai piedi della muraglia morti e rottami erano ammucchiati come ghiaia e pietrisco in una tempesta; gli orrendi mucchi crescevano sempre...”

cards.title: Uglúk
cards.subtitle: Servant of Saruman
cards.gameText: Tracker. Fierce. The roaming penalty for each [ISENGARD] tracker you play is -2. While you can spot 2 [ISENGARD] trackers, Ugluk is strength +3. While you can spot 3 [ISENGARD] trackers, Ugluk is damage +1.
cards.lore: 'I am Ugl?k. I command.'

fields.title: Uglúk
fields.subtitle: Servant of Saruman
fields.gameText: Tracker. Fierce. The roaming penalty for each [ISENGARD] tracker you play is -2. While you can spot 2 [ISENGARD] trackers, Ugluk is strength +3. While you can spot 3 [ISENGARD] trackers, Ugluk is damage +1.
fields.lore: 'I am Ugl?k. I command.'

cards.title: Uglúk's Sword
cards.gameText: Bearer must be an Uruk-hai. Shadow: If bearer is Ugluk, exert it and discard a minion from hand to play a minion. Its twilight cost is -3.
cards.lore: “‘I am Uglúk. I command.'”

fields.title: Uglúk's Sword
fields.gameText: Bearer must be an Uruk-hai. Shadow: If bearer is Ugluk, exert it and discard a minion from hand to play a minion. Its twilight cost is -3.
fields.lore: “‘I am Uglúk. I command.'”

fields.title: Uglúks Schwert
fields.lore: "Ich bin Uglúk. Ich befehle.“

fields.title: La Espada De Uglúk
fields.lore: “Yo soy Uglúk. Yo soy quien manda.”

fields.title: L'Épée d'Ouglouk
fields.lore: « “Je suis Ouglouk. C'est moi qui commande.” »

fields.title: Spada di Uglúk
fields.lore: “‘Io sono Uglúk. Io comando.'”

cards.title: Unferth
cards.subtitle: Grima's Bodyguard
cards.gameText: Each time the Free Peoples player assigns a companion or ally to an [ISENGARD] Man, that companion or ally must exert.
cards.lore: Gríma promised him riches when Rohan fell to Saruman.

fields.title: Unferth
fields.subtitle: Grima's Bodyguard
fields.gameText: Each time the Free Peoples player assigns a companion or ally to an [ISENGARD] Man, that companion or ally must exert.
fields.lore: Gríma promised him riches when Rohan fell to Saruman.

fields.subtitle: Grímas Leibwächter
fields.lore: Gríma versprach ihm Reichtümer, wenn Rohan an Saruman fiele.

fields.subtitle: El Guardaespaldas de Grima
fields.lore: Gríma le prometió riquezas cuando Rohan caiga ante Saruman.

fields.subtitle: Garde du Corps de Grima
fields.lore: Grima lui promit des richesses quand Rohan tomberait aux mains de Saroumane.

fields.subtitle: Guardia del Corpo di Gríma
fields.lore: Gríma gli promise infinite ricchezze, quando Rohan fosse caduta in mano a Saruman.

cards.title: Uruk Assault Band
cards.gameText: Damage +1. To play, spot an Uruk-hai. While at a battleground, this minion is fierce. While you control a battleground, this minion is strength +6. While you control 2 battlegrounds, this minion may not take wounds.

fields.title: Uruk Assault Band
fields.gameText: Damage +1. To play, spot an Uruk-hai. While at a battleground, this minion is fierce. While you control a battleground, this minion is strength +6. While you control 2 battlegrounds, this minion may not take wounds.

cards.title: Uruk Besieger
cards.gameText: Damage +1. Regroup: Stack this minion on a site you control. Shadow: If stacked on a site you control, play this minion. Its twilight cost is -1.
cards.lore: Fresh troops awaited to attack any weakness.

fields.title: Uruk Besieger
fields.gameText: Damage +1. Regroup: Stack this minion on a site you control. Shadow: If stacked on a site you control, play this minion. Its twilight cost is -1.
fields.lore: Fresh troops awaited to attack any weakness.

fields.title: Uruk Belagerer
fields.lore: Ausgeruhte Truppen warteten darauf, die Schwachstellen anzugreifen.

fields.title: Asediador Uruk
fields.lore: Tropas de refresco esperaban para atacar cualquier punto débil.

fields.title: Assiégeant Ourouk
fields.lore: Des nouvelles troupes se préparaient à exploiter toute faiblesse.

fields.title: Assediante Uruk
fields.lore: Truppe fresche attendevano per attaccare un punto debole.

cards.title: Uruk Chaser
cards.gameText: Tracker. Fierce. During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it is strength +2.
cards.lore: “‘Now we'll have to leg it double quick.'”

fields.title: Uruk Chaser
fields.gameText: Tracker. Fierce. During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it is strength +2.
fields.lore: “‘Now we'll have to leg it double quick.'”

fields.title: Jagender Uruk
fields.lore: "Jetzt müssen wir doppelt schnell laufen.“

fields.title: Perseguidor Uruk
fields.lore: “Ahora habrá que redoblar el paso.”

fields.title: Poursuiveur Ourouk
fields.lore: « “Il nous va falloir jouer doublement des jambes, maintenant.” »

fields.title: Inseguitore Uruk
fields.lore: “‘Ora dovremo raddoppiare l'andatura.'”

cards.title: Uruk Crossbow Troop
cards.gameText: Archer. When you play this minion, you may place an [ISENGARD] token on a machine.
cards.lore: Bolts from the Uruk crossbows shattered the shields of the defenders.

fields.title: Uruk Crossbow Troop
fields.gameText: Archer. When you play this minion, you may place an [ISENGARD] token on a machine.
fields.lore: Bolts from the Uruk crossbows shattered the shields of the defenders.

fields.title: Uruk Schützeneinheit
fields.lore: Die Bolzen der Uruk Armbrüste zerschmetterten die Schilde der Verteidiger.

fields.title: Tropa De Ballesteros Uruk
fields.lore: Virotes de las ballestas Uruk hacían añicos los escudos de los defensores.

fields.title: Troupe d'Arbalétriers
fields.lore: Les carreaux des arbalètes ourouks brisèrent les boucliers des défenseurs.

fields.title: Truppa di Balestrieri Uruk
fields.lore: I dardi delle balestre Uruk schiantarono gli scudi dei difensori.

cards.title: Uruk Crossbowman
cards.gameText: Archer. Archery: Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound an unbound companion; this minion does not add to the minion archery total.
cards.lore: Both the weapon and its wielder were foul creations of Saruman.

fields.title: Uruk Crossbowman
fields.gameText: Archer. Archery: Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound an unbound companion; this minion does not add to the minion archery total.
fields.lore: Both the weapon and its wielder were foul creations of Saruman.

fields.title: Uruk Armbrustschütze
fields.lore: Sowohl die Waffe als auch ihr Besitzer waren teuflische Schöpfungen Sarumans.

fields.title: Ballestero Uruk
fields.lore: Ambas, el arma y su portador, fueron inmundas creaciones de Saruman.

fields.title: Arbalétrier Ourouk
fields.lore: L'arme et celui qui la maniait était tous deux des créations infectes de Saroumane.

fields.title: Balestriere Uruk
fields.lore: Tanto l'arma quanto il suo possessore erano delle ripugnanti creazioni di Saruman.

cards.title: Uruk Defender
cards.gameText: Damage +1. Skirmish: Exert this minion at a battleground to make another Uruk-hai strength +2.
cards.lore: Saruman's Uruk army trained in formation tactics.

fields.title: Uruk Defender
fields.gameText: Damage +1. Skirmish: Exert this minion at a battleground to make another Uruk-hai strength +2.
fields.lore: Saruman's Uruk army trained in formation tactics.

fields.title: Uruk Verteidiger
fields.lore: Sarumans Uruk-Armee war geübt in taktischen Formationen zu kämpfen.

fields.title: Defensor Uruk
fields.lore: El ejército Uruk de Saruman se entrenó en formaciones tácticas.

fields.title: Défenseur Ourouk
fields.lore: Les armées ourouks de Saroumane étaient entraînés pour combattre en formation.

fields.title: Difensore Uruk
fields.lore: L'esercito degli Uruk di Saruman si addestrava nelle tattiche in formazione.

cards.title: Uruk Fanatic
cards.gameText: Damage +1. If there are at least 3 cards in the dead pile, this minion is fierce.
cards.lore: Despite intensive training, the smell of blood still enraged the Uruk warriors.

fields.title: Uruk Fanatic
fields.gameText: Damage +1. If there are at least 3 cards in the dead pile, this minion is fierce.
fields.lore: Despite intensive training, the smell of blood still enraged the Uruk warriors.

fields.title: Fanatischer Uruk
fields.lore: Trotz intensiven Trainings, machte der Geruch von frischem Blut die Urukkrieger immer noch rasend.

fields.title: Fanático Uruk
fields.lore: A pesar de un entrenamiento intensivo, el olor de la sangre aún enfurecía a los guerreros Uruk.

fields.title: Fanatique Ourouk
fields.lore: Malgré leur entraînement intensif, les guerriers ourouks devenaient fous à l'odeur du sang.

fields.title: Uruk Fanatico
fields.lore: Nonostante l'intenso addestramento, l'odore del sangue faceva ancora infuriare i guerrieri Uruk.

cards.title: Uruk Follower
cards.gameText: Tracker. Fierce. Unbound Hobbits may not be discarded. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is killed, exert this minion to add a burden.
cards.lore: “But at the moment Uglúk was not engaged in sport. He needed speed and had to humour unwilling followers.”

fields.title: Uruk Follower
fields.gameText: Tracker. Fierce. Unbound Hobbits may not be discarded. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is killed, exert this minion to add a burden.
fields.lore: “But at the moment Uglúk was not engaged in sport. He needed speed and had to humour unwilling followers.”

fields.title: Uruk Gefolgsmann
fields.lore: Aber im Augenblick war Uglúk nicht auf Scherze aus. Er brauchte Eile und musste unwillige Gefolgsleute bei Laune halten.

fields.title: Seguidor Uruk
fields.lore: “Pero por el momento Uglúk no estaba con ánimo de diversiones. Le corría prisa y no era ocasión de discutir con quienes lo seguían de mala gana.”

fields.title: Suivant Ourouk
fields.lore: « Mais, pour le moment, Ouglouk n'était pas porté au jeu. Il avait besoin de promptitude, et il devait se prêter aux caprices de suivants involontaires. »

fields.title: Seguace Uruk
fields.lore: “Ma per il momento Uglúk non pensava allo svago. Aveva fretta e doveva incoraggiare e incitare coloro che non avevano voglia di seguirlo.”

cards.title: Uruk Foot Soldier
cards.gameText: Tracker. Fierce. During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it is strength +3 and damage +1.
cards.lore: “‘Evening's coming on, and we ought to get a move on.'”

fields.title: Uruk Foot Soldier
fields.gameText: Tracker. Fierce. During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it is strength +3 and damage +1.
fields.lore: “‘Evening's coming on, and we ought to get a move on.'”

fields.title: Uruk Fußsoldat
fields.lore: "Der Abend kommt, und wir sollten uns dranhalten.“

fields.title: Soldado De A Pie Uruk
fields.lore: “El atardecer se nos echa encima, y deberíamos movernos.”

fields.title: Soldat d'Infanterie Ourouk
fields.lore: « “Le soir tombe, et nous devrions partir.” »

fields.title: Fante Uruk
fields.lore: “‘La sera sta per arrivare, e dovremmo rimetterci in marcia.'”

cards.title: Uruk Hunter
cards.gameText: Tracker. Fierce. Unbound Hobbits may not be discarded. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is killed, exert this minion twice to exhaust a companion.
cards.lore: “‘We came out of Isengard, and led you here, and we shall lead you back the way we choose.'”

fields.title: Uruk Hunter
fields.gameText: Tracker. Fierce. Unbound Hobbits may not be discarded. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is killed, exert this minion twice to exhaust a companion.
fields.lore: “‘We came out of Isengard, and led you here, and we shall lead you back the way we choose.'”

fields.title: Uruk Jäger
fields.lore: "Wir sind aus Isengart gekommen und haben euch hierher geführt, und wir werden euch auch auf dem Weg, den wir wählen, zurückführen.“

fields.title: Cazador Uruk
fields.lore: “Salimos de Isengard y trajimos la tropa aquí y volveremos por el camino que nosotros decidamos.”

fields.title: Chasseur Ourouk
fields.lore: « “Nous sommes partis de l'Isengard, nous vous avons conduits jusqu'ici, et nous vous ramènerons par le chemin que nous choisirons.” »

fields.title: Cacciatore Uruk
fields.lore: “‘Siamo venuti da Isengard e vi abbiamo guidati sin qui, e saremo noi a scegliere la via del ritorno che più ci piace.'”

cards.title: Uruk Plains Runner
cards.gameText: Tracker. Fierce. During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it is strength +3 and damage +1.
cards.lore: “‘Run! Or you'll never see your beloved holes again!'”

fields.title: Uruk Plains Runner
fields.gameText: Tracker. Fierce. During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it is strength +3 and damage +1.
fields.lore: “‘Run! Or you'll never see your beloved holes again!'”

fields.title: Uruk Steppenläufer
fields.lore: "Rennt, oder ihr seht eure geliebten Höhlen nie wieder.“

fields.title: Corredor De Llanura Uruk
fields.lore: “¡Corred, maldición! O nunca volveréis a ver vuestras queridas madrigueras.”

fields.title: Coureur des Plaines Ourouk
fields.lore: « “Courez! ou vous ne reverrez jamais vos chers trous.” »

fields.title: Corridore delle Pianure
fields.lore: “‘Correrete! O altrimenti non vedrete mai più le vostre adorate caverne!'”

cards.title: Uruk Pursuer
cards.gameText: Tracker. Fierce. Unbound Hobbits may not be discarded. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is killed, exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound an unbound companion.
cards.lore: “‘None of that! Hold your tongues.'”

fields.title: Uruk Pursuer
fields.gameText: Tracker. Fierce. Unbound Hobbits may not be discarded. Response: If an unbound Hobbit is killed, exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player wound an unbound companion.
fields.lore: “‘None of that! Hold your tongues.'”

fields.title: Uruk Verfolger
fields.lore: "Nichts dergleichen. Haltet den Mund.“

fields.title: Uruk Perseguidor
fields.lore: “Nada de charlas.”

fields.title: Pourchasseur Ourouk
fields.lore: « “Pas de ça. Bouclez-la.” »

fields.title: Persecutore Uruk
fields.lore: “‘Ehi voi!... Cucitevi la bocca.'”

cards.title: Uruk Rear Guard
cards.gameText: Damage +1. Skirmish: Exert this minion at a battleground to make another Uruk-hai strength +1.
cards.lore: Promised a fair share of plunder, they defended against possible reinforcements.

fields.lore: Las guerras entre los reinos del Sur enseñaron velocidad y precisión a los arqueros de los Haradrim.

fields.title: Tir en Rafale
fields.lore: Les guerres entre les royaumes du Sud enseignèrent la vitesse et la précision aux archers Haradrim.

fields.title: In Rapida Successione
fields.lore: Le Guerre tra i regni del sud insegnarono velocità e precisione agli arcieri degli Haradrim.

cards.title: Regiment of Haradrim
cards.gameText: Southron. To play, spot a [RAIDER] Man. Regroup: Exert Regiment of Haradrim twice to take control of a site.
cards.lore: “‘One of their regiments is due by our reckoning to pass by, some time ere noon....'”

fields.title: Regiment of Haradrim
fields.gameText: Southron. To play, spot a [RAIDER] Man. Regroup: Exert Regiment of Haradrim twice to take control of a site.
fields.lore: “‘One of their regiments is due by our reckoning to pass by, some time ere noon....'”

fields.title: Kompanie der Haradrim
fields.lore: "Eine ihrer Abteilungen muss unserer Schätzung nach irgendwann vor dem Mittag hier vorbeikommen....“

fields.title: Regimiento De Haradrim
fields.lore: “Según nuestras estimaciones, uno de los regimientos aparecerá aquí poco antes del mediodía...”

fields.title: Régiment de Haradrim
fields.lore: « “Un de leurs régiments doit, d'après nos calculs, venir par ici un peu avant midi...” »

fields.title: Reggimento degli Haradrim
fields.lore: “‘Uno dei loro reggimenti dovrebbe passare poco prima del meriggio...'”

cards.title: Southron Archer
cards.gameText: Southron. Archer. While you can spot another Southron, the minion archery total is +1 for each site you control.
cards.lore: “‘They have passed on to the Black Gate; but more may follow.'”

fields.title: Southron Archer
fields.gameText: Southron. Archer. While you can spot another Southron, the minion archery total is +1 for each site you control.
fields.lore: “‘They have passed on to the Black Gate; but more may follow.'”

fields.title: Southron Archer
fields.gameText: Southron. Archer. While you can spot another Southron, the minion archery total is +1 for each site you control.

fields.title: Südland Bogenschützen
fields.lore: "Sie sind weitergezogen zum Schwarzen Tor; aber noch mehr mögen folgen.“

fields.title: Arquero Sureño
fields.lore: “Iban todos hacia la Puerta Negra; pero otros podrían venir detrás.”

fields.title: Archer Suderon
fields.lore: « “Ils sont passés, en direction de la Porte Noire; mais d'autres peuvent suivre.” »

fields.title: Arciere Sudrone
fields.lore: “‘Sono arrivati al Cancello Nero; ma altri potrebbero venire.'”

cards.title: Southron Assassin
cards.gameText: Southron. Each time a companion or ally loses a skirmish involving a Southron, you may remove (1) to make the Free Peoples player wound a Ring-bound companion.
cards.lore: “‘Some of the Southrons have broken from the trap and are flying from the road.'”

fields.lore: “‘Some of the Southrons have broken from the trap and are flying from the road.'”

fields.title: Südland Attentäter
fields.lore: "Einige der Südländer sind aus der Falle ausgebrochen und fliehen von der Straße.“

fields.title: Asesino Sureño
fields.lore: “Algunos de los Sureños han conseguido escapar de la emboscada y ahora huyen del camino.”

fields.title: Assassin Suderon
fields.lore: « “Certains des Suderons se sont échappés du piège et s'enfuient de la route.” »

fields.title: Assassino Sudrone
fields.lore: “‘Alcuni dei Sudroni sono sfuggiti alla trappola e stanno scappando via dalla strada.'”

cards.title: Southron Bow
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a [RAIDER] Man. Bearer is an archer. While you can spot another [RAIDER] Man, the minion archery total is +1.
cards.lore: Volleys from Southron bows are deadly in large numbers.

fields.lore: Volleys from Southron bows are deadly in large numbers.

fields.title: Bogen der Südländer
fields.lore: In genügend großer Anzahl waren die Pfeile der Südländer tödlich.

fields.title: Arco Sureño
fields.lore: Las descargas de los arcos Sureños son mortíferas en grandes números.

fields.title: Arc Suderon
fields.lore: Les volées des arcs suderons sont mortelles en grand nombre.

fields.title: Arco Sudrone
fields.lore: Le salve di frecce dei Sudroni sono letali, se in gran numero.

cards.title: Southron Bowman

cards.lore: The Southron armies deploy archers to harass enemy troop formations.

fields.lore: The Southron armies deploy archers to harass enemy troop formations.

fields.title: Südländer Bogenschütze
fields.lore: Die Armee des Südlandes setzte Bogenschützen ein, um die feindliche Truppenaufstellung zu stören.

fields.title: Sureño Arquero
fields.lore: Los ejércitos Sureños despliegan arqueros para hostigar a las formaciones de tropas del enemigo.

fields.title: Tireur Suderon
fields.lore: Les armées suderones déploient leurs archers pour harceler les formations ennemies.

fields.title: Tiratore Sudrone
fields.lore: Gli eserciti dei Sudroni schierano gli arcieri per tormentare le formazioni nemiche.

cards.title: Southron Commander
cards.gameText: Southron. Ambush (1). Assignment: Spot 6 companions to assign this minion to the Ring-bearer. The Free Peoples player may discard an unbound companion to prevent this.
cards.lore: “‘Almost as bad as Orcs, and much bigger.'”

fields.title: Southron Commander
fields.gameText: Southron. Ambush (1). Assignment: Spot 6 companions to assign this minion to the Ring-bearer. The Free Peoples player may discard an unbound companion to prevent this.
fields.lore: “‘Almost as bad as Orcs, and much bigger.'”

fields.title: Anführer der Südländer
fields.lore: "Fast so schlimm wie Orks, und viel größer.“

fields.title: Comandante Sureño
fields.lore: “Casi tan malvados como los Orcos y mucho más grandes.”

fields.title: Commandant Suderon
fields.lore: « “Presqu'aussi mauvais que des Orques, et beaucoup plus grands.” »

fields.title: Comandante Sudrone
fields.lore: “‘Quasi cattivi come gli Orchi, e molto più grandi.'”

cards.title: Southron Explorer
cards.gameText: Southron. Regroup: Exert this minion and remove (5) to take control of a site.
cards.lore: Scouts find oases for Southron armies as they cross the deserts of Harad.

fields.title: Southron Explorer
fields.gameText: Southron. Regroup: Exert this minion and remove (5) to take control of a site.
fields.lore: Scouts find oases for Southron armies as they cross the deserts of Harad.

fields.title: Südland Kundschafter
fields.lore: Kundschafter entdeckten Oasen für die Armee der Südländer auf ihrem Vormarsch durch die Wüsten Harads.

fields.title: Explorador Sureño
fields.lore: Los exploradores buscan oasis para los ejércitos Sureños mientras cruzan los desiertos de Harad.

fields.title: Explorateur Suderon
fields.lore: En traversant les déserts de Harad, les éclaireurs trouvent des oasis pour les Suderons.

fields.title: Esploratore Sudrone
fields.lore: Le guide trovano oasi per gli eserciti Sudroni quando attraversano i deserti dell'Harad.

cards.title: Southron Fighter
cards.gameText: Southron. Ambush (1). Maneuver: Exert this minion and spot 5 companions to make the Free Peoples player exert a companion.
cards.lore: “‘...they have come out of the South beyond the Great River's end....'”

fields.title: Southron Fighter
fields.gameText: Southron. Ambush (1). Maneuver: Exert this minion and spot 5 companions to make the Free Peoples player exert a companion.
fields.lore: “‘...they have come out of the South beyond the Great River's end....'”

fields.title: Südlandkämpfer
fields.lore: "... sie sind aus dem Süden gekommen, jenseits vom Ende des Großen Stroms....“

fields.title: Luchador Sureño
fields.lore: “...han venido del Sur mas allá del final del Gran Río...”

fields.title: Combattant Suderon
fields.lore: « “...ils viennent du Sud au-delà du bout du Grand Fleuve...” »

fields.title: Combattente Sudrone
fields.lore: “‘...sono venuti dal Sud, dalle terre al di là della fine del Grande Fiume...'”

cards.title: Southron Scout
cards.gameText: Southron. Ambush (2).
cards.lore: “‘They have black eyes, and long black hair, and gold rings in their ears....'”

fields.title: Southron Scout
fields.gameText: Southron. Ambush (2).
fields.lore: “‘They have black eyes, and long black hair, and gold rings in their ears....'”

fields.title: Späher der Südländer
fields.lore: "Sie haben schwarze Augen und langes schwarzes Haar und goldene Ringe in den Ohren....“

fields.title: Avanzado Sureño
fields.lore: “Tienen los ojos negros, largos cabellos negros y aros de oro en las orejas...”

fields.title: Éclaireur Suderon
fields.lore: « “Ils ont un aspect féroce. Ils ont les yeux noirs, de longs cheveux noirs, et des boucles d'or aux oreilles...” »

fields.title: Guida Sudrone
fields.lore: “‘Hanno occhi neri, e lunghi capelli neri, e cerchi d'oro alle orecchie...'”

cards.title: Southron Sentry
cards.gameText: Southron. Maneuver: Exert this minion to add (2) for each site you control.
cards.lore: Pickets guarded the borders of the Southron encampment.

fields.title: Southron Sentry
fields.gameText: Southron. Maneuver: Exert this minion to add (2) for each site you control.
fields.lore: Pickets guarded the borders of the Southron encampment.

fields.title: Südland Wächter
fields.lore: Palisaden schützten das Lager der Südländer.

fields.title: Centinela Sureño
fields.lore: Los pelotones protegían los límites del campamento sureño.

fields.title: Sentinelle Suderone
fields.lore: Des piquets montaient la garde aux frontières du campement suderon.

fields.title: Sentinella Sudrone
fields.lore: I picchetti controllavano i confini dell'accampamento Sudrone.

cards.title: Southron Soldier
cards.gameText: Southron. Ambush (2).
cards.lore: The kingdoms of Harad fight countless wars and train thousands of warriors.

fields.title: Southron Soldier
fields.gameText: Southron. Ambush (2).
fields.lore: The kingdoms of Harad fight countless wars and train thousands of warriors.

fields.title: Südlandsoldat
fields.lore: Die Königreiche von Harad lagen ständig im Krieg und bildeten Tausende von Kriegern aus.

fields.title: Soldado Sureño
fields.lore: Los reinos de Harad luchan en incontables guerras y entrenan a millares de guerreros.

fields.title: Soldat Suderon
fields.lore: Les royaumes d'Harad livrent des guerres sans nombre et entraînent des milliers de guerriers.

fields.title: Soldato Sudrone
fields.lore: I regni dell'Harad combattono infinite battaglie e addestrano migliaia di guerrieri.

cards.title: Southron Spear
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Southron. Skirmish: Remove (4) and exert bearer to wound a companion or ally bearer is skirmishing.
cards.lore: Long pikes defend the Southrons against the armored knights of Gondor.

fields.title: Southron Spear
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a Southron. Skirmish: Remove (4) and exert bearer to wound a companion or ally bearer is skirmishing.
fields.lore: Long pikes defend the Southrons against the armored knights of Gondor.

fields.title: Speer der Südländer
fields.lore: Lange Piken schützten die Südländer gegen die Angriffe der gepanzerten Ritter Gondors.

fields.title: Lanza Sureña
fields.lore: Largas picas protegen a los Sureños de los acorazados caballeros de Gondor.

fields.title: Lance Suderone
fields.lore: De longues piques défendent les Suderons contre les chevaliers en armure du Gondor.

fields.title: Lancia Sudrone
fields.lore: Le lunghe picche difendono i Sudroni dai cavalieri corazzati di Gondor.

cards.title: Southron Troop
cards.gameText: Southron. Archer. Ambush (1). To play, spot a Southron. Assignment: Spot 7 companions to assign this minion to the Ringbearer. The Free Peoples player may make you discard a companion (except the Ring-bearer) to prevent this.

cards.title: Southron Veterans
cards.gameText: Southron. Ambush (1). Maneuver: Exert this minion and spot 6 companions to make the Free Peoples player exert 2 companions.
cards.lore: “He caught a glimpse of swarthy men... running down the slope some way off....”

fields.title: Southron Veterans
fields.gameText: Southron. Ambush (1). Maneuver: Exert this minion and spot 6 companions to make the Free Peoples player exert 2 companions.
fields.lore: “He caught a glimpse of swarthy men... running down the slope some way off....”

fields.title: Erfahrene Südländer
fields.lore: Flüchtig sah er schwärzliche Menschen..., die in einiger Entfernung den Hang hinunterrannten....

fields.title: Veteranos Sureños
fields.lore: “Por un momento alcanzó a ver a unos hombres endrinos... que corrían cuesta abajo a cierta distancia...”

fields.title: Vétérans Suderons
fields.lore: « Il eut un moment la vision d'hommes... qui descendaient la pente en courant à quelque distance... »

fields.title: Veterani Sudroni
fields.lore: “...intravide degli Uomini di carnagione scura... scendere di corsa il pendio...”

cards.title: Southron Wanderer
cards.gameText: Southron. Ambush (1). Assignment: Exert this minion and spot 5 companions to assign this minion to the Ringbearer. The Free Peoples player may add (4) to prevent this.
cards.lore: Some desert warriors have no allegiance and work for any faction that will pay them.

fields.title: Southron Wanderer
fields.gameText: Southron. Ambush (1). Assignment: Exert this minion and spot 5 companions to assign this minion to the Ringbearer. The Free Peoples player may add (4) to prevent this.
fields.lore: Some desert warriors have no allegiance and work for any faction that will pay them.

fields.title: Südlandnomade
fields.lore: Einige Südländer kannten keine Loyalität und kämpften für die Seite, die sie bezahlte.

fields.title: Vagabundo Sureño
fields.lore: Algunos guerreros del desierto no le deben lealtad a nadie y trabajan para cualquier facción que les pague.

fields.title: Vagabond Suderon
fields.lore: Quelques guerriers du désert n'ont aucune allégeance et travaillent pour quiconque les paie.

fields.title: Sudrone Errante
fields.lore: Alcuni guerrieri del deserto non sono fedeli a nessuno e si mettono al servizio di qualunque fazione li paghi.

cards.title: Vision From Afar
cards.gameText: Assignment: Assign an Easterling to the Ring-bearer. The Free Peoples player may add a burden to prevent this.
cards.lore: “Then he knew that the hope that had for one wild moment stirred in his heart was vain.”

fields.title: Vision From Afar
fields.gameText: Assignment: Assign an Easterling to the Ring-bearer. The Free Peoples player may add a burden to prevent this.
fields.lore: “Then he knew that the hope that had for one wild moment stirred in his heart was vain.”

fields.title: Von ferne gesehen
fields.lore: Dann wusste er, dass die Hoffnung, die sich einen verrückten Augenblick lang in seinem Herzen geregt hatte, vergebens war.

fields.title: Visión De La Lejanía
fields.lore: “Y supo entonces que la esperanza que en un raro momento le había encendido el corazón era vana.”

fields.title: Vision Lointaine
fields.lore: « Il vit alors la vanité de l'espoir qui, durant un instant fantasque, s'était fait jour dans son c*ur. »

fields.title: Visione in Lontananza
fields.lore: “‘Allora capì che la speranza balenatagli nel cuore in un momento di follia era del tutto vana.'”

cards.title: Whirling Strike
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Wound a companion or ally skirmishing a [RAIDER] Man.
cards.lore: The Southrons fight with tactics the men of Gondor have never before seen.

fields.title: Whirling Strike
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Wound a companion or ally skirmishing a [RAIDER] Man.
fields.lore: The Southrons fight with tactics the men of Gondor have never before seen.

fields.title: Wirbelnder Schlag
fields.lore: Die Südländer kämpften in einer Art und Weise, die die Menschen von Gondor noch nie zuvor gesehen hatten.

fields.title: Golpe Giratorio
fields.lore: Los Sureños luchan usando tácticas que los hombres de Gondor no han visto nunca.

fields.title: Coup Tourbillonnant
fields.lore: Les Suderons combattent avec des tactiques jamais vues par les hommes du Gondor.

fields.title: Colpo Mulinante
fields.lore: I Sudroni attaccano utilizzando tattiche che gli Uomini di Gondor non hanno mai visto prima.

cards.title: Wrath of Harad
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. While you can spot a [RAIDER] Man, each Free Peoples event that spots or exerts a ranger gains this cost: 'wound a companion.' Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [RAIDER] Man strength +2.
cards.lore: Massed Southron troops prepared to attack Gondor.

fields.title: Wrath of Harad

fields.lore: Massed Southron troops prepared to attack Gondor.

fields.title: Ira De Harad
fields.lore: Tropas de Sureños en masa se prepararon para atacar Gondor.

fields.title: L'Ire d'Harad
fields.lore: Les troupes suderones se préparaient à attaquer le Gondor.

fields.title: Ira dell'Harad
fields.lore: Le forze ammassate degli Haradrim si prepararono ad attaccare Gondor.

cards.title: Aldor
cards.subtitle: Soldier of Edoras
cards.gameText: Archery: Exert Aldor and spot a villager to make the fellowship archery total +1.
cards.lore: Fighting to defend his people, Aldor found courage to replace his youth.

fields.title: Aldor
fields.subtitle: Soldier of Edoras
fields.gameText: Archery: Exert Aldor and spot a villager to make the fellowship archery total +1.
fields.lore: Fighting to defend his people, Aldor found courage to replace his youth.

fields.subtitle: Soldat aus Edoras
fields.lore: Der Kampf um die Freiheit seines Volkes gab Aldor die Kraft seiner Jugend wieder.

fields.subtitle: Soldado de Edoras
fields.lore: Luchando para defender a su pueblo, Aldo encontró coraje para reemplazar su juventud.

fields.subtitle: Soldat d'Edoras
fields.lore: Oubliant sa perte, la lutte pour la défense de son peuple emplit le coeur d'Aldor de courage.

fields.subtitle: Soldato di Edoras
fields.lore: Combattendo per la sua gente, Aldor compensò con il coraggio la non più giovane età.

cards.title: Brego
cards.gameText: To play, spot a [ROHAN] Man. Bearer must be a Man, Elf, or Wizard. When you play Brego, you may heal bearer. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.
cards.lore: Brego was named for the second King of Rohan.

fields.title: Brego
fields.gameText: To play, spot a [ROHAN] Man. Bearer must be a Man, Elf, or Wizard. When you play Brego, you may heal bearer. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.
fields.lore: Brego was named for the second King of Rohan.
Brego war nach dem zweiten König von Rohan benannt.
Brego fue llamado como el segundo Rey de Rohan.
Brego porte le nom du second roi de Rohan.
Fu chiamato Brego, come il secondo Re di Rohan.

cards.title: Ceorl
cards.subtitle: Weary Horseman
cards.gameText: Response: If your opponent is about to take control of a site, exert Ceorl and a villager to prevent this.
cards.lore: “‘We were driven back yesterday over the Isen with great loss; many perished at the crossing.'”

fields.title: Ceorl
fields.subtitle: Weary Horseman
fields.gameText: Response: If your opponent is about to take control of a site, exert Ceorl and a villager to prevent this.
fields.lore: “‘We were driven back yesterday over the Isen with great loss; many perished at the crossing.'”

fields.subtitle: Erschöpfter Reitersmann
fields.lore: "Gestern wurden wir unter schweren Verlusten über den Isen zurückgedrängt; viele kamen um, als sie den Fluss überquerten.“

fields.subtitle: Jinete Cansado
fields.lore: “Ayer, en la otra margen del Isen, sufrimos una derrota; muchos hombres perecieron al cruzar el río.”

fields.subtitle: Écuyer Épuisé
fields.lore: « “Nous avons été repoussés hier au-delà de l'Isen, avec de grandes pertes; de nombreux hommes ont péri dans le passage de la rivière.” »

fields.subtitle: Cavaliere Esausto
fields.lore: “‘Fummo respinti ieri al di qua dell'Isen e subimmo molte perdite; quanti Cavalieri morti nell'attraversare il fiume!'”

cards.title: Elite Rider
cards.gameText: When this companion is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -1. While skirmishing a wounded minion, this companion is strength +2.
cards.lore: “After him they rode: a long line of mail-clad men, swift, shining, fell and fair to look upon.”

fields.title: Elite Rider
fields.gameText: When this companion is in your starting fellowship, his twilight cost is -1. While skirmishing a wounded minion, this companion is strength +2.
fields.lore: “After him they rode: a long line of mail-clad men, swift, shining, fell and fair to look upon.”

fields.title: Elitereiter
fields.lore: Ihm ritten sie nach: eine große Schar von Männern in Panzerhemden, pfeilgeschwind, schimmernd, schrecklich und schön anzusehen.

fields.title: Jinete De Élite
fields.lore: “Los otros lo siguieron: una larga fila de hombres en cota de malla, rápidos, resplandecientes, terribles y hermosos.”

fields.title: Cavalier d'Élite
fields.lore: « Tous le suivirent: longue file d'homme en cotte de mailles, rapides, reluisants, terribles et beaux à voir. »

fields.title: Cavaliere d'Elite
fields.lore: “Dietro di lui in una lunga fila galoppavano Uomini abbigliati di cotte di maglia, veloci, brillanti, al tempo stesso belli e crudeli nell'aspetto.”

cards.title: Éomer
cards.subtitle: Sister-son of Theoden
cards.gameText: While you can spot a [ROHAN] Man, Eomer's twilight cost is -1. At the start of each turn, you may heal a [ROHAN] ally.
cards.lore: “‘Now indeed there is hope of victory!'”

fields.title: Éomer
fields.subtitle: Sister-son of Theoden
fields.gameText: While you can spot a [ROHAN] Man, Eomer's twilight cost is -1. At the start of each turn, you may heal a [ROHAN] ally.
fields.lore: “‘Now indeed there is hope of victory!'”

fields.subtitle: Schwestersohn des Théoden
fields.lore: "Nun besteht wirklich Hoffnung auf Sieg!“

fields.subtitle: Hijo de Hermana de Théoden
fields.lore: “!Ahora en verdad hay esperanzas de victoria!”

fields.subtitle: Fils-Sœur de Théoden
fields.lore: « “A présent, certes, il y a l'espoir de la victoire!” »

fields.subtitle: Figlio della Sorella di Théoden
fields.lore: “‘Ora vi è davvero speranza di una vittoria!'”

cards.title: Éomer
cards.subtitle: Third Marshal of Riddermark
cards.gameText: While you can spot a [ROHAN] Man, Eomer's twilight cost is -1. Eomer is strength +2 for each wound on each minion he is skirmishing.
cards.lore: “Then one rode forward, a tall man, taller than the rest; from his helm as a crest a white horsetail flowed.”

fields.title: Éomer
fields.subtitle: Third Marshal of Riddermark
fields.gameText: While you can spot a [ROHAN] Man, Eomer's twilight cost is -1. Eomer is strength +2 for each wound on each minion he is skirmishing.
fields.lore: “Then one rode forward, a tall man, taller than the rest; from his helm as a crest a white horsetail flowed.”

fields.subtitle: Dritter Marschall der Riddermark
fields.lore: Dann ritt einer vorwärts, ein großer Mann, größer als die übrigen; sein Helmbusch war ein weißer Pferdeschweif.

fields.subtitle: Tercer Mariscal de La Marca
fields.lore: “Luego uno de ellos se adelantó, un hombre alto, más alto que el resto; sobre el yelmo le flotaba como una cresta una cola de caballo blanca.”

fields.subtitle: Troisième Maréchal de la Marche
fields.lore: « L'un d'eux s'approcha alors – un homme de haute taille, plus grand que tous les autres, de son casque, comme un cimier, pendait une queue de cheval blanche. »

fields.subtitle: Terzo Maresciallo del Riddermark
fields.lore: “‘Uno dei Cavalieri si face avanti, un uomo alto più degli altri; dal suo elmo spioveva a guisa di criniera una bianca coda di cavallo.'”

cards.title: Éomer's Spear
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. If bearer is Eomer and he is mounted, Eomer is damage +2.
cards.lore: “He advanced until the point of his spear was within a foot of Aragorn's breast.”

fields.title: Éomer's Spear
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. If bearer is Eomer and he is mounted, Eomer is damage +2.
fields.lore: “He advanced until the point of his spear was within a foot of Aragorn's breast.”

fields.title: Éomers Speer
fields.lore: Er näherte sich, bis die Spitze seines Speers einen Fuß von Aragorns Brust entfernt war.

fields.title: La Lanza De Éomer
fields.lore: “Avanzó hasta que la punta de la lanza tocó casi el pecho de Aragorn.”

fields.title: La Lance d'Éomer
fields.lore: « Il avanca jusqu'à ce que la pointe de sa lance fût à un pied de la poitrine d'Aragorn. »

fields.title: Lancia di Éomer
fields.lore: “Quando la punta della sua lancia fu a un piede dal petto di Aragorn, si fermò.”

cards.title: Éothain
cards.subtitle: Scout of the Mark
cards.gameText: Each time the fellowship moves to a plains site, each minion must exert.
cards.lore: “‘Time is pressing.... We must hasten south, lord.'”

fields.title: Éothain
fields.subtitle: Scout of the Mark
fields.gameText: Each time the fellowship moves to a plains site, each minion must exert.
fields.lore: “‘Time is pressing.... We must hasten south, lord.'”

fields.subtitle: Kundschafter der Mark
fields.lore: "Die Zeit drängt.... Wir müssen nach Süden eilen, Herr.“

fields.subtitle: Explorador de la Marca
fields.lore: “El tiempo apremia... Tenemos que darnos prisa hacia el sur, señor.”

fields.subtitle: Éclaireur de la Marche
fields.lore: « “Le temps nous presse ... Il faut nous hâter d'aller vers le sud, Seigneur.” »

fields.subtitle: Guida del Mark
fields.lore: “‘Il tempo preme... Dobbiamo affrettare il nostro viaggio a sud, sire.'”

cards.title: Éowyn
cards.subtitle: Lady of Rohan
cards.gameText: Valiant. Response: If an unbound companion is about to take a wound, exert Eowyn and add (1) to prevent that wound.
cards.lore: “Thus Aragorn... beheld Éowyn... and thought her fair, fair and cold, like a morning of pale spring that is not yet come to womanhood.”

fields.title: Éowyn
fields.subtitle: Lady of Rohan
fields.gameText: Valiant. Response: If an unbound companion is about to take a wound, exert Eowyn and add (1) to prevent that wound.
fields.lore: “Thus Aragorn... beheld Éowyn... and thought her fair, fair and cold, like a morning of pale spring that is not yet come to womanhood.”

fields.subtitle: Herrin von Rohan
fields.lore: So erblickte Aragorn... Éowyn... und fand sie schön, schön und kalt wie ein Morgen im bleichen Frühling, noch nicht zur Fraulichkeit gereift.

fields.subtitle: Dama de Rohan
fields.lore: “Así fue como Aragorn... vio a Eowyn... y la encontró hermosa, hermosa y fría, como una clara mañana de primavera que no ha alcanzado aún la plenitud de la vida.”

fields.subtitle: Dame de Rohan
fields.lore: « C'est ainsi qu'Aragorn vit pour la première fois... Éowyn, Dame de Rohan, et il la trouva belle, belle et froide, comme un pâle matin de printemps, non encore parvenue à la plénitude de la femme. »

fields.subtitle: Dama di Rohan
fields.lore: “Così Aragorn... mirò Éowyn... e la trovò bella, bella e fredda, come una mattina di pallida primavera, e non ancora maturata in donna.”

cards.title: Éowyn
cards.subtitle: Sister-daughter of Theoden
cards.gameText: Valiant. Response: If Eowyn is exhausted and about to take a wound in a skirmish, discard 2 cards from hand to prevent that wound.
cards.lore: “Slender and tall she was... but strong she seemed and stern as steel, a daughter of kings.”

fields.subtitle: Schwestertochter des Théoden
fields.lore: Schlank und groß war sie... doch stark schien sie zu sein, und hart wie Stahl, eine Tochter von Königen.

fields.subtitle: Hija de Hermana de Théoden
fields.lore: “Alta y esbelta era ella... pero fuerte y vigorosa a la vez, templada como el acero, verdadera hija de reyes.”

fields.subtitle: Fille-Sœur de Théoden
fields.lore: « Mince et élancée apparaissait-elle... mais elle était en même temps forte et dure comme l'acier, fille de rois. »

fields.subtitle: Figlia della Sorella di Théoden
fields.lore: “‘Era bianca ed esile... ma pareva forte e severa come acciaio, una figlia di re.'”

cards.title: Éowyn's Sword
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Eowyn. While you can spot a villager, Eowyn is damage +1.
cards.lore: “...the sword was set upright before her, and her hands were laid upon the hilt.”

fields.title: Éowyn's Sword
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Eowyn. While you can spot a villager, Eowyn is damage +1.
fields.lore: “...the sword was set upright before her, and her hands were laid upon the hilt.”

fields.title: Éowyns Schwert
fields.lore: ... das Schwert hatte sie senkrecht vor sich gestellt, und ihre Hände lagen auf dem Heft.

fields.title: La Espada De Éowyn
fields.lore: “...las manos apoyadas en la empuñadura de la espada clavada ante ella en el suelo.”

fields.title: L'Épée d'Éowyn
fields.lore: « ... l'épée était dressée devant elle, et ses mains reposaient sur la poignée. »

fields.title: Spada di Éowyn
fields.lore: “‘...teneva la spada dritta innanzi a sé, e le mani poggiate sull'elsa.'”

cards.title: Fight for the Villagers
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make a [ROHAN] Man strength +2 (or +3 if you spot a villager).
cards.lore: “‘Bar the gates, set a watch on the surrounds, and get the women and children to the caves.'”

fields.title: Fight for the Villagers
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make a [ROHAN] Man strength +2 (or +3 if you spot a villager).
fields.lore: “‘Bar the gates, set a watch on the surrounds, and get the women and children to the caves.'”

fields.title: Kämpft für die Dorfbewohner
fields.lore: "Verriegelt die Tore, stellt Wachen auf und bringt Frauen und Kinder in die Höhlen.“

fields.title: Luchar Por Los Campesinos
fields.lore: “Barrad las puertas, estableced una guardia en el perímetro, y llevad a las mujeres y los niños a las cuevas.”

fields.title: Défendez les Villageois
fields.lore: « “Barrez les portes, montez la garde aux alentours et menez femmes et enfants aux cavernes...” »

fields.title: Combattere per i Villici
fields.lore: “‘Serrate i cancelli, mettete delle sentinelle di guardia, e portate le donne e i bambini nelle caverne.'”

cards.title: Firefoot

cards.lore: Riders of his éored claimed that Éomer's horse had no equal, save Shadowfax.

fields.title: Feuerfuß
fields.lore: Die Reiter seines Éored behaupteten, dass kein Pferd, außer Schattenfell, Éomers Tier gleichkäme.

fields.title: Pies De Fuego
fields.lore: Los Jinetes de su éored aseguraban que el caballo de Éomer no tenía igual, salvo Sombragrís.

fields.title: Piedardent
fields.lore: Les cavaliers prétendent que le cheval d'Éomer n'a pas d'égal, sauf Gripoil.

fields.title: Zoccofuoco
fields.lore: I cavalieri della sua éored affermavano che il cavallo di Éomer non aveva eguali, eccetto Ombromanto.

cards.title: Forth Eorlingas!
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert Theoden to make a companion who has the Theoden signet defender +1 until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: “Behind them from the Deep came the stern cries of men issuing from the caves, driving forth the enemy.'”

fields.title: Forth Eorlingas!

fields.lore: “Behind them from the Deep came the stern cries of men issuing from the caves, driving forth the enemy.'”

fields.title: Vorwärts, Eorlingas!
fields.lore: Hinter ihnen aus der Klamm erschollen die lauten Rufe der Mannen, die aus den Höhlen herauskamen und den Feind vor sich hertrieben.

fields.title: ¡Adelante Eorlingas!
fields.lore: “Tras ellos llegaban desde el Abismo los gritos roncos de los hombres que irrumpían de las cavernas persiguiendo a los enemigos.”

fields.title: En Avant Eorlingas!
fields.lore: « Derrière eux, venaient du Gouffre les cris rauques des hommes qui sortaient des cavernes, poussant l'ennemi devant eux. »

fields.title: Avanti Eorlingas!
fields.lore: “Dal Fosso alle loro spalle giunsero le grida risolute degli uomini che irrompevano fuori dalle caverne scacciando il nemico.”

cards.lore: “‘...it was the spirit of your people that held it strong.'”

fields.title: Diese Festung ist nie gefallen
fields.lore: "... der Mut Eures Volkes machte sie uneinnehmbar.“

fields.title: Fortaleza Nunca Derrotada
fields.lore: “...fue el espíritu de tu gente lo que le mantuvo fuerte.”

fields.title: Une Forteresse Jamais Prise
fields.lore: « “... c'est l'esprit de votre peuple qui la garda forte.” »

fields.title: Una Fortezza Mai Caduta
fields.lore: “‘...è stato lo spirito della tua gente che l'ha mantenuta salda.'”

cards.title: Guma
cards.subtitle: Plains Farmer

cards.lore: Foodstores swelled as refugees like Guma brought provisions to the Hornburg.

fields.subtitle: Ackerbauer
fields.lore: Die Nahrungsspeicher schwollen an, als Flüchtlinge wie Guma Vorräte in die Hornburg brachten.

fields.subtitle: Granjero de las Llanura
fields.lore: Los almacenes de comida aumentaban con refugiados como Guma que trajo provisiones a Cuernavilla.

fields.subtitle: Fermier des Plaines
fields.lore: « “Dans ce cas, il n'y a que deux solutions... cacher l'Anneau pour toujours; ou le détruire.” »

fields.subtitle: Contadino delle Pianure
fields.lore: Le riserve di cibo aumentavano, poiché i rifugiati come Guma recavano provviste al Trombatorrione.

cards.title: Heavy Chain
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Man. Bearer may not be overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.
cards.lore: What Man of an earlier age wore this chain? Was his end worth a song?

fields.lore: What Man of an earlier age wore this chain? Was his end worth a song?

fields.title: Schweres Kettenhemd
fields.lore: Welcher Mensch aus alten Tagen trug diese Ketten? Fand er ein Ende, das eines Liedes würdig war?

fields.title: Cota Pesada
fields.lore: ¿Qué hombre de una era anterior portaba esta armadura? ¿Fue su final merecedor de una canción?

fields.title: Cotte de Mailles Forte
fields.lore: « “Qui fut l'Homme d'un temps passé digne de porter cette cotte? A-t-on chanté sur son sort?” »

fields.title: Armatura di Maglia Pesante
fields.lore: Quale Uomo di una passata era indossò quest'armatura? Fu la sua fine degna di una canzone?

cards.title: Helm! Helm!
cards.gameText: Regroup: Spot 2 mounted [ROHAN] Men to liberate a site or draw 3 cards.
cards.lore: “And with that shout the king came. His horse was white as snow, golden was his shield, and his spear was long.”

fields.title: Helm! Helm!
fields.gameText: Regroup: Spot 2 mounted [ROHAN] Men to liberate a site or draw 3 cards.
fields.lore: “And with that shout the king came. His horse was white as snow, golden was his shield, and his spear was long.”
Und zugleich mit diesem Ruf kam der König. Weiß wie Schnee war sein Pferd, golden sein Schild und lang sein Speer.

fields.title: ¡Helm! ¡Helm!
fields.lore: “En medio de este clamor, apareció el rey. Montaba un caballo blanco como la nieve; de oro era el escudo y larga la lanza.”
« Et sur ce cri, le roi vint. Son cheval était d'un blanc de neige, doré était son bouclier, et sa lance était longue. »
“‘In mezzo al clamore apparve al re. Il suo cavallo era bianco come neve, d'oro era lo scudo e lunga la lancia.'”

cards.title: Herugrim
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Theoden. He is damage +1.
cards.lore: “‘Here, lord, is Herugrim, your ancient blade....'”

fields.title: Herugrim

fields.lore: “‘Here, lord, is Herugrim, your ancient blade....'”

fields.title: Herugrim
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Theoden. He is damage +1.

fields.lore: "Hier, Herr, ist Herugrim, Eure alte Klinge.“
“Hela aquí, Señor, Herugrim, vuestra antigua espada...”
« “Voici, Seigneur, Herugrim, votre ancienne lame...” »
“‘Ecco a te, sire, Herugrim, la tua antica lama...'”

cards.title: Hlafwine
cards.subtitle: Village Farmhand
cards.gameText: Villager. Discard Hlafwine if an opponent controls his home site. Skirmish: Exert Hlafwine to make a [ROHAN] Man strength +2.

fields.subtitle: Landarbeiter
fields.lore: Zu alt, um noch zu kämpfen, bereitete Hlafwine die Mahlzeiten für die Verteidiger zu.

fields.subtitle: Campesino del Pueblo
fields.lore: Demasiado viejo para luchar, Hlafwine preparaba vituallas para los defensores.

fields.subtitle: Aide de Ferme Villageois
fields.lore: « “Vous avez été convenus ici pour répondre à la menace du Mordor.” »

fields.subtitle: Bracciante del Villaggio
fields.lore: Troppo vecchio per combattere, Hlafwine preparava i pasti per i difensori.

cards.lore: “‘A time may come when there will be a need for valour without renown....'”

fields.lore: “‘A time may come when there will be a need for valour without renown....'”

fields.title: Eine ehrenvolle Aufgabe
fields.lore: "Es wird eine Zeit kommen, in der wir auf solch selbstlose Tapferkeit angewiesen sein werden.“

fields.title: Una Carga Honorable
fields.lore: “Llegará un tiempo en el que habrá necesidad de valor sin reconocimiento...”

fields.title: Une Honorable Tâche
fields.lore: « “Le moment approche où nous aurons besoin de vaillance sans renommée...” »

fields.title: Una Incarico Onorevole
fields.lore: “‘Potrà arrivare un tempo in cui vi sarà bisogno di valore senza gloria...'”

fields.lore: “Very swift were the horses of Rohan.”

fields.title: Pferd von Rohan
fields.lore: Sehr schnell waren die Pferde von Rohan.

fields.title: Caballo De Rohan
fields.lore: “Los caballos de Rohan se alejaron rápidamente.”

fields.title: Cheval de Rohan
fields.lore: « Rapides étaient les chevaux de Rohan. »

fields.title: Cavallo di Rohan
fields.lore: “Velocissimi erano i cavalli di Rohan.”

cards.title: King's Mail
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. Bearer takes no more than 1 wound during each skirmish phase. If bearer is Theoden, he may not take wounds except during a skirmish involving him.
cards.lore: “Now men came bearing raiment of war from the king's hoard....”

fields.title: Die Rüstung des Königs
fields.lore: Nun kamen Männer und brachten Kriegsausrüstung aus des Königs Hort....

fields.title: La Cota De Mallas Del Rey
fields.lore: “Los hombres trajeron entonces paramentos de guerra de los arcones de Rey...”

fields.title: La Cotte du Roi
fields.lore: « Des hommes apportèrent alors un équipement de guerre des magasins du roi... »

fields.title: Cotta di Maglia del Re
fields.lore: “Giunsero allora Uomini con abiti da guerra appartenenti al tesoro reale...”

cards.title: Léod

cards.gameText: Villager. Discard Leod if an opponent controls his home site. Skirmish: Exert Leod to make a mounted companion strength +2.
cards.lore: Humble Léod was a rancher before he became a soldier at Helm's Deep.

fields.subtitle: Hirte aus Westfold
fields.lore: Der bescheidene Léod war Viehzüchter, bevor er in Helms Klamm zum Soldaten wurde.

fields.subtitle: Pastor del Folde Oeste
fields.lore: El humilde Léod era un ganadero antes de convertirse en un soldado en el Abismo de Helm.

fields.title: Leod
fields.subtitle: Berger de l'Ouestfolde
fields.lore: « “Il n'y a en elle ni dans ce pays nul mal, autre que celui qu'y apporterait un homme lui-même. Et alors, qu'il prenne garde!” »

fields.subtitle: Pastore dell'Ovestfalda
fields.lore: L'umile Léod era un allevatore prima di diventare un soldato presso il Fosso di Helm.

cards.title: Rider of Rohan

cards.lore: “‘They are proud and wilful, but they are true-hearted, generous in thought and deed....'”

fields.lore: “‘They are proud and wilful, but they are true-hearted, generous in thought and deed....'”

fields.title: Reiter von Rohan
fields.lore: "Sie sind stolz und eigenwillig, aber aufrichtig und großzügig im Denken und Handeln....“

fields.title: Jinete De Rohan
fields.lore: “Son orgullosos y porfiados, pero sinceros de corazón, generosos en pensamiento y actos.”

fields.title: Cavalier de Rohan
fields.lore: « “Ils sont fiers et opiniâtres, mais aussi loyaux et généreux de coeur et en action...” »

fields.title: Cavaliere di Rohan
fields.lore: “‘Sono orgogliosi e volitivi, ma il loro cuore è sincero, e i loro atti e pensieri sono generosi...'”

cards.title: Rider's Mount
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.
cards.lore: “Their horses were of great stature, strong and clean-limbed; their grey coats glistened, their long tails flowed in the wind....”

fields.title: Rider's Mount

fields.lore: “Their horses were of great stature, strong and clean-limbed; their grey coats glistened, their long tails flowed in the wind....”

fields.title: Reiterpferd
fields.lore: Ihre Pferde waren sehr groß, stark und wohlgestaltet; das graue Fell glänzte, die langen Schweife flatterten im Wind....

fields.title: Montura De Jinete
fields.lore: “Los caballos eran de gran alzada, fuertes y de miembros ágiles; los pelajes grises relucían, las largas colas flotaban al viento...”

fields.title: Monture de Cavalier
fields.lore: « Leurs chevaux étaient de grande stature, forts et bien découplés; leur robe luisait, leur longue queue flottait au vent... »

fields.title: Cavalcatura del Cavaliere
fields.lore: “‘I loro cavalli erano imponenti, forti e dall'andatura decisa; i manti grigi scintillanti, le lunghe code svolazzanti al vento...'”

cards.title: Rider's Spear
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. If bearer is mounted, bearer is damage +1.
cards.lore: “Shafts of the sun flared above the eastern hills and glimmered on their spears.”

fields.title: Rider's Spear

fields.lore: “Shafts of the sun flared above the eastern hills and glimmered on their spears.”

fields.title: Speer der Reiter
fields.lore: Sonnenstrahlen flammten über den östlichen Bergen auf und glitzerten auf ihren Speeren.

fields.title: Lanza De Jinete
fields.lore: “La luz crecía alrededor. Los rayos del sol encendían las colinas orientales y centelleaban en las lanzas.”

fields.title: Lance de Cavalier
fields.lore: « Des rayons de soleil flamboyaient au-dessus des collines de l'Est et miroitaient sur leurs lances. »

fields.title: Lancia del Cavaliere
fields.lore: “Raggi di sole avvamparono sui colli a oriente e scintillarono sulle loro lance.”

cards.lore: “‘How fair are the bright eyes in the grass! Evermind they are called... for they blossom in all seasons of the year, and grow where dead men rest.'”
