fields.lore: "Wie schön sind diese leuchtende Augen im Gras! Immertreu werden sie genannt... denn sie blühen zu allen Jahreszeiten und wachsen, wo tote Männer ruhen.“
“!Qué hermosos son esos ojos que brillan en la hierba! Las llaman nomeolvides... Pues florecen en todas las estaciones del año y crecen donde descansan los muertos.”
« “Que ces yeux qui brillent dans l'herbe sont donc beaux! On les appelle ‘souvenir éternel'...car elles fleurissent en toutes saisons et croissent où reposent les Hommes morts.” »
“‘Come son belli gli occhi luminosi nell'erba! Ricorda sempre è il loro nome... poiché fioriscono in ogni stagione dell'anno e crescono là ove riposano i morti.'”

cards.title: Supplies of the Mark
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Add (2) and place a villager from hand beneath your draw deck to heal a [ROHAN] ally.
cards.lore: “‘This is all we could save, my Lady.'”

fields.title: Supplies of the Mark
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Add (2) and place a villager from hand beneath your draw deck to heal a [ROHAN] ally.
fields.lore: “‘This is all we could save, my Lady.'”

fields.title: Nachschub für die Mark
fields.lore: "Dies ist alles, was wir retten konnten, Herrin.“

fields.title: Suministros De La Marca
fields.lore: “Esto es todo lo que podemos salvar, mi Señora.”

fields.title: Provisions de la Marche
fields.lore: « “C'est tout ce que nous pouvions sauver, ma Dame.” »

fields.title: Rifornimenti del Mark
fields.lore: “‘Questo è tutto ciò che siamo riusciti a salvare, mia Signora.'”

cards.title: Sword of Rohan
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. While bearer is skirmishing an Uruk-hai, bearer is damage +1.
cards.lore: “‘This is a good sword, Haleth, son of Háma... there is always hope.'”

fields.title: Sword of Rohan
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a [ROHAN] Man. While bearer is skirmishing an Uruk-hai, bearer is damage +1.
fields.lore: “‘This is a good sword, Haleth, son of Háma... there is always hope.'”

fields.title: Schwert aus Rohan
fields.lore: "Das ist ein gutes Schwert, Haleth, Sohn des Háma... es gibt immer Hoffnung.“

fields.title: Espada De Rohan
fields.lore: “Esta es una buena espada, Haleth, hijo de Háma... siempre hay esperanza.”

fields.title: Epée de Rohan
fields.lore: « “C'est une bonne épée Haleth, fils de Hama... il y a toujours de l'espoir.” »

fields.title: Spada di Rohan
fields.lore: “‘Questa è una buona lama, Haleth, figlio di Hàma... c'è sempre speranza.'”

cards.title: Théoden
cards.subtitle: Son of Thengel
cards.gameText: Regroup: Spot a [ROHAN] ally and exert Theoden to liberate a site.
cards.lore: “‘I myself will go to war, to fall in the front of the battle, if it must be.'”

fields.title: Théoden
fields.subtitle: Son of Thengel
fields.gameText: Regroup: Spot a [ROHAN] ally and exert Theoden to liberate a site.
fields.lore: “‘I myself will go to war, to fall in the front of the battle, if it must be.'”

fields.subtitle: Sohn des Thengel
fields.lore: "Ich selbst will in den Krieg ziehen und in der ersten Schlachtreihe fallen, wenn es sein muss.“

fields.subtitle: Hijo de Thengel
fields.lore: “Yo mismo iré a la guerra, para caer en el frente de combate, si tal es mi destino.”

fields.subtitle: Fils de Thengal
fields.lore: « “Je partirai moi-même en guerre, pour tomber sur le front du combat, si cela doit être.” »

fields.subtitle: Figlio di Thengel
fields.lore: “Io stesso partirò in guerra, e cadrò in battaglia, se così dovrà essere.”

cards.title: Valleys of the Mark
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time your opponent plays a roaming minion, you may spot a villager to exert that minion.
cards.lore: “‘Where is the hand on the harpstring, and the red fire glowing? / Where is the spring and the harvest and the tall corn growing?'”

fields.title: Valleys of the Mark
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time your opponent plays a roaming minion, you may spot a villager to exert that minion.
fields.lore: “‘Where is the hand on the harpstring, and the red fire glowing? / Where is the spring and the harvest and the tall corn growing?'”

fields.title: Die Täler der Mark
fields.lore: "Wo ist die Hand an der Harfe? Wo ist das lodernde Feuer? / Wo nun Frühling und Herbst und voll reifen Korns die Scheuer?“

fields.title: Valles De La Marca
fields.lore: “¿Dónde están la mano en el arpa y el fuego rojo encendido? / ¿Dónde están la primavera y la cosecha y la espiga alta que crece?”

fields.title: Les Vallées de la Marche
fields.lore: « “Où sont la main sur la corde et la harpe, et le grand feu rougeoyant? / Où sont le printemps et la moisson et le blé haut croissant?” »

fields.title: Valli del Mark
fields.lore: “‘Dov'è la mano sull'arpa, e il rosso fuoco ardente? / Dov'è primavera e la messe, ed il biondo grano crescente?'”

cards.title: Weapon Store
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Exert a [ROHAN] Man to play a hand weapon from your discard pile.
cards.lore: “‘And to you my other guests I will offer such things as may be found in my armoury.'”

fields.title: Weapon Store
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Fellowship: Exert a [ROHAN] Man to play a hand weapon from your discard pile.
fields.lore: “‘And to you my other guests I will offer such things as may be found in my armoury.'”

fields.title: Waffenlager
fields.lore: "Und Euch, meinen anderen Gästen will ich das anbieten, was in meiner Waffenkammer zu finden ist.“

fields.title: Almacén De Armas
fields.lore: “Y a vosotros, mis otros invitados, os ofrezco lo que podáis encontrar en mi armería.”

fields.title: Magasin d'Armes
fields.lore: « “Et à vous, mes autres invités, j'offrirai des objets de mon armurerie.” »

fields.title: Deposito di Armi
fields.lore: “‘Agli altri miei ospiti offrirò ciò che potrebbe servir loro della mia armeria.'”

cards.title: Weland
cards.subtitle: Smith of the Riddermark
cards.gameText: Villager. Discard Weland if an opponent controls his home site. Fellowship: Exert Weland to heal a mounted companion.
cards.lore: A tender of horses, Weland found much work at Helm's Deep.

fields.title: Weland
fields.subtitle: Smith of the Riddermark
fields.gameText: Villager. Discard Weland if an opponent controls his home site. Fellowship: Exert Weland to heal a mounted companion.
fields.lore: A tender of horses, Weland found much work at Helm's Deep.

fields.subtitle: Hufschmied der Riddermark
fields.lore: Da er sich mit Pferden auskannte, hatte Weland in Helms Klamm viel zu tun.

fields.subtitle: Herrero de La Marca
fields.lore: Un cuidador de caballos, Weland se encontró con mucho trabajo en el Abismo de Helm.

fields.subtitle: Forgeron de la Marche
fields.lore: « “Hélas pour la Lothlórien que j'aime! Ce serait une pauvre existence dans un pays où ne pousserait aucun mallorne.” »

fields.subtitle: Fabbro del Riddermark
fields.lore: Weland, che badava ai cavalli, trovò molto da fare al Fosso di Helm.

cards.title: Well Stored
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. At the start of each fellowship phase, you may heal a villager.
cards.lore: “‘Behind us in the caves of the Deep are... old and young, children and women. But great store of food, and many beasts and their fodder, have also been gathered there.'”

fields.title: Well Stored
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. At the start of each fellowship phase, you may heal a villager.
fields.lore: “‘Behind us in the caves of the Deep are... old and young, children and women. But great store of food, and many beasts and their fodder, have also been gathered there.'”

fields.title: Gut versorgt
fields.lore: "Hinter uns in den Höhlen sind... Alt und Jung, Kinder und Frauen. Aber auch große Vorräte von Lebensmitteln sind angelegt worden, und viele Tiere sind da und Futter für sie.“

fields.title: Bien Almacenado
fields.lore: “Atrás, en las cavernas del Abismo, están... viejos y jóvenes, niños y mujeres. Pero también hemos llevado allí provisiones en abundancia y muchas bestias, y el forraje necesario para alimentarlas.”

fields.title: Bien Approvisionnés
fields.lore: « “Derrière nous, dans les cavernes de Helm se trouvent... vieux et jeunes, femmes et enfants. Mais de grandes réserves de nourritures, et plusieurs bêtes et leur fourrage ont aussi été rassemblés ici.” »

fields.title: Ben Immagazzinato
fields.lore: “‘Dietro di noi, nelle caverne del Fosso, sono rifugiati... vecchi e giovani, donne e bambini. Ma ivi abbiamo anche riunito grandi quantità di provviste, di animali e di foraggio.'”

cards.title: Work for the Sword
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Make a [ROHAN] Man strength +2 (and damage +2 if mounted).
cards.lore: “‘The Orcs are destroyed. We slaughtered them during the night.'”

fields.title: Work for the Sword
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Make a [ROHAN] Man strength +2 (and damage +2 if mounted).
fields.lore: “‘The Orcs are destroyed. We slaughtered them during the night.'”

fields.title: Arbeit für die Schwerter
fields.lore: "Die Orks sind vernichtet. Wir haben sie in der Nacht erschlagen.“

fields.title: Trabajo Para La Espada
fields.lore: “Los Orcos fueron destruídos. Los aniquilamos durante la noche.”

fields.title: Du Travail pour l'Épée
fields.lore: « “Les Orques sont morts. Nous les avons massacrés durant la nuit.” »

fields.title: Lavoro per la Spada
fields.lore: “‘Gli Orchi sono stati distrutti. Li abbiamo uccisi durante la notte.'”

cards.title: Brace of Coneys
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit. Fellowship: Discard this possession to remove a burden.
cards.lore: “‘He let them stew for close on an hour, testing them now and again with his fork, and tasting the broth.'”

fields.title: Brace of Coneys
fields.gameText: Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit. Fellowship: Discard this possession to remove a burden.
fields.lore: “‘He let them stew for close on an hour, testing them now and again with his fork, and tasting the broth.'”

fields.title: Kaninchenragout
fields.lore: Er ließ sie fast eine Stunde brutzeln, prüfte sie ab und zu mit der Gabel und kostete die Brühe.

fields.title: Guiso De Conejo
fields.lore: “Los dejó hervir cerca de una hora, pinchándolos de cuando en cuando con el tenedor y probando el caldo.”

fields.title: Une Couple de Lapins
fields.lore: « Il les laissa cuire pendant près d'une heure, en les vérifiant de temps à autre avec sa fourchette et en goûtant le bouillon. »

fields.title: Coppia di Conigli
fields.lore: “Li lasciò cuocere a stufato per quasi un'ora, toccandoli ogni tanto con la forchetta ed assaggiandone il brodo.”

cards.title: Cliffs of Emyn Muil
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. When the fellowship moves from site 1T, remove up to 2 burdens. Skirmish: Discard this condition to wound a minion a Hobbit companion is skirmishing.
cards.lore: “‘We've escaped from the Emyn Muil!'”

fields.title: Cliffs of Emyn Muil
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. When the fellowship moves from site 1T, remove up to 2 burdens. Skirmish: Discard this condition to wound a minion a Hobbit companion is skirmishing.
fields.lore: “‘We've escaped from the Emyn Muil!'”

fields.title: Die Klippen des Emyn Muil
fields.lore: "Wir sind dem Emyn Muil entkommen.“

fields.title: Riscos De Emyn Muil
fields.lore: “¡Hemos escapado de Emyn Muil!”

fields.title: Les Falaises d'Emyn Muil
fields.lore: « “Nous nous sommes échappés de l'Emyn Muil.” »

fields.title: Dirupi dell'Emyn Muil
fields.lore: “‘Siamo fuggiti dall'Emyn Muil!'”

cards.title: Escape
cards.gameText: Stealth. Bearer must be an unbound Hobbit. Limit 1 per character. Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to cancel a skirmish involving him. Any Shadow player may remove (1) to prevent this.
cards.lore: “Suddenly Merry and Pippin realized that without moving they were now outside the circle....”

fields.title: Escape
fields.gameText: Stealth. Bearer must be an unbound Hobbit. Limit 1 per character. Skirmish: Exert bearer twice to cancel a skirmish involving him. Any Shadow player may remove (1) to prevent this.
fields.lore: “Suddenly Merry and Pippin realized that without moving they were now outside the circle....”

fields.title: Huida
fields.lore: “De pronto Merry y Pippin cayeron en la cuenta de que sin haberse movido se encontraban ahora fuera del círculo...”

fields.title: Évasion
fields.lore: « Merry et Pippin s'aperçurent tout à coup que, sans avoir bougé, ils se trouvaient à présent en dehors du cercle. »

fields.title: Fuga
fields.lore: “Improvvisamente Merry e Pipino si resero conto di trovarsi ora all'esterno del cerchio...”

cards.title: Frodo
cards.subtitle: Courteous Halfling
cards.gameText: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). While you can spot 3 unbound companions, Shadow cards may not discard cards from your hand or from the top of your draw deck.
cards.lore: “‘But as for us, we are Hobbits of the Shire, far to the North and West, beyond many rivers.'”

fields.title: Frodo
fields.subtitle: Courteous Halfling
fields.gameText: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). While you can spot 3 unbound companions, Shadow cards may not discard cards from your hand or from the top of your draw deck.
fields.lore: “‘But as for us, we are Hobbits of the Shire, far to the North and West, beyond many rivers.'”

fields.subtitle: Höflicher Halbling
fields.lore: "Aber was uns betrifft, so sind wir Hobbits aus dem Auenland, das fern im Norden und Westen hinter vielen Flüssen liegt.“

fields.subtitle: Mediano Cortés
fields.lore: “En cuanto a nosotros, somos hobbits de la Comarca, muy lejos al Norte y al Oeste, más allá de numerosos ríos.”

fields.title: Frodon
fields.subtitle: Semi-Homme Courtois
fields.lore: « “Quant à nous, nous sommes des Hobbits de la Comté, loin dans le Nord et dans l'Ouest, au-delà de maintes rivières.” »

fields.subtitle: Mezzuomo Cortese
fields.lore: “‘Quanto a noi, siamo Hobbit della Contea, che si trova all'estremo nord-ovest, al di là di molti fiumi.'”

cards.title: Frodo
cards.subtitle: Tired Traveller
cards.gameText: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). Fellowship: Play a Ring-bound companion to remove a burden.
cards.lore: “‘We have come by long ways – out of Rivendell, or Imladris as some call it.'”

fields.title: Frodo
fields.subtitle: Tired Traveller
fields.gameText: Ring-bearer (resistance 10). Fellowship: Play a Ring-bound companion to remove a burden.
fields.lore: “‘We have come by long ways – out of Rivendell, or Imladris as some call it.'”

fields.subtitle: Müder Wanderer
fields.lore: "Wir haben weite Wege zurückgelegt, denn wir sind aus Bruchtal gekommen oder Imladris, wie manche es nennen.“

fields.subtitle: Viajero Cansado
fields.lore: “Hemos venido hasta aquí por largos caminos, desde Rivendel o Imladris como lo llaman algunos.”

fields.title: Frodon
fields.subtitle: Voyageur Fatigué
fields.lore: « “Nous sommes venus par de longs chemins – de Fondcombe, ou Imladris comme d'aucuns l'appellent.” »

fields.subtitle: Viaggiatore Stanco
fields.lore: “‘Siamo giunti percorrendo lunghe strade... da Gran Burrone, o Imladris come lo chiamano taluni.'”

cards.title: Frodo's Cloak
cards.gameText: Bearer must be Frodo. Skirmish: At sites 1T to 4T, add a burden and discard this possession to cancel a skirmish involving Frodo. At any other site, discard this possession to remove a burden and heal Frodo.
cards.lore: Neither weather nor searching eyes found Frodo.

fields.title: Frodo's Cloak
fields.gameText: Bearer must be Frodo. Skirmish: At sites 1T to 4T, add a burden and discard this possession to cancel a skirmish involving Frodo. At any other site, discard this possession to remove a burden and heal Frodo.
fields.lore: Neither weather nor searching eyes found Frodo.

fields.title: La Capa De Frodo
fields.lore: Ni el clima ni los ojos inquisitivos encontraron a Frodo.

fields.title: La Cape de Frodon
fields.lore: Ni le temps, ni les yeux scrutateurs ne trouvèrent Frodon.

fields.title: Mantello di Frodo
fields.lore: Né il maltempo, né occhi alla sua ricerca insidiavano Frodo.

cards.title: Get On and Get Away
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Add 2 burdens to play the fellowship's next 2 sites (replacing opponent's sites if necessary).
cards.lore: “‘The Dead can't be really there! Is it some devilry hatched in the Dark Land?'”

fields.title: Get On and Get Away
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Add 2 burdens to play the fellowship's next 2 sites (replacing opponent's sites if necessary).
fields.lore: “‘The Dead can't be really there! Is it some devilry hatched in the Dark Land?'”

fields.gameText: Fellowship: Spot 2 Ring-bound Hobbits (or Smeagol) and add 2 burdens to play the fellowship's next 2 sites (replacing opponent's sites if necessary).

fields.title: Weitergehen, um weg zu kommen
fields.lore: "Die Toten können doch nicht wirklich da sein! Ist das irgendwie Schurkerei, die im Dunklen Land ausgeheckt wurde?“

fields.title: Montad Y Marchaos
fields.lore: “¡Los muertos no pueden estar ahí realmente! ¿Pesa algún sortilegio sobre el País Oscuro?”

fields.title: Continuer et Sortir d'Ici
fields.lore: « “Les morts ne peuvent être réellement là! C'est quelque sorcellerie tramée en Terre Ténébreuse ?” »

fields.title: Avanzare e Andare Via
fields.lore: “‘I Morti non possono essere effettivamente qui! Qualche diavoleria cova forse nell'Oscuro Paese?'”

cards.title: Good Work
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time a Hobbit wins a skirmish, you may place a [SHIRE] token here. Fellowship: Remove a burden for each [SHIRE] token here (limit 3). Discard this condition.
cards.lore: “‘You seem to have been doing well, Master Took.'”

fields.title: Good Work
fields.gameText: Plays to your support area. Each time a Hobbit wins a skirmish, you may place a [SHIRE] token here. Fellowship: Remove a burden for each [SHIRE] token here (limit 3). Discard this condition.
fields.lore: “‘You seem to have been doing well, Master Took.'”

fields.title: Gute Arbeit
fields.lore: "Du scheinst deine Sache gut gemacht zu haben, Herr Tuk.“

fields.title: Buen Trabajo
fields.lore: “Parece que habéis mostrado mucho tino, maese Tuk.”

fields.title: Bon Travail
fields.lore: « “Tu m'as l'air de t'être assez bien débrouillé, Maître Touque.” »

fields.title: Ottimo Lavoro
fields.lore: “‘Pare che tu abbia fatto un buon lavoro, Messer Tuc.'”

cards.title: Impatient and Angry
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Exert Sam to make him strength +3. If Sam wins this skirmish, you may remove a burden.
cards.lore: “He planted himself... as if he was addressing a young hobbit who had offered him what he called ‘sauce' when questioned about visits to the orchard.”

fields.title: Impatient and Angry
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Exert Sam to make him strength +3. If Sam wins this skirmish, you may remove a burden.
fields.lore: “He planted himself... as if he was addressing a young hobbit who had offered him what he called ‘sauce' when questioned about visits to the orchard.”

fields.title: Ungeduldig und wütend
fields.lore: Er pflanzte sich... auf... als ob er es mit einem jungen Hobbit zu tun habe, der ihm ‚pampig' gekommen war, als er ihn wegen Besuchen im Obstgarten verhörte.

fields.title: Enfadado E Impaciente
fields.lore: “Se plantó tranquilamente... Como si estuviese increpando a un joven hobbit que interrogado acerca de sus visitas a la huerta, se hubiese pasado de ‘fresco'.”

fields.title: Impatience et Colère
fields.lore: « Il se planta carrément...avec l'expression qu'il aurait eue pour apostropher un jeune Hobbit qui aurait fait preuve de ce qu'il appelait du ‘culot' à propos de questions sur certaines visites au verger. »

fields.title: Impaziente e Adirato
fields.lore: “Si piantò... con le mani sui fianchi, guardandolo come se si fosse rivolto a un giovane Hobbit che, interrogato sulle sue visite nell'orto, avesse risposto con insolenza.”

cards.title: Knocked on the Head
cards.gameText: Regroup: Play an unbound Hobbit from your discard pile.
cards.lore: “‘I wonder if poor Merry is much hurt.'”

fields.title: Knocked on the Head
fields.gameText: Regroup: Play an unbound Hobbit from your discard pile.
fields.lore: “‘I wonder if poor Merry is much hurt.'”

fields.title: Schlag auf den Kopf
fields.lore: "Ich wüsste gern, ob der arme Merry schwer verwundet ist.“

fields.title: Golpeado En La Cabeza
fields.lore: “Me pregunto si la herida de Merry será grave.”

fields.title: Un Coup sur la Tête
fields.lore: « “Je me demande si ce pauvre Merry est grièvement atteint.” »

fields.title: Colpito alla Testa
fields.lore: “‘Chissà se le ferite di Merry sono gravi.'”

cards.title: Light Shining Faintly
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Add a burden to heal a Ring-bound companion twice.
cards.lore: “‘He's like that, and sometimes it shines through, somehow.'”

fields.title: Light Shining Faintly
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Add a burden to heal a Ring-bound companion twice.
fields.lore: “‘He's like that, and sometimes it shines through, somehow.'”

fields.title: Schwach schimmerndes Licht
fields.lore: "So ist er, und manchmal schimmert es irgendwie durch.“

fields.title: Luz Brillando Débilmente
fields.lore: “Él es así, y a veces, por alguna razón, la luz se transparenta.”

fields.title: Une Lueur Brille Faiblement
fields.lore: « “Il est comme cela, et parfois la lumière transparaît d'une façon ou d'une autre.” »

fields.title: Luce Fioca
fields.lore: “‘Lui è così, e qualche volta, chissà come, traspare.'”

cards.title: Merry
cards.subtitle: Learned Guide
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Exert the Ring-bearer to discard Merry. Any Shadow player may remove (2) to prevent this.
cards.lore: “‘I don't suppose you have much notion where we are; but I spent my time at Rivendell rather better.'”

fields.title: Merry
fields.subtitle: Learned Guide
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Exert the Ring-bearer to discard Merry. Any Shadow player may remove (2) to prevent this.
fields.lore: “‘I don't suppose you have much notion where we are; but I spent my time at Rivendell rather better.'”

fields.subtitle: Gelehrter Führer
fields.lore: "Ich vermute , du hast nicht viel Ahnung, wo wir sind; aber ich habe meine Zeit in Bruchtal besser ausgenützt.“

fields.subtitle: Guía Experimentado
fields.lore: “No creo que sepas muy bien dónde estamos; pero he aprovechado mejor que tú el tiempo que pasamos en Rivendel.”

fields.subtitle: Guide Érudit
fields.lore: « “Je ne pense pas que tu saches guère où nous sommes; mais j'ai un peu mieux profité de mon temps à Fondcombe.” »

fields.subtitle: Guida Esperta
fields.lore: “‘Immagino che tu non abbia che una vaga nozione di dove ci troviamo, mentre io impiegai il mio tempo a Gran Burrone in modo più utile.'”

cards.title: Merry
cards.subtitle: Unquenchable Hobbit
cards.gameText: Skirmish: If Merry is not assigned to a skirmish, discard him to remove a [SAURON] Orc from a skirmish involving an unbound companion.
cards.lore: “‘All Wizards should have a hobbit or two in their care – to teach them the meaning of the word, and to correct them.'”

fields.title: Merry
fields.subtitle: Unquenchable Hobbit
fields.gameText: Skirmish: If Merry is not assigned to a skirmish, discard him to remove a [SAURON] Orc from a skirmish involving an unbound companion.
fields.lore: “‘All Wizards should have a hobbit or two in their care – to teach them the meaning of the word, and to correct them.'”

fields.subtitle: Nicht kleinzukriegender Hobbit
fields.lore: "Alle Zauberer sollten in ihrer Obhut ein oder zwei Hobbits haben, die die Zauberer die Bedeutung des Worts lehren und sie verbessern.“

fields.subtitle: Hobbit Inagotable
fields.lore: “Todos los magos deberían tener uno o dos hobbits a su cuidado, para que les enseñaran el significado de las palabras y los corrigieran.”

fields.subtitle: Hobbit Presque Assouvi
fields.lore: « “Tous les magiciens devraient avoir un ou deux Hobbits à leur charge – pour leur apprendre le sens de ce mot et les corriger.” »

fields.subtitle: Hobbit Irrefrenabile
fields.lore: “‘Tutti gli stregoni dovrebbero avere a disposizione un paio di Hobbit che insegnino loro il significato delle parole e li correggano.'”

cards.title: Mind Your Own Affairs
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Spot Frodo and add a burden to wound a minion skirmishing a companion who has the Frodo signet.
cards.lore: “‘Yet those who claim to oppose the Enemy would do well not to hinder it.'”

fields.title: Mind Your Own Affairs
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Spot Frodo and add a burden to wound a minion skirmishing a companion who has the Frodo signet.
fields.lore: “‘Yet those who claim to oppose the Enemy would do well not to hinder it.'”

fields.title: Kümmert Euch um Eure Angelegenheiten
fields.lore: "Dennoch würden jene, die behaupten, gegen den Feind zu kämpfen, gut daran tun, meinen Auftrag nicht zu hindern.“

fields.title: Ocúpate De Tus Asuntos
fields.lore: “No obstante quienes pretendan combatir al enemigo harían bien en no entorpecerla.”

fields.title: Mêlez-Vous de Vos Propres Affaires
fields.lore: « “Cependant, ceux qui prétendent s'opposer à l'Ennemi feront bien de ne pas l'entraver.” »

fields.title: Occupati di Ciò che ti Riguarda
fields.lore: “‘Tuttavia, coloro che pretendono di lottare contro il Nemico farebbero bene a non ostacolarlo.'”

cards.title: Pippin
cards.subtitle: Just a Nuisance
cards.gameText: Skirmish: If Pippin is not assigned to a skirmish, discard him to remove an Uruk-hai from a skirmish involving an unbound companion.
cards.lore: “‘What good have I been?... a passenger, a piece of luggage.'”

fields.title: Pippin
fields.subtitle: Just a Nuisance
fields.gameText: Skirmish: If Pippin is not assigned to a skirmish, discard him to remove an Uruk-hai from a skirmish involving an unbound companion.
fields.lore: “‘What good have I been?... a passenger, a piece of luggage.'”

fields.subtitle: Nur ein Ärgernis
fields.lore: "Was bin ich schon nütze gewesen? Nur eine Last: eine Last, ein Gepäckstück.“

fields.subtitle: Simplemente una Molestia
fields.lore: “¿Qué he hecho de bueno?... He sido sólo una molestia, un pasajero, un bulto de equipaje.”

fields.subtitle: Rien Qu'Un Encombrement
fields.lore: « “À quoi ai-je servi?... un passager, un bagage.” »

fields.title: Pipino
fields.subtitle: Un Peso Inutile
fields.lore: “‘A che cosa sono servito? Sono stato semplicemente un peso inutile: un passeggero, un carico.'”

cards.title: Pippin
cards.subtitle: Woolly-footed Rascal
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Add a burden to discard Pippin. Any Shadow player may remove (2) to prevent this.
cards.lore: “‘We had foul fare with the Orcs, and little enough for days before that. It seems a long while since we could eat to heart's content.'”

fields.title: Pippin
fields.subtitle: Woolly-footed Rascal
fields.gameText: Skirmish: Add a burden to discard Pippin. Any Shadow player may remove (2) to prevent this.
fields.lore: “‘We had foul fare with the Orcs, and little enough for days before that. It seems a long while since we could eat to heart's content.'”

fields.subtitle: Wollfüßiger Schlingel
fields.lore: "Wir wurden schlecht verköstigt bei den Orks und hatten schon vorher tagelang wenig genug gehabt. Es ist lange her, dass wir nach Herzenslust essen konnten.“

fields.subtitle: Pillo de Pies Lanudos
fields.lore: “Con los Orcos, la comida era repugnante, y antes de eso más que insuficiente durante muchos días. Hacía tiempo que no comíamos a gusto.”

fields.subtitle: Coquin Lâcheur aux Pieds
fields.lore: « “Nous avons fait vilaine chère avec les Orques, et nous n'avions pas eu grand-chose pendant plusieurs jours auparavant.” »

fields.title: Pipino
fields.subtitle: Furfante dai Piedi Lanosi
fields.lore: “‘E' stato assai brutto il viaggio con gli Orchi, e l'alimentazione dei giorni scorsi lasciava a desiderare. Sembrava passato un tempo eterno dall'ultima volta che avevamo mangiato a sazietà.'”

cards.title: Sam
cards.subtitle: Frodo's Gardener
cards.gameText: Ring-bound. Fellowship: Play Sam's Pack from your draw deck. Response: If Frodo is killed, make Sam the Ring-bearer (resistance 5).
cards.lore: “‘I am only a hobbit, and gardening's my job at home, sir, if you understand me....'”

fields.title: Sam

fields.lore: “‘I am only a hobbit, and gardening's my job at home, sir, if you understand me....'”

fields.subtitle: Frodos Gärtner
fields.lore: "Ich bin nur ein Hobbit, und Gärtner bin ich zu Hause von Beruf, Herr, wenn ihr mich versteht....“

fields.subtitle: El Jardinero de Frodo
fields.lore: “Yo no soy más que un hobbit, y jardinero de oficio, en mi tierra, señor, si me comprende usted...”

fields.subtitle: Jardinier de Frodon
fields.lore: « Je ne suis qu'un Hobbit, et le jardinage est mon métier, chez nous, Monsieur, si vous me comprenez...” »

fields.subtitle: Giardiniere di Frodo
fields.lore: “‘...Io non sono che un Hobbit, e a casa il mio lavoro è il giardinaggio, signore...'”

cards.title: Sam
cards.subtitle: Samwise the Brave

cards.lore: “‘Frodo wouldn't have got far without Sam....'”

fields.title: Sam

fields.lore: “‘Frodo wouldn't have got far without Sam....'”

fields.subtitle: Samweis der Tapfere
fields.lore: Ohne Sam wäre Frodo wohl nicht allzu weit gekommen.

fields.subtitle: Samsagaz el Valiente
fields.lore: “Frodo no habría llegado ni a la mitad del camino sin Sam...”

fields.subtitle: Samsagace le Brave
fields.lore: « “Frodon ne serait pas allé loin sans Sam...” »

fields.subtitle: Samvise il Coraggioso
fields.lore: “Frodo non avrebbe fatto molta strada senza Sam...”

cards.title: Sam's Pack
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a Ring-bound Hobbit. At the start of each turn, you may add (2) to heal a Ring-bound companion.
cards.lore: “He still hopefully carried some of his gear in his pack....”

fields.title: Sams Rucksack
fields.lore: Hoffnungsvoll schleppte er immer noch etwas von seiner Ausrüstung mit....

fields.title: La Mochila De Sam
fields.lore: “No había perdido aún las esperanzas de utilizar los enseres que llevaba en el equipaje...”

fields.title: Le Paquet de Sam
fields.lore: « Il portait toujours avec espoir une partie de son matériel dans son paquet... »

fields.title: Zaino di Sam
fields.lore: “Si trascinava ancora dietro, speranzoso, parte dell'attrezzatura nello zaino...”

cards.title: Seven We Had
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Add a burden to discard a condition borne by a Hobbit.
cards.lore: “‘...one we lost at Moria, the others we left at Parth Galen above Rauros....'”

fields.title: Seven We Had

fields.title: Sieben Gefährten hatten wir
fields.lore: "Einen verloren wir in Moria, die anderen verließen wir bei Parth Galen oberhalb von Rauros....“

fields.title: Teníamos Siete
fields.lore: “...a uno lo perdimos en Moria, de los otros nos separamos en Parth Galen a orillas del Rauros...”

fields.title: Nous En Avions Sept
fields.lore: « “... nous en perdîmes un à la Moria; les autres, nous les avons laissés à Parth Galen au-dessus du Rauros...” »

fields.title: Sette ne Avevamo
fields.lore: “‘...uno lo perdemmo a Moria, gli altri li lasciammo a Parth Galen sopra Rauros...'”

cards.lore: “‘The cord was cut!'”

fields.title: Seine Fesseln trennen
fields.lore: Der Strick war durchgeschnitten!

fields.title: Cortó Sus Ataduras
fields.lore: “¡La cuerda estaba cortada!”

fields.title: Il a Défait ses Liens
fields.lore: « “La corde a été coupée!” »

fields.title: Tagliare le Sue Corde
fields.lore: “‘La corda si ruppe!'”

cards.title: Store-room
cards.gameText: Regroup: Heal an unbound Hobbit once (or twice if you spot Gandalf).
cards.lore: “‘Saruman kept enough wisdom not to trust his Orcs. He had Men to guard his gates.... Anyway, they were favoured and got good provisions.'”

fields.title: Store-room
fields.gameText: Regroup: Heal an unbound Hobbit once (or twice if you spot Gandalf).
fields.lore: “‘Saruman kept enough wisdom not to trust his Orcs. He had Men to guard his gates.... Anyway, they were favoured and got good provisions.'”

fields.title: Vorratsraum
fields.lore: "Saruman hat genug Verstand bewahrt, um seinen Orks nicht zu trauen. Er hatte Menschen, die seine Tore bewachten.... Jedenfalls wurden sie bevorzugt und bekamen gute Verpflegung.“

fields.title: Almacén
fields.lore: “Saruman, a pesar de todo, tuvo la prudencia de no fiarse de los Orcos. Eran Hombres los que custodiaban las puertas... Como quiera que sea, ellos fueron los favorecidos y obtuvieron buenas provisiones.

fields.title: Magasin
fields.lore: « “Saroumane avait conservé suffisamment de sagesse pour ne pas faire confiance à ses Orques. Il avait des hommes pour garder ses portes... En tout cas, ils étaient favorisés et ils recevaient de bons vivres.” »

fields.title: Magazzino
fields.lore: “‘Saruman, nonostante tutto, era ancora abbastanza saggio per non fidarsi dei suoi Orchi. Teneva degli Uomini a guardia del cancello... Comunque erano privilegiati e forniti di ottime provviste.'”

cards.title: Swiftly and Softly

cards.lore: “In the deep of night under hard clear stars they set off.”

fields.title: Rasch und leise
fields.lore: In tiefer Nacht unter den harten, klaren Sternen brachen sie auf.

fields.title: Suave Y Rápidamente
fields.lore: “En plena noche y a la luz clara y fría de las estrellas, emprendieron la marcha.”

fields.title: Avec Rapidité et Douceur
fields.lore: « Ils se mirent en route, en pleine nuit sous les étoiles dures et claires. »

fields.title: Silenzioso e Veloce
fields.lore: “‘A notte fonda, al lume di pallide stelle gelide si misero in marcia.'”

cards.title: Warmed Up a Bit
cards.gameText: Stealth. Skirmish: Discard an unbound Hobbit.
cards.lore: “‘...we shall be able to stand again, and walk.'”

fields.title: Warmed Up a Bit

fields.lore: “‘...we shall be able to stand again, and walk.'”

fields.title: Ein wenig aufgewärmt
fields.lore: "... können wir vielleicht sogar wieder stehen und gehen.“

fields.title: Desentumecido Un Poco
fields.lore: “...quizá podamos tenernos en pie y caminar.”

fields.title: Un Peu Dérouillés
fields.lore: « “...nous pourrons nous tenir debout et marcher.” »

fields.title: Scaldati un Po'
fields.lore: “‘...quando ci saremo scaldati un po', forse riusciremo di nuovo a stare in piedi e a camminare.'”

fields.lore: “‘Forty leagues and five you have measured ere the fourth day is ended! Hardy is the race of Elendil!'”

fields.subtitle: Flügelfuß
fields.lore: "Fünfundvierzig Wegstunden habt ihr zurückgelegt, ehe der vierte Tag sich neigt. Zäh ist Elendils Geschlecht!“

fields.subtitle: Pies Alados
fields.lore: “¡No ha concluido el cuarto día y ya habéis recorrido cuarenta y cinco leguas! ¡Fuerte es la raza de Elendil!”

fields.subtitle: Pieds-Ailés
fields.lore: « “Vous avez parcouru quarante-cinq lieues avant la fin du quatrième jour! Robuste est la race d'Elendil!” »

fields.subtitle: Piedealato
fields.lore: “‘Quarantacinque leghe avete percorso prima della fine del quarto giorno! Robusta è la stirpe di Elendil!'”

cards.title: Théoden
cards.subtitle: Lord of the Mark
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Play a [ROHAN] possession on a [ROHAN] companion to heal that companion (limit once per turn).
cards.lore: “‘Every man and strong lad able to bear arms, all who have horses, let them be ready in the saddle at the gate ere the second hour from noon!'”

fields.title: Théoden
fields.subtitle: Lord of the Mark
fields.gameText: Fellowship: Play a [ROHAN] possession on a [ROHAN] companion to heal that companion (limit once per turn).
fields.lore: “‘Every man and strong lad able to bear arms, all who have horses, let them be ready in the saddle at the gate ere the second hour from noon!'”

fields.subtitle: Herrscher der Mark
fields.lore: "Jeder Mann und jeder kräftige Bursche, der fähig ist, Waffen zu tragen, alle, die Pferde haben, sollen sich gesattelt am Tor bereithalten vor der zweiten Stunde nach dem Mittag!“

fields.subtitle: Señor de la Marca
fields.lore: “Que los hombres y los jóvenes fuertes y aptos para las armas, y todos quienes tengan caballos estén aquí montados a las puertas del castillo a la hora segunda pasado el mediodía.”

fields.subtitle: Seigneur de la Marche
fields.lore: « “Que tous les hommes et les gars assez forts pour porter les armes, que tous ceux qui possèdent des chevaux soient en selle à la porte d'ici la seconde après midi.” »

fields.subtitle: Sire del Mark
fields.lore: “‘Che tutti gli uomini, e i giovani forti e capaci di maneggiare le armi, e i proprietari di cavalli siano pronti in sella al cancello prima che suoni la seconda ora dopo il meriggio!'”
